tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /padma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa khrag 'thung lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug cing mchod pa'i rim pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ha yaṃ gri wa maṇḍal na maḥ bskal ldan gdul bya'i sgo gsum 'dzin ma la/ /smin byed dbang gi zim char legs phab ste/ /sku bzhi'i 'bras stsol drin can bla ma dang / /dbyer med rta mchog rol par gus btud nas/ /rgyud dang mkhas grub man ngag la brten te/ /padma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa'i rim/ /ma nor gzhung don gsal ba'i ngag gis bshad/ /de la 'dir padma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i rgyud la brten nas slob dpon rin po che padma 'byung gnas dang / sprul pa'i lo tsā ba chen po bai ro tsa nas smin grol las tshogs dang bcas pa'i rtsa ba'i yi ge rnams mdzad/ ring brgyud ni gter ma lugs dang / nye brgyud ni dpal ldan grub thob 'da' phyar la slob dpon rin po che padma 'byung gnas kyis smin grol yongs rdzogs dngos su stsal pa nas bzung chos rgyal brtson 'grus rdo rje sogs nas nye bar brgyud de tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po yab sras sogs la bka' babs pa ltar/ mkhas sgrub de rnams kyis dbang chog 'phrin gzhung / 'grel pa sogs yig cha'i rigs deng sang lung rgyun zhugs pa dang ma bzhugs pa du ma zhig mdzad 'dug pa rnams kyi nang nas bu brgyud phal cher gyis thugs nyams su bzhes shing phyag len du mdzad pa'i yig cha ni/ 'di'i sgo nas rang gzhan smin par byed pa'i nyams len dpal ldan seng ges mdzad pa'i dbang chog bde chen myu gu la lha dbang gi lhan thabs sbyar zhing / bla chen chos dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i dbang chu ma dag pa'i dri ma 'khrud byed gnyis gtso bor bzung 'phrin gzhung gnyags rnam rgyal bzang pos mdzad pa dang / dus phyis tshar chen rin po ches mdzad pa'i tshe dbang dang / gying lnga gza' gdong gi gtor chog rnams gung bsgrigs shing /

de dag tu mi gsal ba'i zur 'debs phran bu yig snying nas kha bskangs pas phyag len 'khrul med 'byung yang blo gros dman pa rnams kyis gsung rab de rnams phyogs gcig tu blta ma bde bas nyams len dang 'chad nyan gang yang ma nus par brten/ 'di skor gyi dbang kun chad la nye ba'i yi ge zhugs pa rnams byung na ci ma rung snyam pa'i nyams gso kho nas kun nas blang ste dkyil chog nag 'gros go bde'i ngag gis bkod na/ de yang sngar sa chog ma byas pa'i sar nub dang po sa chog gi nyer bsdog sa gzhi slang / brtag sbyang / bzung / bsrung ba rnams so sor bya/ deng sang phal cher gnas dus la mi byed pas 'dir ma bshad cing / byed dgos dang 'jug par spro na/ ratna shrī bha dras mdzad pa'i dbang chu dngos grub kyi 'byung gnas sogs nas 'byung ba ltar bya zhing / gnyis pa rang gang du gnas pa la gang du bya ba'i gnas gtsug lag khang dang mgon khang lta bu yin na rten dang rgyan dgram pa logs su mi dgos pas gnas der chag chag sogs byas la yo byad rnams bsham/ gnas sa rnams su byed na chag chag byas la bla bre yol ba 'phan gdugs la sogs pas nye bar mdzes pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi nub phyogs su 'di'i sku bris 'bur gang rung bzhugs/ gzhung bzhin sa stegs byed par spro na tshar chen yab sras kyi zhal slob ldong 'dren ind+ra sa mu dras brtsams pa'i dbang chu legs bshad rin chen phreng ba ltar bya/ yi ge sngon ma rnams nas las thig rjes su 'debs par gsungs kyang / phyag len phal cher la spyi 'gro ltar mdzad pas/ dkyil 'khor bri ba'i sar khrag chang bdud rtsi ril bu'i khu bas byugs la/ gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi pa dur khrod rdor phreng me ris dang bcas pa'i thig spyi 'gro ltar btab pa'i dbus su gru gsum rtse nang la bstan pa'i mthar thod skam gyi rwa ba'i mu khyud/ de'i phyir 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi thod pa skam rlon gyi mu khyud dang bcas pa btab cing bris pa'i dbus su maṇḍal dri thig zlum po'i steng la lha'i tshom bu/

dkyil 'khor gyi phyi'i byang shar du de'i dgos mchod/ g.yas su zhal zas/ dbus su mar me/ g.yon du spos/ rgyab tu zlum gtor rnams dang sa lha'i maṇḍal gyi steng mañdzi'i khar thod pa la sogs pa'i snod du 'bras chan/ 'bru sna/ sha rus/ me tog sna tshogs rul rgyu med pa zhib btags gtor phye chu chang las sbyar ba'i gtor ma snying gzugs la mtheb skyu rgyan kha phyir bstan brgya'am lnga bcu'i zlum skor 'bri mog sogs kyis dmar por bsgyur ba'i ldebs la dkar rgyan sgor mo ji ltar rigs pa'i dkyil du sha rlon pa ril por bsgril bas dmar rgyan ji ltar rigs pa dang / zur la me ri rtse rgyan padma'i steng thod pa padma nyi zla nor bu me ri can btsugs pa la mda' dar dmar po 'tshams pa yum gyi tsakli dang bcas pa btsugs pa'am/ de tsam ma 'grub na gtor dbyibs mdog sogs gong bzhin la rgyan rnams ci rigs kyis brgyan pa dang / de'i g.yas su mañdzi la 'byor na pho thod tshad ldan 'bru chang gar mas bkang par ba me ba/ tsan dmar/ li shi gha na sa ri/ spur be/ cu gang / dza ti/ ga bur/ bdud rtsi ril bu/ bu ram rnams zhib btags btab cing / mdog dkar por bsgyur ba'i sman phud dang / g.yon du mañdzi la 'byor na mo thod tshad ldan du khrag gtsang mar mon bu/ lug ru dmar po/ seng ldeng dmar po'i phye ma rnams btab pa'i rakta/ mdun du mañdzi la zhun chen bsres pa'i mar me 'bri mog gis kha bsgyur pa/ rgyab tu mañdzi la thod pa sogs su mngar gsum dang chu sbyar ba'i mchod yon rnams dang / bdud rtsi'i g.yas su stegs kyi mkhar snod gtsang mar gying lnga'i gtor ma dbus su gru bzhi pa dang bcas pa'i steng du/ bshos bu gru gsum chung ba gcig dang / de'i shar lho nub gsum du bshos bu gru bzhi sbrang du gru gsum rnams dkar dmar dang / khyad par ra'i sha khrag gis brgyan pa/ yang rakta'i g.yon snod gcig tu gza'i gtor ma bshos bu sum gnyis man gru bzhi/

sum cha yan gru gsum g.yas gcus/ phyogs bzhir gru gsum g.yas gcus re re ra rog po'i sha khrag gis brgyan pa/ yang mar me'i phyir snod gcig tu gnod sbyin gyi gtor ma dbus su gru gsum che ba gcig de'i g.yas g.yon du gru gsum chung ba re re/ de gsum gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du gru gsum chung ba re re/ de'i mtha' skor du gru gsum chung ba nyi shu rtsa gcig gis bskor ba/ de'i mdun du bskang ba byed par spro na lcam sring gsum gyi bskang gtor/ g.yas g.yon du btsan bshos dkar dmar/ bse'i ra skyes dmar po rnams dang / dkyil 'khor gyi rgyab tu brtan ma'i zlum gtor rtser rgyal mtheb skyu bcad kha phyir bstan gyis bskor ba khrag gis byugs shing dkar dmar gyi rgyan dang bcas pa ste/ gtor ma de rnams la 'byor na so so'i sku mdog dang mthun pa'i mda' dar tsakli'i rgyan ni ster rigs pa dang / rgyun du yi dam chos skyong gi gtor bsngo bskang ba gang byed kyi gtor ma gshoms dgos na'ang bshams shing / ma byung kyang chad pa'i skyon med/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyi'i byang shar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog shar gyi g.yas su 'bri mog gis bsgyur pa'i mar me/ g.yon du mngar gsum bsres pa'i mchod yon/ shar lhor dri lnga btab pa'i zhabs bsil/ lhor 'bru 'bri mog gis bsgyur ba'i me tog lho nub tu spos reng sogs/ nub byang du gur gum mam tsandan sbyar ba'i dri chab/ byang du 'o ma mar bu ram zan la sbyar ba'i zhal zas 'bri mog gis bsgyur zhing dkar rgyan can rnams bshams shing / spro na de dag kyang mañdzi'i khar bshams dgos pa'i khungs kyang yod do/ /dkyil 'khor gyi mdun mchod pa'i phyir stegs bu kheb ldan 'bru bkram pa'i steng padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dmar po 'dab ma dang mu khyud sogs ji ltar mdzes pa bri/ de'i steng du mañdzi la sogs pa'i mkhar snod gtsang ma rnams 'bras kyis bkang ba'i steng du rin chen dmar la sogs pa'i tshe bum gas chag med pa dar dmar po'i mgul 'ching dang bcas pa'i nang du/

sa'i snying po gser/ shing gi snying po bu re/ rtsi thog gi snying po mar dkar/ 'bru'i snying po til dkar sogs btab pa'i chu'i snying po chang gar mas legs par bkang / tshon skud sna lnga'i gzungs thag kyang mgul par dkris la bzhag pa'i steng du rin po che'i snod du spos sna tshogs btab pa'i chang gi sbrus pa'i tshe 'brang sgong gzugs ma ni zlum bu kha sbyor gyi rnam par byas pa thabs dang shes rab mtshon pa'i brdar phyed smad dkar phyed stod dmar du byas/ steng du mar gyis rdo rje rgya gram bris/ de'i lte ba la bu ram gyis g.yung ris chos bskor du bya/ de'i dkyil du srog shing la brten pa'i sar bu ram gyis rdo rje phyed pa gzugs/ mtha' la mi grangs dang snyam pa'i phye mar gyi ril bus bskor/ gzhan yang mda' bya rgod la sgro mes bzhur ba la dar dmar po kha la bsnams pa dang / me long dang g.yu rnams btags pa'i tshe 'gugs kyi mda' dar sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med cing phun sum tshogs par bshams/ dkyil 'khor gyi mthar yol ba yod na yol ba'i phyir phyogs skyong dang 'byung po'i zlum gtor gnyis pad 'dab bzhis bskor rgyan can dang / bgegs gtor ni mtheb kyu bcad khe phyir bstan gsum gyi steng gcig bcad khe gyen bstan gyi mdun ting lo/ g.yas g.yon gang bder zan changs dang bcas pa/ gser skyems kyi gtor ma zan leb gru bzhi gcig mgron tshan gyi grangs dang mnyam par gtub par gsungs pas/ 'dir gser skyems bsdus pa'i mgron tshan gyi grangs lnga tshan bzhir gras la 'bri mog gis bsgyur cing gru bzhi chung ngu so sor dkar rgyan dang / de'i mdun du phud chang bcas/ gnyis kar rin chen bandha bstan/ rang gi mdun du rdor dril/ nang mchod/ ḍā ma ru/ 'thor nas/ sgrub grogs mang du yod na rnga rol dung rkang gling sogs rol mo'i bye brag dang / snod so sor rtags gdab pa'i khrag zhag thal ba rnams mang nyung bso mtshams/

bum pa bcu'am gnyis gang rung du 'og tu bgegs bskrad nas blug rgyu'i chu gtsang / sman lnga/ dri lnga/ 'bru lnga/ rin chen lnga/ snying po lnga/ bdud rtsi ril bu'am chos sman gang rung dang kha tshad ma nyams pas srog lnga'am bdun yod pa'i mgul 'ching / ku sha sogs kyi kha rgyan/ dung chos/ rdor gzungs/ mchod pa gnyis su dkyil 'khor la chag chag 'debs pa'i sman rag mtshon sna lnga/ mig byed rdo rje bcas pa/ mda' dar brgyad me long bcas/ tshon skud kyi drwa ba sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med pa bshams la/ rdo rje slob dpon nas bzung sngags pa'i dbang gral gyi rim pa 'khod pa ni/ sngon 'gro bshoms kyi rim pa'o/ /cho ga dngos la thog mar bla ma'i gsol 'debs bya ste/ de yang / dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /bdag gi spyir bor padma'i gdan bzhugs nas/ /bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /e ma hoḥ spros bral chos kyi dbyings kyi zhing khams su: chos nyid dus gsum skye 'gag med pa'i ngang : bya bral lhun rdzogs bde ba chen po'i sku: nam mkha' bzhin du thugs rje phyogs ris med: bla ma chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan padma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: bde chen lhun gyis grub pa'i zhing khams su: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las kyi: ye shes lnga ldan bde bar gshegs pa'i sku: thugs rje bye brag sna tshogs so sor ston: bla ma longs spyod rdzogs sku la gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan padma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: mi 'jed 'jig rten dag pa'i zhing khams su: thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba'i don la byon: gang la gang 'dul thabs kyi 'gro don mdzad: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: bla ma sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan padma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: zhes dang /

tshar chen rin po ches mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs lam rim dang bcas pa la/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse nas gong sa rdo rje 'chang lnga pa'i bar gong sa lnga pa chen po de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i kha bskong dang / de 'phros kha bskong kho bos sbyar ba 'di bzhin bya ste/ dkon mchog gsum dngos rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i gtso/ /zhi khro rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bdag /gsang chen bzang po'i phrin las bstan pa'i dpal/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos dbyings 'od gsal bde ldan zhing khams su/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i chos sku snang brnyan ni/ /dmar gsal mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar 'od dpag med/ /chos sku snang ba mtha' yas la gsol ba 'debs/ /'og min bde chen dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /bde stong gnyis med khrag 'thung khro bo'i gar/ /yang gsang khros pa'i dpal chen dkyil 'khor pa/ /longs sku padma dbang chen la༞ /nub phyogs o rgyan rnga yab dpal ri rtser/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun 'dus rigs 'dzin che/ /srin po'i kha gnon skye rgu yongs kyi gnyen/ /sprul sku padma 'byung gnas la༞ /nags rgyal lha chu mtshan ldan sgrub gnas su/ /padmas rjes bzung rab dga'i sa la gnas/ /gangs can khrod 'dir grub thob 'dar phyar zhes/ /yongs su grags pa de nyid la༞ /dpal ldan bo dong mkhas pa'i chos grwa ru/ /thos bsam bsgom pas rang rgyud legs sbyangs nas/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pas rgyal ba'i bstan pa spel/ /chos rgyal brtson 'grus rdo rje la༞ /byang phyogs nyan po'i dben gnas dam pa ru/ /zab dang rgya che'i gdams pa'i mdzod bzung nas/ /skal ldan gdul bya skyong ba mkhas grub che/ /nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa la༞ /brag sram dpal gyi gtsug lag khang chen du/ /rig gnas rgya mtsho'i mthar son mkhas pa'i mchog /gcig tu sgrub pa lhur len grub pa'i dbang / /mkhan chen chos rgyal dpal bzang la༞ /gtsang stod mus srad dpal gyi dgon pa ru/

/gsang chen bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rdo rje 'dzin/ /khyad par lam 'di'i rtsa lag chag ston rje/ /kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ge la༞ /rnam par grol ba'i gnas kyi yang rtse ru/ /kun mkhyen chen po'i sras kyi thu bo pa/ /snyan brgyud bstan pa 'dzin pa'i dpal yon can/ /chos rje rin chen bkra shis la༞ /gar bzhugs chos dbyings dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /bde stong gnyis med ye shes rol pa las/ /nyams dang rtogs pa'i rba rlabs stong g.yo ba/ /rtogs ldan yon tan mgon po la༞ /rgyal po'i khab kyi sgo mang gtsug lag tu/ /zab don smra ba'i gtsug rgyan mchog gyur pa/ /mkhyen brtse nus pas 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal/ /bla chen chos dpal bzang po la༞ /dpal ldan sa skya'i grang chen bla brang du/ /gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i tshogs la dbang 'byor zhing / /gsung ngag bstan pa'i sgron me mus srad pa/ /byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan la༞ /snye thang bde mchog dpal gyi yang dben du/ /gsang chen gdams pas skal ldan rjes su 'dzin/ /mthu stobs nus pas nag phyogs phye mar thag /mus chen rnam rgyal bzang po la༞ /dam pas byin brlabs nags yug dgon pa ru/ /kun bzang dgongs pa'i gnas lugs mngon du gyur/ /drag sngags grub pa'i snyan grags phyogs kun khyab/ /'khrul zhig ratna bha dra la༞ /mang mkhar cha lung rdo rje'i brag rdzong du/ /blo gsal bung ba 'du ba padmo'i tshal/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i bcud phyung gdams pa'i gter/ /drin chen tshar pa smyon pa la༞ /gtsang stod zhwa lu'i dpal gyi chos grwa cher/ /gsang sngags bstan pa phyogs bcur spel mdzad cing / /tshar chen chos rje'i thugs bcud bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /'dzin mkhas mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug la༞ /gsung ngag slob bshad chos 'khor yang rtse ru/ /kha 'u par grags 'khrul med bstan pa'i rgyun/ /rnam par rgyas mdzad mthu stobs nus pa'i bdag /mkhas grub bsod nams chos 'phel la༞ /rje btsun gong ma'i phyogs med gdan sa ru/

/snyan brgyud gdams pa mchog gi bdud rtsi yis/ /skal bzang 'chi med dga' ston spel mdzad pa'i/ /sngags 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan la༞ /phun tshogs slob bshad chos kyi sde chen por/ /gsang chen theg mchog yid bzhin nor bu las/ /legs bshad 'dod dgu'i char chen 'bebs mkhas pa'i/ /mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan la༞ /bde ba'i rdo rje'i mi 'gyur pho brang cher/ /zab rgyas chos tshul bye bas sgo phye nas/ /skal ldan gdul bya smin cing grol mdzad pa'i/ /'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can la༞ /dga' ldan gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i pho brang cher/ /rang rang gdul bya'i blo dang legs mtshams par/ /mdo sngags bshad sgrub chos tshul 'doms mdzad pa'i/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho la༞ /'jigs med mi 'gyur rdo rje'i brag ri'i ngos/ /mdo rgyud man ngag rig gnas chos grwa cher/ /rgyal dbang padma'i rgyal tshab rig 'dzin rje/ /kun bzang padma 'phrin las la༞ /dpal ldan smon dga' rin chen bsam gtan gling / /rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bsti gnas su/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rmor chen rje/ /rje btsun kun dga' lhun grub la༞ /bkra shis dge mtshan dpal ldan chos kyi sde/ /'phags yul rdo rje gdan dang dbyer med du/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang ngur smṛg bla gos 'chang / /mtshungs med legs pa'i mtshan can la༞ /gtsang stod dpal ldan sa skya'i gdan sa zhes/ /mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i zhing khams dam pa ru/ /'khon rigs bstan 'gror dge ba'i lhag bsam can/ /ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros la gsol ba 'debs/ /phyi ltar dge mtshan du mas dpal gyis phyug /nang ltar gsang chen rdo rje'i pho brang che/ /gsang ba mnyam nyid chen po'i mkha' klong du/ /yab rje dbang sdud snying po la༞ /phun tshogs longs sku'i gzhal med khang bzang cher/ /dbang gi mtshan can thugs sras grub pa'i dbang / /rim gnyis bdud rtsi zil mngar rtags rol ba'i/ /ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen la༞

/bkra shis dge mtshan du ma'i srid pa'i gnas/ /bslab gsum rin chen rgyan gyis mngon par mtho/ /mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i ded dpon sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' rgyal mtshan la༞ /'chi med dbang gi dga' tshal dam pa ru/ /gsang gsum lha yi 'khor lor rtag tu gzigs/ /padma ka ra slar byon sa skya pa/ /sngags 'chang theg chen dbang sdud la༞ /phun tshogs rta bdun lam gyi nam mkha' la/ /nam bkra'i 'od lnga'i gur khang zhal yas cher/ /ḍā ki tshogs kyi rje bo sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la༞ /'dzam gling phun tshogs du ma'i dpal 'bar bar/ /lung rtogs chos kyi snang byed zer phreng 'gyed/ /phan bde'i pad tshal bzhad pa'i gnyen gcig pu/ /skyabs mchog kun dga' snying po la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa dang / /rig 'dzin rig pa brda yi brgyud pa dang / /gang zag snyan khungs brjod pa'i bla ma ste/ /brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag ni deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /tshad ldan bla ma dam pas rjes bzung zhing / /yang gsang khros pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i mthus/ /khrag 'thung rgyal po myur du 'grub par shog /sgrub chen bka' brgyad snying po padma dbang / /gsang las yang gsang khros pa nying khu'i rgyud/ /'phags yul grub dbang padma 'byung gnas dang / /skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po bai ro'i zhabs/ /gangs can grub thob dpal ldan 'dar phyar gyi/ /thugs kyi nying khu zhal gyis gdams pa 'di/ /dgongs pa ji bzhin 'khrul med legs rtogs te/ /rtse gcig brtson pas nyams su len par shog /rnam dag dbang bzhi'i bdag rgyud legs smin cing / /rim gnyis zab mo'i rtogs pa ldan byas nas/ /gnas skabs las bzhi'i phrin las kun 'grub ste/ /kun bzang dgongs pa mngon du 'gyur bar shog /lte ba'i dbus nas mchog gi 'od dmar gyis/ /rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa/

/mun khung sgron me bteg pa ji bzhin du/ /gsal dwangs snang ba'i bskyed rim rtogs par shog /de ltar snang ba'i bskyed rim thams cad kun/ /legs par brtags tshe skye 'gag gnas gsum dang / /gdod nas bral ba'i sems nyid rig pa'i rtsal/ /stong nyid rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtogs par shog /de las chu zla bar snang 'ja' tshon ltar/ /snang bzhin brtags na bden par ma grub cing / /med cing snang ba mi 'gags gdod ma'i gshis/ /zung 'jug ngang nas sku gnyis mngon 'gyur shog /dregs pa'i rgyal po gying chen sde lnga dang / /gza' gdong drag po gnod sbyin lcam dral sogs/ /ji ltar bsgo ba'i bka' las mi 'da' bar/ /gsang chen bstan pa bsrung ba'i mthu ldan shog /mkha' la rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i char sprin thibs/ /bar na rnal 'byor gsang sngags 'brug stong sgrog /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char chen gyis/ /sgrub mchog phun tshogs 'bras bu 'grub par shog /ces dang / gzhan yang rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku bstod sogs gsol 'debs mdzad srol 'dug pas spro na bya/ phyi'i sngon 'gro la rgyas par na rgyal chen tho 'dzugs/ /sri gnon/ sgo byang rnams mdzad pas de bzhin spro na gong du bshad pa'i dbang chu dngos 'byung sogs yi ge sngon ma rnams bzhin dang / phyag len phal cher la 'dir bshad pa ltar sngon 'gro 'bring po mdzad pas/ de'i tshul ni/ las kyi rdo rjes cha gsum la chab btang / dpon slob rnams kyis rdo rje gsor zhing / oṃ raṃ kro dha rakṣa badzra dzwa la raṃ/ tig na bi shwa dzwa la raṃ/ phaṭa raṃ raṃ/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ

rdo rje bsdu rgya/ rdo rje g.yab cing dril bu bcad gtub tu dkrol la/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs phyogs skyong rnams/ /thub pa'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /bdag cag rnams la phan mdzad phyir/ /'jig rten skyong ba dbang dang ldan/ /thabs mkhas thugs dam dkyil po che/ /tshangs dbang la sogs bcu rnams kyang / /byams pa'i thugs kyis 'dir byon cig /oṃ ind+ra ye/ agna ye/ ya ma ye/ ni ri ti ye/ wa ru ṇa ye/ wa ya ye/ ku be ra ye/ i shwa ra ye/ uddhaṃ brahma ṇa ye/ surya gra ha/ a ti pa ta ye/ tsand+ra nakṣa tra/ a ti pa ta ye/ a dhwa pri thi wi bhyaḥ a su re bhyaḥ nā ge bhyaḥ e hye hi/ padma'i phyag rgya dang / padma ka ma la ye satwaṃ/ mchod pa so so'i phyag rgya/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la grihna daṃ arghaṃ swā hā/ pā dyaṃ swā hā/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gandhaṃ/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shapda swā hā/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya dang / badzra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ dam la bzhag ngag tu/ rdo rje phyag 'tshal ba'i stangs ka dang / dril bu gsum brdung / dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha/ /lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /me ste sreg bya za ba'i lha/ /drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing༞ /gshin rje be con 'chang ba'i lha/ /ma mo'i rgyal po༞ /lho phyogs༞ /mchod cing༞ /bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha/ /srin po'i༞ /lho nub༞ /mchod cing༞ /zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha/ /klu'i rgyal po༞ /nub phyogs༞ /mchod cing༞ /rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha/ /rigs 'dzin rgyal po༞ /nub byang༞ /mchod cing༞ /gnod sbyin lag na dbyug tho 'dzin/ /nor skyong rgyal po༞ /byang phyogs༞ /mchod cing༞ /dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha/ /'byung po'i rgyal po༞ /byang shar༞ /mchod cing༞ /steng gi tshangs pa chen po dang /

/nyi ma zla ba gza' chen po/ /gza' dang rgyu skar bcas pa la/ /mchod cing༞ /'og gi klu ste sa yi bdag /sa 'dzin lag pa chen po pa/ /dam tshig shes pa'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhes pas bstod/ ngag tu/ oṃ ind+ra ye/ agna ye/ ya ma ye/ ni ri ti ye/ wa ru ṇa ye/ wa ya bhe/ ku be ra ya/ i shwa ra ye/ uddhaṃ brahma ṇa ye/ surya gra ha/ a ti pa ta ye/ tsand+ra nakṣa tra/ a ti pa ta ye/ a dhwa pri thi wi bhyaḥ a su re bhyaḥ nā ge bhyaḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyoḥ bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba thad khaṃ/ utga te/ spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhṇa daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swā hā/ rdor thal kha phye se gol dang bcas pa lan gsum gyis bsngos/ rdo rje thugs kha dang / dril bu chig brdung / shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ /gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po dang / /dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang / /steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang / /lha rnams kun dang gang dag sa steng klu/ /ri yi lha dang gtsang ma'i tshogs bcas la/ /sa sa so sor gtor ma phul ba 'di/ /rab tu dges pas yid kyis bzhes nas su/ /rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas kyang / /rang gi bud med mdza' bshes gnyen mdun bcas/ /nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas thabs gcig tu/ /phreng ba me tog dri dang gdug par bcas/ /bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na/ /'di dag gsol zhing legs par bsnams nas kyang / /bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang bskal pa bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srung /

/dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi ba nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wa ra gatstsha/ bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs gong bzhin byas la/ ngag tu/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas lha klu gnod sbyin 'byung po'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu rgya/ rdo rje g.yab cing dril bu bcad gtub tu dkrol la/ ngag tu/ lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul/ /nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzang lus srul po/ /dri za srin po gdon gyi tshogs bcas dang / /gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /bud med bcas shing g.yog 'khor bcas pa la/ /bdag gis pus mo sa la btsugs nas ni/ /thal mo sbyar nas khyed la gsol 'debs kyis/ /gsan nas phan btags slad du 'dir gshegs shig /oṃ de wa/ nā ga yakṣa/ gandharbha/ a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/ ki ṇa ra/ ma ho ra ga ma nu khe/ a ma nu khe/ e hye hi/ bhū ta sa pa ri wā ra/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ arghaṃ swā hā/ pā dyaṃ swā hā/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gandhaṃ/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shapda swā hā/ rdor bsdud dang / badzra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ dam la bzhag rdol thal kha phye ba'i mthar se gol bcas/ oṃ de wa/ nā ga yakṣa/ gandharbha/ a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/ ki na ra/ ma ho ra ga ma nu khe/ a ma nu khe/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyoḥ bi shwa mu ṣe bhyaḥ sarba thad khaṃ utga te/ spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga ṇa khaṃ gṛhna daṃ/ ba liṃ ta ye swā hā/ zhes pa gsum mam bdun gyis dbul/ rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bzhag ste/ bdag bsrung ba'i phyag rgya dang / g.yon pas dril bu chig brdung byas la/ ngag tu/ 'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang /

/dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yi gnas rnams dang / /shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang / /ri bo kun la gang dag gnas pa dang / /rin chen gling na lhag par gang gnas dang / /chu bo kun dang chu bo'i mdo rnams dang / /mtsho dang rdzing bu ldeng ka chu ngogs dang / /g.ya' chu bsil ma dag na gnas pa dang / /grong dang phyugs lhas grong khyer stong pa dang / /khang stong dag dang lha yi gnas rnams dang / /gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gnas rnams dang / /dka' thub gnas dang glang chen bres gnas dang / /rgyal po'i dkor khang dag na gnas pa dang / /lam srang gsum mdo dang ni bzhi mdo dang / /gang dag lam po che dang shing gcig drung / /dur khrod chen po nags tshal chen po dang / /seng ge dred dang gcan gzan gnas rnams dang / /'brog chen 'jigs su rung bar gang gnas dang / /gang dag gling mchog dag na gnas pa dang / /lhun po dur khrod dag na gnas pa rnams/ /rab tu dges shing mgu bar gyur gnas su/ /phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug par bcas/ /bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na/ /'di dag gsol zhing legs par bzhes nas kyang / /bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /sarba bhū ta gatstsha/ bgegs gtor bsang sbyangs byin rlabs gong bzhin dang / rang khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis rdo rje dang / dril bu 'dzin pas hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ ngag tu/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi༞ chos kyi༞ dge 'dun༞ bcom ldan 'das padma dbang chen khrag 'thung lha dgu 'khor za byed bka' nyan gyi tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi༞ rnal 'byor pa bdag gi sngags dang phyag rgya dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi byin rlabs dang / chos nyid rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing / chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyis sems can thams cad la gnod cing 'tshe ba dang /

rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob dkyil 'khor sgrub cing dbang bskur ba la dbang bskur mi byed na sgrub pa la zhes sbyar/ bar du gcod par byed pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad skad cig thang gcig yud tsam la 'dir mchis par gyur cig ṭakki hūm̐ dzaḥ ṭakki hūm̐ dzaḥ g.yon khro bo'i khu tshur bcas sogs/ gos kyi nang snying ga'i thad du kha nang bstan la bzhag g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya bskor zhing mthar mchog sbyin gyi rjes su se gol/ oṃ gung ka re gung ka re swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi pi tsi swā hā/ oṃ gung gung swā hā/ oṃ sarba bighān swā hā/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyoḥ bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba thad khaṃ/ utga te/ spha ra ṇa/ i maṃ/ ga ga ṇa khaṃ/ gṛhṇa daṃ/ ba liṃ ta ye swā hā/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis bsngos la/ lag pa g.yas pa khu tshur snying gar bzhag g.yon pa dril bu chig brdung byas la/ ngag tu/ gang zhig mtshan mo rgyu ba yi/ /'byung po rnams dang sha za dang / /srin po sha rjen za ba dang / /sems can rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /ljon shing gel pa sogs gnas dang / /de dang de la gtor ma ni/ /za ba sha chang la phug bcas/ /'bras chan 'bras bu mang po yi/ /mchod pa 'di yis mgu byos la/ /gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang / /bdag cag rnams la phan pa'i sems/ /de ring phyin chad bskyed par gyis/ /rgyan gyis brgyan par byas kyang chos spyod cing / /dul zhing yang dag sdom la tshangs par spyod/ /'byung po kun la chad pa spangs pa ni/ /dge slong dge sbyong de yin bram ze de/ /mtshon chas mi 'jigs gang yang med/ /'chi ba'i srog la kun kyang 'dzems/ /'tsho ba'i zas la kun kyang 'du/ /rang gi lus la dpe long la/ /gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig /oṃ chen po'am chung ngu gang dag gis/ /lus la mngon par gnod gyur pa'i/ /nad de nye bar phyung nas su/ /gdon khyod rang gi gnas su dengs/

/de ltar bdag gis ci nus kyi/ /mchod dang bsnyen bkur bgyis pa yis/ /dam tshig gnas la gnas nas su/ /bdag gi bsam pa skong bar mdzod/ /rtag tu dam tshig la gnas shing / /'dir ni bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad de rab tu gsos mdzod la/ /gdon khyod rang gi gnas su dengs/ /oṃ sarba bighanna gatstsha/ slob dpon gyis rdor dril gsor dkrol dang / gzhan rnams kyis drag po'i rnga rol/ las kyi rdo rjes bgegs gtor phyir dor ro/ /gser skyems ni/ gong du bkod pa'i gtor ma dang / chang phud gtsang ma gnyis/ las kyi rdo rjes mdun du cog rtse'am ras la sogs pa gdan gtsang ma'i steng du bzhag dpon slob rnams kyis rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor te/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ bhrūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mahā ratna ka ma la bi shuddhe/ zhes lan gcig dang / gser skyems kyi mgron rnams badzra sa mā dzaḥ rnga brdung shing dbyangs dang bcas pas/ ngag tu/ bla ma rig 'dzin tshogs bcas mchod/ /yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams mchod/ /sgrub chen bka' brgyad lha tshogs mchod/ /rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs mchod/ /khyad par dbang chen lha tshogs mchod/ /bcom ldan ha ya grī wa mchod/ /yum chen padma gar dbang mchod/ /sprul pa'i khro rgyal rigs bzhi mchod/ /yang sprul sgo ma bzhi rnams mchod/ /srog gcod gying chen sde lnga mchod/ /dregs pa gza' gdong lcam sring mchod/ /gnod sbyin bshan pa lcam dral mchod/ /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams mchod/ /bka' nyan dregs pa sde brgyad mchod/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong rnams mchod/ /mkha' 'gro phra men tshogs rnams mchod/ /gtsug lag khang gi srung ma mchod/ /bod khams brtan ma bcu gnyis mchod/ /gnas bdag gzhi bdag thams cad mchod/ /rigs drug sems can thams cad kyang / /gser skyems gtsang mas tshim byas nas/ /byang chub sems kyis rgyud gang ste/ /sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /'dir drag rol bya zhing las kyi rdo rjes gtor ma rnams khang steng du nam mkhar 'thor ba ste phyi mtshams bcad pa'o/

/spyod lam gyi mtshams bcad pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang par sgrub pa po rnams ma gtogs mis rgyu 'grul gcod dgos par gsungs zhing / sgrub grogs mang ba'am/ mched lcam tshang ma yod na skos bzhag pa'i las rdor gyis phyag gsum btsal la/ ngag tu/ rdo rje slob dpon rdo rje rgyal theb dang / /yum dang skar ma gying dang byan po dang / /gsang ba'i phyag tshang mched lcam bya rog ma/ /rang rang las sgrub bya phyir brtan par bzhugs/ /zhes brjod cing rkos chang drangs te/ sgrub pa 'di nam grub kyi bar la brtan par bzhugs shig ces brjod/ rtags nod dang rtags btab pa ni/ thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu/ ho dgongs su gsol/ steng rnam par dag pa 'phrul gyi gzhal yas khang / 'og rnam par dag pa gser gyi sa gzhi/ bar rnam par dag pa khrag 'thung rgyal po'i lha tshogs/ dben gnas rnam par dag pa dmar nag gru gsum dbang gi dkyil 'khor/ slob dpon rnam par dag pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i spyan sngar/ slob bu rnam par dag pa bdag cag rnams kyis dad pas phyag 'tshal/ dam tshig gi rtags nod rdo rje'i gral du mchis par ci snang / zhes brjod la las rdor gyis phyag gsum btsal/ slob dpon gyi thal mo sbyar la lha la rtags nod pa'i bsam pas/ rjes su gnang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes brjod la slob dpon rang dang tshogs pa rnams kyi dpral bar thal chen gyi tshom bu kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum pa'i dbyibs bris la/ ngag tu/ he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang / /dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas/ /gying chen kun dang gcig pa'i phyir/ /thal chen tshom bus brgyan pa yang / /'di yang rtags kyi phyag rgya ste/ /'di yang sngon gyi tha tshig go /'di yang bdag nyid chen po'i rgya/ /oṃ mahā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ āḥ rna rtse khur tshos gnyis te gsum du/ gung mdzub mthe'u chung gsum gyis rakta'i thig le thod tshal gyi dbyibs su bris la/ ngag tu/ he ru ka yi༞

/dur khrod༞ /ma mo kun dang༞ /rakta'i thig les༞ /'di yang༞ /'di yang༞ /'di yang༞ /oṃ mahā༞ /zhes brjod/ snying gar zhag chen gyi zo ris rdo rje rtse lnga pa'am tshes gsum gyi zla ba'i dbyibs su bris la/ he ru ka yi༞ /dur khrod༞ /gying chen kun dang༞ /zhag gi zo ris༞ /'di yang༞ /'di yang༞ /'di yang༞ /oṃ mahā༞ /zhes brjod/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bka' gnang ste/ rdo rje mched lcam 'dir 'dus rnams/ dbang chen gyi sgrub pa gnyen po 'di'i sgor bzhugs nas/ yi dam lha'i rgya btab pa yin pas/ khyed bgegs gdug pa can rnams kyis blta ba'am/ 'tshe ba'i gnas med pa yin no/ /zhes brjod/ de rnams shin tu spros pa che ba'i dbang du byas pa yin no/ /spros pa chung na/ ngag tu/ rjes su gnang ba bgyi'o/ /zhes brjod ma thag tu nang mchod kyis/ dpral ba mgrin pa snying gar thig le re bya'o/ /de rnams kyis phyi'i sngon du 'gro ba bstan zin to/ /nang gi sngon du 'gro ba la/ lha lhag par gnas pa/ sa lha lhag par gnas pa/ thig tshon lhag par gnas pa/ mchod pa lhag par gnas pa/ bum pa lhag par gnas pa dang lnga tsam zhig 'byung ba las/ dang po la/ rol mo byin dbab sngon 'gro'i bsod nams kyi tshogs bsog pa ni/ rang nyid gnas pa'i sa de gzhal yas khang du gsal ba'i dbus su/ padma'i sdong po lo 'dab me tog 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus su padma kha bye ba'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rgyal ba 'od dpag med pa'i rnam pa can mtha' skor du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams sprin phung 'thibs pa bzhin bsam/ mdun gyi pad 'dab lngar ru dra pho mo bsnol ba'i steng du bcom ldan 'das padma dbang chen/ lho'i padma la bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ge la 'khor rgyal ba rgyal mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ nub kyi padma la rgyu ma nor ba rtsa ba'i sngags/ bzlas pa'i sngags/

las tshogs kyi sngags sogs po ti brag ri yangs pa lta bu/ byang gi padma la khro bo bzhi/ khro mo bzhi ste rgyal ba rigs lnga'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ mtha' skor gyi padma la mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad sprin phung 'thibs pa bzhin bsam/ de'i mdun du rang nyid dpal rta mgrin zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pa can/ pha mas thog drangs sems can thams cad kyang rta mgrin gyi rnam par byas te/ skyabs su 'gro bar mos la/ ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la༞ /dam pa'i chos rnams la༞ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams༞ /nyer gcig sogs/ thal mo sbyar la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lan gcig sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dpal padma dbang chen gyi lam gyi rim pa zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig lan gcig ye shes tshogs bsogs dang mtshams bcad pa ni/

oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ paṃ padma maṇḍa la/ ma surya maṇḍa la/ a tsaṇḍa maṇḍa la/ ru tra baṃ/ hrīḥ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ hrīḥ badzra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdag nyid padma dbang chen sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas tsandan gyi be con nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon sdigs mdzub bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba/ spyi gtsug na rta mgo ljang khu rta skad 'tsher ba/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad dang / khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje'i gshog pa can/ mi mgo skam po'i dbu rgyan dang / khro bo'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bdag la thim/ hūm̐ badzra he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ badzra he ru kas dbu brgyan par gyur/ slar yang thugs kha'i hrīḥlas khro bo dpag tu med pa 'phros/ bgegs dang log pa 'dren pa thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus khro bo'i gur du gyur/ de'i phyi rol du rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ rin chen/ padma/ rgya gram rnams kyi sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla re/ phyi rol tu mda'i drwa ba ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ hrīḥbadzra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ nyer gcig gam brgya la sogs pa bzla/ thal mo sbyar la/ rgyal ba kun bdag chos sku padma'i gsung / /chos rje 'od dpag med pa rdo rje chos/ /spyan ras gzigs sprul hrīḥlas dbang chen sku/ /rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnga rol dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hrīḥ dpal chen mi zad dkyil 'khor nas/ /'bar ba'i khro bo me dpung 'bar/ /gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams/ /bgegs dang log 'dren rdul du rlog /dbang chen me dpung dmar nag 'bar/ /bskal pa dus mtha'i me lta bu/ /dbang drag mtshon cha brag ltar gtams/

/gang la babs kyang gcod cing sgrol/ /dbang chen khro bo mi zad rngam/ /srid pa'i ye shes 'khor lo 'khrigs/ /dbang chen mtshams las gang 'da' ba/ /rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bya'o/ /oṃ raṃ kro dha rakṣa badzra dzwa la raṃ tig na bi shwa dzwa la raṃ phaṭa raṃ raṃ/ drag rol dang bcas pas lan bdun brjod/ bshags pa bya ba ni/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das padma dbang chen khrag 'thung lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu rgya dang / thal mo sbyar la/ hūm̐/ bdag gis dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ /sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin dbang phyug go 'phang du/ /yi dam lha dang rdo rje slob dpon la/ /'da' bar ma byas bsrung bar dam bcas te/ /las ngan dbang gyur skye bo bdag 'dra ba/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang du gyur/ /sku yi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /yi dam lha yi phyag rgya mi gsal te/ /sngags dang bzlas brjod bsnyen pa'i grangs kyang chag /bsnyen sgrub bskang phyir dus kyi mchod pa chag /nya bzhi dus drug mchod pa lo zlar 'das/ /khas blangs dam bcas bzhin du ma bgyis te/ /gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /snyan gzhung brgyud nas thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /lta spyod gsang ba'i man ngag gnyer gtad pa/ /spyod pa g.yel bas man ngag gnyer ma thub/ /nyams shing tshogs chag nyams pa'i tshogs dang 'dres/ /thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /snang gsal sgron ma rdo rje slob dpon dang / /dam tshig gzungs kyis 'brel ba'i yum rnams la/ /snying nas smad cing thugs dang 'gal gyur pa'i/ /bka' chad gnas su gyur pa mthol lo bshags/ /dam tshig gsung gis 'brel ba'i mched lcam la/ /rku brdungs 'gran sems zhe sdang bsdeg la sogs/ /ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal mi bzod pas/ /ltung ba'i lu gu brgyud de'i rgyun thag chod/

/dbyings nyid nam mkha'i dbyings su bzod par gsol/ /bzod par gsol lo tshangs pa stsal du gsol/ /oṃ padma shrī he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ padma shrī he ru ka te no pa tiṣṭha/ dri dho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ sarba siddhi me pra yañtsa/ sarba karmā su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shrī ya/ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wan/ padma shrī he ru ka ma me muñtsa/ padma shrī he ru ko bha wa mahā sa ma ya satwa ā hūm̐ phaṭa/ brgya'am nyer gcig sogs bzla/ byin 'bebs ni/ mdun gyi tshogs kyi zhing de dag thams cad dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang gi snying gar thim/ yang snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs bsdus nas bdag dang dkyil 'khor gyi gnas su thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ hūm̐ a la la hoḥ bha ga wan/ sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ rnga rol dbyangs dang bcas pas/ 'phags mchog thugs rje'i dus la babs/ /mthu rtsal dbyung ba'i dus la babs/ /dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la babs/ /dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i dus la babs/ /nyams chag bskong ba'i dus la babs/ /mthu chen mthu stsol bcom ldan 'das/ /dbang chen dbang bskur bcom ldan 'das/ /byin can byin phob bcom ldan 'das/ /dngos grub mchog stsol bcom ldan 'das/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag rnams la/ /las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ zhes brjod/ phyi mchod byin rlabs ni/ mchod pa rnams la rdo rje gsor zhing / oṃ raṃ kro dha rakṣa badzra dzwa la raṃ/ tig na bi shwa dzwa la raṃ/ phaṭa raṃ raṃ/ rang gi thugs kha nas raṃ dmar po 'phros pa'i mes mchod snod rnams la reg pas mi gtsang ba bsregs/ yaṃ spros pas rlung gis gtor/ khaṃ spros pas chus bkrus/ skyon thams cad dag par byas/ bhrūm̐ spros pas bandha 'bar ba'i snod chen por gyur/ ooṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/

a du su a ga na sha sa ma ya satwaṃ/ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ a dkar po las mchod yon ma dkar mo mchod yon gyis gang ba'i dung chos/ du ser po las bdug spos ma ser mo spos khang / su dkar po las me tog la dkar mo me tog a dmar skya las mar me ma dmar skya mar me/ ga ljang khu las dri chab ma ljang gu dri chab/ na dkar po las zhal zas ma dkar mo zhal zas/ sha kha dog sna tshogs las rol mo ma sna tshogs mdog can rol mo sna tshogs 'dzin pa ste lha mo thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'i sku can du gyur/ mchod yon gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ a ha ra a ha ra hūm̐/ lan gsum/ de bzhin du mchod pa so so'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badzra dhū pe hūm̐/ gsum/ de bzhin du me tog nas rol mo'i bar la'ang phyag rgya dang bstun sngags rnams lan gsum re brjod de rdzogs pa dang / lha mo de dag re res kyang sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad gang bar gyur/ ces brjod/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs ni/ mdun gyi nang mchod dang gtor ma'i g.yas kyi bdud rtsi la rdo rje gsor zhing / oṃ raṃ kro dha nas skyon thams cad dag par byas/ bar gong bzhin/ bhrūm̐ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ bhrūm̐ bhi sha bi shuddhe bandha dzñā na tsakra maṇḍal/ thod pa'i gzhal yas khang 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte ba dang bcas pa padma surya ratna tsand+ra e maṇḍa la bhrūm̐/ dbus su padma 'dab brgyad/ shar du nyi ma/ lhor rin chen zur brgyad/ nub tu zla ba/ byang du rgya gram/ de rnams kyi steng du dbus su rakta dang oṃ pyaṃ/ shar du byang sems dang hūm̐ muṃ/ lhor sha chen dang swā maṃ/ nub tu dri chen dang oṃ laṃ/ byang du dri chu dang hā swaṃ/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las dbus su padma dril bu/ shar du rdo rje dril bu/ lhor rin chen dril bu/ nub tu 'khor lo dril bu/

byang du rgya gram dril bu/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las dbus su 'od dpag med yab yum dmar po gnyis ka'ang padma dang dril bu/ shar du mi bskyod pa yab yum sngon po gnyis ka'ang rdo rje dang dril bu/ lhor rin 'byung yab yum ser po gnyis ka'ang rin po che dang dril bu/ nub tu rnam snang yab yum dkar po gnyis ka'ang 'khor lo dang dril bu/ byang du don grub yab yum ljang gu gnyis ka'ang rgya gram dang dril bu 'dzin pa ste yab rnams g.yas phyag mtshan thugs kar 'dzin cing / g.yon dril bu dang bcas pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rnams g.yas phyag mtshan dang bcas pas yab la 'khyud cing / g.yon dril bu yab kyi thugs khar bsten pa/ yab rnams kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ badzra/ yum rnams kyi mkha' mi dmigs te a las padma 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru la as mtshan pa/ e aṃ/ a nu ra ga ya haṃ/ a nu ra ga ya mi/ bo dhi tsitta spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras 'khor 'das snod bcud kyi bdud rtsi thams cad bsdus nas yab yum rnams la thim ste 'od du zhu bas bdud rtsi dkar po mu tig gi mdog lta bu la oṃ dkar pos mtshan pa'i steng du padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte ba la las kyi rta mgrin dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas padma thugs kar 'dzin cing / g.yon rdo rje rgya gram gnon thabs su 'dzin pa'i mdun du mi pham ma dkar mo lcags kyu/ g.yas su khro gnyer ma ser mo zhags pa/ rgyab tu ral gcig ma dmar mo lcags sgrog g.yon du ro lang ma ljang gu dril bu 'dzin pa/ dbu gtsug rta mgo ljang gu'i steng na hrīḥdamar nag gnas pa de rang gi mthe bong a las zla ba dang / srin lag ma las nyi ma'i bar du 'dzin par gyur/ ces dang / mtheb srin sbyar ba hrīḥ'adzin pa'i stangs ka byas te/

a ma saṃ hrīḥsurya tsand+ra padma dha ra hrīḥ lan gcig dang / oṃ sarba mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐/ zhes 'dur dbyangs dang bcas pas brgya rtsa la sogs pa brjod pa'i mthar/ hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas 'og min na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas phyi nang gsang gsum gyis mchod cing thugs mnyes thugs rgyud bskul nas mdun gyi nam mkhar rigs lnga yab yum gyi rnam par byon te sbyor ba mdzad pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi chu rgyun rta mgrin gyi zhal du bzhugs/ sgal tshigs kyi rta brgyud srog dag pa'i lam nas byung rdo rje nas yum bzhi'i khar byang sems dus gcig la babs pas rta mgrin yum bzhi dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas 'og gi bdud rtsi la thim pas bdud rtsi dam ye dbyer med du 'dres nas 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis gtor ma dang mchod rdzas rnams la gtor te/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi shūddhe hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas bsangs/ rang dang sgrub grogs la gtor te/ oṃ dharma a mṛ ta hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas nyams grib sbyangs/ g.yas nas g.yon du gtor te/ oṃ raṃ kro dha sogs dang raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ zhes brjod pas khro bo mtshon cha thogs pas bgegs bskrad/ g.yon nas g.yas su gtor te sngags de nyid brjod pas khro bo'i gur khang du gyur pa bsam mo/ /gtor ma byin brlabs ni rdo rje gsor zhing / oṃ raṃ kro dha nas/ skyon thams cad dag par byas/ bar gong bzhin/ bhrūm̐ padma ba liṃ ta bi shwa tsakra bhrūm̐/ ma surya maṇḍa la/ hūm̐ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ gtor ma'i steng du nyi gdan la hūm̐/ paṃ padma maṇḍal/ āḥs ma ya satwaṃ/ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ de'i steng du padma'i gdan la āḥ a tsaṇḍa maṇḍal/ oṃ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ de'i steng du zla ba'i gdan la oṃ las gzugs ma dkar mo me long / sgra ma sngon mo pi waṃ/ dri ma ser mo dung chos/

ro ma dmar mo zhal zas/ reg ma ljang gu pañtsa li ka'i gos rdor gong can/ chos ma mthing kha chos 'byung 'dzin pa rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa rnams 'phro bas sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad gang bar gyur/ ces dang / oṃ mahā ba liṃ ta pū dza te dzwa hūm̐/ zhes pa bdun brjod/ slar rdo rje gsor zhing / oṃ raṃ/ nas/ skyon thams cad dag par byas/ /bar gong bzhin/ bhrūm̐ bandha sha ka ma surya maṇḍal/ ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ snod thod pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du rakta'i rgya mtsho dmar nag dbyibs zlum po stong gsum khengs pa/ phyogs bzhir rba rlabs bsnol bar 'khrug pa/ zhing chen gyi rdzu 'phrul ba/ zhing chung gi gnas 'phyo ba/ tshil chen gyi dar chags pa/ dngas ma 'dod yon gyi lha mo/ khu mar rakta'i rgya mtsho/ rtsigs ma dgra bgegs kyi sha rus las byas pa/ de yang phyi ltar na khrag nang ltar na chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ gsang ba ltar na yum gyi padma rakta chos thams cad kyi 'byung gnas su gyur/ oṃ mahā rakta hūm̐/ zhes lan bdun brjod do// ༈ //gnyis pa sa lha ni/ las kyi rdo rjes gtor ma la chab bran cing spos dang mar me sbar/ ngag tu/ oṃ raṃ kro dha rakṣa badzra dzwa la raṃ/ tig na bi shwa dzwa la raṃ/ phaṭa raṃ raṃ/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ laṃ las sa'i lha mo ser mo gser gyi mdog can/ phyag gnyis kyis gser gyi bum pa thugs kar stod de 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs dang / dar sna tshogs kyi lhab lhub kyis klubs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas sa 'og nas bdag gis bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ pri thi wi de wi badzra sa mā dzaḥ spos rdor bcom dril gdangs dang bcas pas/

hūm̐/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs lha mo che/ /'gro ba rnams kyi don slad du/ /'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol/ /zhes dang / oṃ pri thi wi de wi e hye hiḥ bha ga wan ma hā ka ru ṇi ka tri sha hoḥ sa ma ya dzaḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ dgug gzhug gis phyag rgya rnams kyai rdor sogs ma rgyud spyi 'gre bzhin/ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badzra pa sha hūm̐/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badzra gaṇḍe hoḥ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga badzra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ hūm̐ oṃ swā āḥhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /de bzhin du/ bdug spos/ me tog mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo 'di/ sa yi lha mo nyid la 'bul/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ pri thi wi de wi arghaṃ pra tiñtsa pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ dhūṣpaṃ/ puṣpeṃ/ ā lo kaṃ gandhaṃ/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shapda āḥhūm̐/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ bhrūm̐/ lan gcig oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum/ gtor ma zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ g.yas mchod sbyin gyi phyag rgya/ oṃ pri thi wi de wi sa pa ri wā ra a ka ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇaṃ adya nutpanna tota oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'bru bcud ma lus zas mchog gtor ma la/ /gser dngul la sogs rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'di/ /sa yi lha mo 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /zhes pas gtor ma phul/ ngag tu/ sa yi lha mo sangs rgyas can/ /gser mdog rin chen bum pa bsnams/

/rin chen rgyan dang mtshan dpes spras/ /sa 'og gtso mo khyod la bstod/ /ces pas brjod/ spos rdor dril/ ngag tu/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par du/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /khro rgyal padma dbang chen gyis/ /sa 'dir dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /las kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes mkhyen gsol lan gsum/ badzra muḥ sa'i lha mo sa der thim nas dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i grogs mdzad par gyur/ sman raka gtor ma mchod pa sa lha'i tshom bu sogs der bshams pa thams cad bsdus la dkyil 'khor 'bri sa'i sa de stong par bzhag chos nyid kyi sbyang ba ni/ oṃ shu n+yā ta dzñā na badzra swa bha wa ātma ko3haṃ/ sa dang dngos por 'dzin pa stong par gyur/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya gdab pa'i tshul dang / oṃ ha na ha na kroddha hūm̐ phaṭa/ sa phyogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ rakta'i thod pa thogs la/ ngag tu/ ka pā la tsakra bi sha bhrūm̐/ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ lan gcig rakta tiṣṭha badzra maṇḍa la hūm̐/ lan gsum/ hūm̐/ zla gam dmar po dbang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /rakta chags pa rdzas kyi byugs byas pas/ /srid gsum dbang sdud dmar gyi go ma g.yel/ /dbang gi rgyal po 'khor bcas bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ma'i thugs ka nas/ /bskal pa'i chu bo'i rgyun ltar dbab par bya/ /rakta sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes pas lha gnas rnams su rakta byugs/ bdud rtsi thogs la/ ngag tu/ dri chen dri chu maṃ sa rakta dang / /byang sems dkar dmar la sogs bdud rtsi lnga/ /nyon mongs dug lnga ye shes lnga sbyang phyir/ /yang gsang khros pa'i dkyil 'khor chag chag 'debs/ /dbang chen 'khor bcas bzhugs pa'i gzhal yas su/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs/ /mahā pañtsa a mri ta ma mā ki maṇḍa la hūm̐/ zhes pas lha gnas rnams su bdud rtsi byug go /gsum pa thig tshon byin rlabs ni/

dbus su sngon po la hūm̐/ shar du dkar po la oṃ/ lhor ser po la swā/ nub tu dmar po la āḥ byang du ljang gu la hā bris pa dang / gzhon nu ma'i padma'i zhus pa'am/ dur khrod kyi ras skud kha dog lnga bsgyur ba lo bcu drug mas bkal ba mtshon so so'i steng du bzhag de rnams dkyil 'khor gyi steng ngam slob dpon gyi mdun du cog rtse ras la sogs pa'i steng du phyogs ma nor bar bkod/ de rnams kyi mdun du mchod pa lnga gtor ma dang bcas pa bshams la/ ngag tu/ raṃ kro dhas bsangs/ swa bhā was thig tshon rnams mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ oṃ swā āḥhā/ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ tshur 'dus sa bon rnams la thim/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ rin chen/ padma/ ral gri rnams su gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su badzra he ru ka sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ shar du buddha he ru ka dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ lhor ratna he ru ka ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ nub tu padma he ru ka dmar po padma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ byang du karma he ru ka ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum dang bcas pa rnams su gyur/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas he ru ka rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med du gyur/ slar yang hūm̐ las 'od 'phros dbang gi lha he ru ka rigs lnga badzra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di rnams la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ hūm̐ oṃ swā āḥhā/ oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lus pa las/

he ru ka rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ arghaṃ la sogs pas phyi mchod dang / mahā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha hi/ bdud rtsi'i mchod pa/ mahā ba liṃ ta khā hi/ gtor ma'i mchod pa/ mahā rakta khā hi/ rakta'i mchod pa/ dril bu bsil zhing / chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang / /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga khro rgyal lnga la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/ rigs lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i thig tshon so so'i rnam pa can du gyur/ oṃ pañtsa ratna sa ma ya hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes dang mtheb srin gyis bsdud la sngags kha yar brjod/ tshon lnga'i ngo bo las gzhal yas khang snang rung du gyur par bsam mo/ /rgyas par na/ rta mgrin gyi sku mdog dang mthun pa'i phod ka rdor gong / rus rgyan/ sna thur/ dgos na skra tshab/ zhwa nag zhwa theb/ ban phur thogs la rnga rol dang bcas pas/ sa gzhi 'khod snyoms nas rgya gram dal 'gros kyis gar ram/ de las kyang spro na rta mgrin gyi rtsa 'cham byas la ye thig 'debs par gsungs kyang / deng sang phyag len phal cher la mi mdzad/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi nub nas shar du blta ba dang / slob ma shar nas nub tu blta ba la/ thig 'debs par bskul ba ni/ slob dpon dbang chen du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas thig g.yog gar gyi dbang phyug ma cig byung bar bsam ste/ ngag tu/ oṃ badzra kro ti shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod la dbus kyi srad bu'i thig sna gtad de/ rgyas par spro na/ hūm̐/ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na/ /dbus phyogs stong gi 'jig rten na/ /bcom ldan badzra he ru ka /mthing nag khro bos bar snang gang / /gzi brjid 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ /sprul pa'i khro bo sprin ltar 'thibs/ /yang sprul khro chung char ltar babs/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes shar/ /zhe sdang ma spang rang sar grol/ /zhe sdang dngos po sbyang ba'i phyir/

/thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ badzra ma ti pra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod la shar gyi srad bu'i sna sogs rim pa bzhin gtad de/ stong gsum stong gi sogs kyi mjug tu/ shar phyogs/ 'gre/ bcom ldan buddha༞ /smug nag༞ /gzi brjid༞ /sprul pa༞ /yang sprul༞ /me long lta bu'i༞ /gti mug༞ /gti mug༞ /sku'i༞ /buddha ma ti pra ma oṃ/ /de bzhin du/ stong gsum༞ /lho༞ /bcom ldan ratna༞ /ser nag༞ /gzi brjid༞ /sprul pa༞ /yang sprul༞ /mnyam nyid༞ /nga rgyal༞ /nga rgyal༞ /yon tan༞ /ratna ma ti pra ma swā/ /nub༞ /bcom ldan padma༞ /dmar nag༞ /gzi brjid༞ /sprul pa༞ /yang sprul༞ /so sor༞ /'dod chags༞ /'dod chags༞ /gsung༞ /padma ma ti pra ma āḥ /byang༞ /karma༞ /ljang༞ /gzi brjid༞ /sprul༞ /yang sprul༞ /bya grub༞ /phrag dog༞ /phrag dog༞ /'phrin las dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /karma ma ti pra ma hā/ zhes brjod/ 'di'i dgongs pa thig skud re re 'og nas 'byung ba ltar ye thig tshar re 'debs pa'i dbang du lags/ bsdu na/ lhan cig bsgril ba'i thig dkyil nas slob dpon gyi lag pa g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis steng nas bzung la gcus te yar gdab cing / ngag tu/ ston mchog dpa' bo dgongs su gsol/ /rdo rje'i thig skud sgra ldan pas/ /nam mkhar dkyil 'khor gsal btab cing / /'gro ba'i don la bskul bar mdzod/ /oṃ badzra sa ma ya su tra ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod la/ zur la yang gdab pas tshang thig dang po/ slob dpon byang bstan dang / slob ma lhor bltas pas tshang thig gnyis pa dang / slob ma byang shar dang / slob dpon shar lhor gnas pas shar gyi log thig slob dpon nub byang dang / slob ma lho nub tu gnas pas nub kyi log thig dang / slob dpon de nyid la slob ma byang shar du song pas byang gi log thig slob dpon shar lhor dang slob ma lho nub tu gnas pas lho'i log thig slob dpon de nyid slob ma nub byang du gnas pas zur thig dang po/

slob dpon lho nub dang slob ma byang shar du gnas pas zur thig gnyis pa rnams skor zhing / rgyab ma sprad par/ slob dpon byang shar dang slob ma shar lhor mi 'gro bar tshang thig dang po ltar steng 'og kun la gcus te gdab/ thig gi ye shes pa la gong bzhin mchod bstod byas la/ oṃ u tiṣṭha/ zhes brjod cing / lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur kha gyen du bstan pas mthe'u chung gnyis sbrel mdzub mo gnyis rtse sbyar la smin mtshams kyi thad der 'degs pa'i tshul du byas/ ye shes kyi thig nam mkhar bteg ā li kā li/ brjod nas/ srad bu rdo rje la dkris te yab kyi thugs kar bsdu'o/ /tshon 'gyed pa ni/ byang shar na bgegs kyi rgyal po dbang ldan gnas pas de 'dul ba'i phyir/ slob dpon gyis byang shar mtshams nas rtsig pa nang nas rim pa bzhin dmar/ dkar/ ser/ ljang / sngo rnams 'bri ba ni 'phrin gzhung dang mthun zhing / dbang chur/ nag ljang / ser/ dkar/ dmar ba bshad pas gang ltar re kha mdzub gang pa re drangs la/ de bandhas kha bcad/ steng du rdo rje'am be con gyis mnan nas/ rtsig pa sbrel ran pa dang / kha bsal te bltas la ma chad pa 'dres pa bzang / chad 'dres nor pa sogs byung na ngan pas drag rol bya zhing / ngag tu/ raṃ kro dha sogs kyis bgegs bskrad do/ /mtshan ma 'god pa ni/ dbus su dbang chen lnga mtshon pa'i phyir/ tshon sngo/ ljang / ser/ dkar/ dmar ba rnams rim pa bzhin bzhugs/ dbus su dmar nag gru gsum gdan nyi zla'i steng du phyag mtshan nam hrīḥl sogs pa bris/ de'i phyi rol tu 'og nag po la thod pa'i phreng ba zlum po dkar po/ de'i phyi rol tu 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi phyogs mdog la hūm̐ phyogs mdog can re'am/ rdo rje dkar/ rin chen sngo/ padma dmar/ ral gri ljang gu rnams bris/ rtsibs mtshan phyogs mdog gam gang mdzes/ de'i phyi rol tu nang thod rlon/ phyi thod skam gnyis ka kha phyir bstan gyi ras zlum po/

de'i phyi rol tu gru chad sgo dang bcas pa/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / sgo bzhir sgo ba bzhi mtshan ma zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du lcags kyu zhags pa/ lcags sgrog dril bu'am/ yang na dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rnams bris tshar ba dang / oṃ mahā padma shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ/ la sogs pas mchod cing rol mo bya/ mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ mahā ba liṃ ta khā haṃ/ mahā rakta khā hi/ dril bu bsil zhing / chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang / /sogs kyis bstod/ pha gu ser po 'dod yon dmar po la lha mo'i mtshan ma/ drwa phyed gzhi nag po la dkar po sogs kyis dkrol ci mdzes/ shar bu sngon po la dkar po'i za ra tshags/ mda' yab padma phyed pa'i dbyibs can/ rta babs ka ba phyogs mdog bang rim ci mdzes/ chos 'khor ri dwags ser po/ padma'i tshogs/ dur khrod kyi sa gzhi/ me ri kha dog sna tshogs dang bcas pa mthong ba rgyud pa'i phyag len bzhin 'bri'o/ /tshon btab pa'i ye shes pa la/ ngag tu/ oṃ mahā padma shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod la rol mo bya/ mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ mahā ba liṃ ta khā hi/ mahā rakta khā hi/ dril bu bsil zhing / chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang / /zhes sogs kyis bstod la/ tshon lhag ma'i ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su badzra muḥ nam mkha'i thig ye shes pa bstim pa ni/ rdo rje gsor zhing drag rol dang / oṃ raṃ kroddha/ sogs/ ngag tu/ nam mkha'i thig gi ye shes pa rnams dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badzra pa sha hūm̐/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badzra gaṇḍe hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes nyer gcig gam bdun la sogs par ci rigs pa brjod pa'i mthar/ ngag tu/ gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod// ༈ //bzhi pa mchod pa lhag gnas ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su mañdzi'i steng du/ bum pa bcu'am gnyis 'og nas bshad pa ltar bgegs skrod grub nas 'jog

dkyil 'khor gyi mdun na phar g.yas nas rim bzhin bdud rtsi/ gtor ma/ rakta rnams bshams/ phyi mchod rnams byang shar nas brtsams te gong bzhin bshams la/ ngag tu/ 'khor ba yongs su dag pa thugs rje'i rgyun/ /tshul khrims go cha chen po brjid pa'i mchog /mi ldog byang chub sems kyi g.yang gzhi 'di/ /'khor ba spang phyir rgyan gyi bla re bkram/ /sa ma ya tiṣṭha badzra/ yol ba dang bla bre la sogs pa phul/ mchod pa rnams la dmigs te/ bde stong dbyer med bandha'i rdzas mchog dang / /ye shes rang gsal mtshon pa mar me dang / /ra sa ya na 'chi med bdud rtsi dang / /'dod yon lnga ldan dpal gyi gtor chen dang / /rjes su chags pa yum gyi rakta dang / /dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i yo byad rgya mtsho rnams/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol ba'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor 'di yi rgyan du 'bul bar bya/ /sa ma ya tiṣṭha badzra/ mda' brgyad/ oṃ raṃ kro dhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ mda' brgyad mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ ind+ra ye swā hā/ shar du dbang po dkar po mig stong dang ldan pa/ glang po che la bzhon pa rdo rjes mtshan pa'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ oṃ sa ma ye swā hā/ lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he la bzhon pa be con 'dzin pa/ oṃ wa ru ṇa ye swā hā/ nub tu chu lha dkar po chu srin la bzhon pa sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ oṃ ku be ra ye swā hā/ byang du gnod sbyin ser po rta la bzhon pa ne'u le 'dzin pa/ oṃ i shwa ra ye swā hā/ byang shar du dbang ldan dkar po khyu mchog la bzhon pa rtse gsum dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ oṃ agna ye swā hā/ shar lhor me lha dmar po ra skyes la bzhon pa/ me thab dang bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ oṃ ni ri ti ye swā hā/ lho nub tu srin po nag po ro langs la bzhon pa ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ oṃ ba ya bhe swā hā/ nub byang du rlung lha ljang sngon sha ba bzhon pa rlung dar 'dzin pa/

de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐ badzra he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rdo rje sems dpa' dbang chen gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du ma nor ba btsugs la/ mda' brgyad dag la mnga' gsol bas/ /phyogs skyong brgyad du byin gyis brlabs/ /bgegs tshogs rnams ni bsrung bya'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor 'di yi rgyan du bzhugs/ /oṃ iṇḍa ye tiṣṭha badzra/ oṃ ya ma ye༞ oṃ wa ru ṇa ye༞ oṃ ku bhe ra ye༞ oṃ i shwa ra ye༞ oṃ agha ye༞ oṃ ni ri ti ye༞ oṃ ba ya bhe tiṣṭha badzra/ phyogs bzhi'i mda' la phyogs mdog dang mtshams bzhi'i mda' la byang shar nas nub byang gyi bar la dkar ser dmar ljang gi dar dang / me long re btags la/ oṃ raṃ kro tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ dar brgyad mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ shar du hūm̐ las sgeg mo ma dkar mo phyag gnyis snyems pa'i tshul gyis rdo rje 'dzin pa/ lhor traṃ las phreng ba ma ser mo phreng ba 'dzin pa/ nub tu hrīḥlas glu ma dmar mo pi waṃ 'dzin pa/ byang du a las gar ma ljang khu gar bsgyur ba/ byang shar du hūm̐ las bdug spos ma dkar mo spos khang 'dzin pa/ shar lhor traṃ las me tog ma ser mo me tog 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu hrī las mar me ma dmar skya mar me'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ nub byang du a las dri chab ma ljang khu dri'i dung chos 'dzin pa rnams su gyur/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐ badzra he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rdo rje sems dpa' dbang chen gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ dar brgyad dag la mnga' gsol bas/ /lha mo brgyad du byin gyis brlabs/

/lha tshogs thams cad mchod pa'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor 'di yi rgyan du bzhugs/ /oṃ lā sya tiṣṭha badzra/ oṃ mā le༞ oṃ gīrt+ti༞ oṃ nirti༞ oṃ dhuṣpaṃ༞ oṃ puṣpaṃ༞ oṃ ā lo kaṃ༞ oṃ gandhaṃ tiṣṭha badzra/ tshon skud lnga/ oṃ raṃ kro ddhas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ oṃ swā ā hā rnams las 'od zer 'phros 'dus 'od du zhu ba las tshon skud sngon po hūm̐ las chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ dkar po oṃ las me long lta bu'i ye shes/ ser po swā las mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ dmar po ā las so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ ljang khu hā las bya ba grub pa'i ye shes rnams su gyur/ oṃ pañtsa dzñā na sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ tshon lnga dag la mnga' gsol bas/ /ye shes lnga ru byin gyis brlabs/ /ye shes lnga po thob bya'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor rgyan du bzhugs su gsol/ /mahā pañtsa dzñā na sa ma ya tiṣṭha badzra/ zhes tshon skud byang shar gyi mda' rtser dkris la/ shar gyi rtse/ shar lho'i rtsa ba/ lho'i rtse/ lho nub kyi rtsa ba/ nub kyi rtse/ nub byang gi rtsa ba/ byang gi rtse/ byang shar gyi rtsa ba/ de nas yar dkris nas/ byang shar gyi rtse/ shar gyi rtsa ba/ shar lho'i rtse/ lho'i rtsa ba/ lho nub kyi rtse/ nub kyi rtsa ba/ nub byang gi rtse/ byang gi rtsa ba/ byang shar gyi rtse/ de rnams g.yas bskor du phyogs bzhi'i rtser dkris/ shar lho nas byang shar gyi bar du mtshams bzhir rtser dkris pas steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rtsibs brgyad du 'byung ba ni mchod pa'i yo byad sta gon no/ /lnga pa bum pa sta gon ni/ gong du bshad pa'i bum pa/ oṃ raṃ kro ddhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ rdor dril hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas bzung la/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi༞

chos kyi༞ dge 'dun gyi༞ bcom ldan 'das padma dbang chen khrag 'thung lha dgu 'khor za byed bka' nyan gyi tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi༞ rnal 'byor pa bdag gi sngags dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyi byin rlabs dang / chos nyid rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing / chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyis/ bla ma lha'i gzhal yas khang du bskyed pa la mi phan cing gnod par sems pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig oṃ raṃ kro dha sogs brjod/ drag rol dang / gu gul gyi dud pas bdug cing / yungs kar gyis brabs la/ bum pa bcu'am gnyis su gong gi chu dang bum rdzas rnams blug ste/ bcu'i dbang du byas na/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus dang lha gnas rnams su mañdzi'i steng du dbus su gtso bo'i bum pa/ 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs steng du rdo rje dbang chen gyi bum pa/ lhor rin chen༞ nub tu padma༞ byang du phrin las༞ shar lhor lcags kyu ma༞ lho sgor zhags pa ma༞ nub sgor lcags sgrog ma༞ byang sgor dril bu ma༞ las bum gzhal yas khang gi byang shar gyi grwar bzhag bum pa gnyis su byas na/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su mañdzi'i steng du rnam rgyal bum pa dang / byang shar du las bum bzhag ste/ kha rgyan gseb tu pad 'dab bam/ dung chos dri chus bkang pa/ rdo rje gzungs thag dang bcas pa bzhag bum pa de rnams rdo rje gzungs thag gis sbrel te slob dpon gyis bzung bar bsam la/ oṃ raṃ kro dhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros bum pa gnyis la phog pas/ bum pa gnyis mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi steng du/ bhrūm̐ bhrūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i bum pa gnyis rtsa ba nag po ra ris med pa/ lto ba ldir zhing zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa phra zhing kha yel ba lha'i gos kyi mgul pa bcings shing /

dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan pa/ phyi bum pa'i rnam pa la/ nang dbang chen gyi gzhal yas khang du gyur pa ni/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ dbus dmar nag gru gsum zla gam dmar po gsum dang thod skam gyi rwa bas bskor ba de'i phyir 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa/ thod pa skam rlon gyi rtsig pa gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol du dur khrod rdo rje'i rwa ba me ris dang bcas pa phyi gsal nang gsal ye shes kyi snang ba can du gyur pa'i dbus dang / phyogs bzhi 'khor lo'i steng du/ paṃ padma maṇḍal/ paṃ las sna tshogs padma'i gdan/ a tsaṇḍa maṇḍal/ a las zla ba'i gdan/ ma surya maṇḍal/ ma las nyi ma'i gdan/ ru tra baṃ/ ru tra pho mo byi chings su bsnol ba'i gdan shar gyi rtsibs steng du/ dhe ba baṃ/ dri za dkar po pho mo byi chings su bsnol ba'i gdan/ lho'i rtsibs steng du/ ya ma baṃ/ grul bum sngon po pho mo byi chings su bsnol ba'i gdan/ nub kyi rtsibs steng du/ nā ga baṃ/ klu rgyal dmar po pho mo byi chings su bsnol ba'i gdan/ byang gi rtsibs steng du/ yakṣa baṃ/ gnod sbyin ljang khu pho mo byi chings su bsnol ba'i gdan/ sgo bzhir a tsaṇḍa maṇḍal/ bzhi brjod/ zla ba'i gdan re re dang ldan par gyur/ ye shes 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi gnas chen po/ /'khor lo dbang chen pho brang ldan/ /phyi nang med pa yongs su gsal/ /lha bskyed pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi hūm̐ mthing nag de/ hri dmar nag gcig dang / maṃ sngon mo gcig tu gyur/ hrīḥmaṃ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ 'od zer phar 'phros rgyal ba rnams la phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa phul/ sems can thams cad kyi las nyon gyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ padma dbang chen gyi go 'phang la bkod/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ slar 'dus hrīḥdang maṃ la thim/ tiṣṭha badzra/ hrīḥ badzra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/

padma dbang chen sku mdog dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ zhal g.yas dkar/ g.yon ljang / dbus dmar nag gru gsum/ zhal bgrad pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ khro gnyer bsdus pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'khyil ba'i spyi gtsug na rta mgo ljang khu zhur dkar po/ phuṃ phuṃ ser po/ rngog ma leb rgan/ dbang gi rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog pa dang bcas pa/ phyag dang po gnyis na padma dang bandha/ bar pa gnyis na lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ tha ma gnyis na be con dang ral gri/ sku stod la zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi dang glang chen gyi ko rlon gsol ba/ sku smad la stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ thod pa skam po lngas dbur brgyan cing / tshal bus dpung rgyan/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu tshar gsum gyis do shal 'phyang ba/ sbrul dkar pos dbu brgyan/ ser pos snyan cha/ dmar pos mgur chu/ nag pos lhu tshigs/ ljang khus ga shal dang ske rags byas pa/ thugs kar zhag gi zo ris/ 'bur gsum du rakta'i thig le/ dpral bar thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/ mdor na dpal gyi chas brgyad dang / dur khrod kyi rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje'i gshog pa can/ zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum gyi tshul gyis ru tra mnan pa/ oṃ mahā kro dhi shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ de'i dpang du yum padma gar gyi dbang phyug ma sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ zhal bgrad pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ khro gnyer bsdus pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ral pa nag po mun ltar du gtibs pa/ phyag g.yas tsitta thogs nas yab la 'khyud cing / g.yon pa dung chen dmar 'khyil gtso bo la stobs pa/ thod pa skam po lngas dbur brgyan cing / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon bskum pas yab la 'khyud cing /

g.yas pa yab dang mnyam du brkyang pa/ dur khrod kyi rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ yab yum gnyis ka ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa/ yab yum gyi thugs ka'i hrīḥdang maṃḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ 'og min na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas la phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa phul/ thugs mnyes/ thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ mdun gyi nam mkhar khrag 'thung rigs lnga yab yum gyi rnam par byon/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lnga'i zhal nas/ hūm̐ badzra he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ buddha he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ swā ratna he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa swā/ ā padma he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā/ hā karma he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hā/ zhes gsungs shing rigs lnga yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pas byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun/ rta mgrin yab yum gyi spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ sku'i nang gang / dri ma dag dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ dbus gnas lngar bandha ka pā la/ bhrūm̐ bhrūm̐ bhrūm̐ bhrūm̐ bhrūm̐/ thod pa'i khang bu lnga dang ldan pa'i nang du/ spyi bor badzra he ru ka sngon po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ dpral bar buddha he ru ka dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rna ltag g.yas su ratna he ru ka ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ ltag par padma he ru ka dmar po padma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rna ltag g.yon du karma he ru ka ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i khrag 'thung rigs lnga tshon gang pa res dbu brgyan par gyur/ spyi bor a tsaṇḍa maṇḍal oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par paṃ padma maṇḍal āḥdamar po/ thugs kar ma surya maṇḍal hūm̐ sngon po/ hūm̐ paṃ/ yab kyi gsang ba'i gnas mi dmigs pa las/ hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ badzra/

yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs pa las/ paṃ las padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru la as mtshan pa/ e aṃ/ a nu ra ko ya haṃ/ a nu ra ko ya mi/ bo ddhi tsitta siddhi ku ru hūm̐/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas bde ba'i sgras/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pas/ thig le rnams yig 'bru brgyad du gyur/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badzra shwa ri kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ shar gyi rtsibs steng du dri za'i gdan la/ rdo rje dbang chen dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa phyag g.yas rdo rje dang / g.yon dbyug tho 'dzin pa/ oṃ ratna shwa ri kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ lho'i rtsibs steng du grul bum gyi gdan la/ rin chen dbang chen sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rin po che dang / g.yon lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ oṃ padma shwa ri kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ nub kyi rtsibs steng du klu rgyal gyi gdan la/ padma dbang chen dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas padma dang g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa/ oṃ karma shwa ri kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang gi rtsibs steng du gnod sbyin gyi gdan la/ las rab dbang chen ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ral gri dang / g.yon kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang zhal bgrad pa mche ba gtsigs pa/ khro gnyer bsdus pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'khyil ba/ sbrul gyis bcings pa/ dpal gyi chas brgyad dang / dur khrod kyi rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gyis bzhugs pa/ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥshar sgo'i zla gdan la/ rdo rje lcags kyu ma dkar mo khrag gi ral pa can g.yas lcags kyu/ oṃ badzra pa sha hūm̐/ lho sgo'i zla gdan la rdo rje zhags pa ma ser mo g.yu'i ral pa can/

g.yas zhags pa/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ nub sgo'i zla gdan la/ rdo rje lcags sgrog ma dmar mo mthing nag gi ral pa can/ g.yas lcags sgrog oṃ badzra gaṇḍe hoḥ byang sgo'i zla gdan la rdo rje dril bu ma ljang khu gser gyi ral pa can/ g.yas dril bu g.yon thams cad tsitta bsnams pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ zhal bgrad pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ khro gnyer bsdus pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ dur khrod kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gyis bzhengs pa/ las thams cad pa'i bum par paṃ padma maṇḍal la/ a tsaṇḍa maṇḍal la/ mahā surya maṇḍal la/ ru tra baṃ/ hrīḥspha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ hrīḥbadzra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ bcom ldan 'das padma dbang chen sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas tsandan gyi be con nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon sdigs mdzub bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba/ spyi gtsug na rta mgo ljang khu rta skad 'tsher ba/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad dang / khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje'i gshogs pa can/ mi mgo skam po'i dbu rgyan dang / khro bo'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim hūm̐ badzra he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ badzra he ru kas dbu brgyan par gyur/ gdan gting sku bskyed dbang bskur zhing / /byin gyis brlabs pa rab tu bya/ /yab yum gnyis med sbyor ba las/ /sprul pa'i khro bo rab tu gsal/ /bdag mdun gnyis kyi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros nub phyogs o ḍyan padma dbang gi gzhal yas nas/ bcom ldan 'das padma dbang chen khrag 'thung lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor las bum gyi lha dang bcas pa la za byed bka' nyan gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba badzra sa mā dzaḥ rnga brdung zhing dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/

dril bu bcad gtub tu dkrol la/ hrīḥ chos kyi dbyings las sku bzhengs pa/ /dbang chen khros pa'i rgyal po bzhengs/ /dbus nyid ye shes gzhal yas nas/ /padma rta mchog gshegs su gsol/ /mkha' dbyings yum gyi gzhal yas nas/ /yum chen khro mo gshegs su gsol/ /phyogs bzhi 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng nas/ /sprul pa'i khro bo gshegs su gsol/ /sgo bzhi gnas kyi gzhal yas nas/ /sgo ma bzhi rnams gshegs su gsol/ /dur khrod chen po'i gnas mchog nas/ /dbang chen bran g.yog gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ e hye hi/ bha ga wan mahā ka ru ṇi ka tri sha hoḥ sa ma ya dzaḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ hrīḥ dpal chen khro bo mi bzad pa/ /rta mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khro mo yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khro rgyal bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgo bsrung bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /a ti pu hoḥ pra ti dza hoḥ hrīḥ dam tshig dbang gi dkyil 'khor 'di/ /ye shes dbang chen dkyil 'khor mchog /pho brang dam tshig dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /dges shing rtag par bzhugs su gsol/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ hrīḥ mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog dang / /bdug spos snang gsal zhugs rtogs sgra/ /zhal zas dri chab 'di rnams kyang / /padma dbang chen dkyil 'khor la/ /mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ mahā padma shwa ra sa pa ri wa ra arghaṃ/ pādyaṃ/ dhūṣpaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ a lo kaṃ gandhaṃ/ nai wi daṃ/ shapda āḥhūm̐/ padma dbang chen khrag 'thung lha dgu dpa' bo gcig pa dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ mahā padma shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra mahā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ mahā ba liṃ ta khā hi/ mahā rakta khā hi/ rnga brdungs shing dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ dril bu shlau ka re'i mtshams su bsil zhing / hrīḥ 'od gsal dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /zag med bde chen rnam 'phrul sku/ /sna tshogs sprul pa'i skur bstan pa'i/ /rta mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spros pa kun las rnam grol yang / /chags chen chags pa 'dul ba'i phyir/

/bud med rgyu ma'i tshul 'dzin pa/ /khro mo yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zag bcas phung po gnas gyur cing / /nyon mongs rnam dag ye shes sku/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi rdzogs mdzad pa/ /khro rgyal bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag chad bdag mtshan rnam dag cing / /bsdu dngos tshad med bzhi yi dngos/ /dgug gzhug bcings shing dbang mdzad pa/ /sgo ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bgegs dang log 'dren kun skrod cing / /bdag gnas rnal 'byor bar chad bsrung / /dngos grub thams cad stsol ba'i lha/ /las kyi rta mgrin phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdug pa can rnams 'dul ba'i phyir/ /rab khros rngams shing mi zad pa/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa yis/ /bka' bstod rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis rnam dag cing / /byang chub phyogs chos rang bzhin can/ /bde chen snying po yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /gzhal med khang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis med ye shes rdo rje yis/ /sa gzhi rwa ba bla re gur/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba can/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lor phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod la bstod pa'i dge ba des/ /lam gyi bar chad gegs bsal nas/ /tshe 'dir tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs te/ /sku bzhi'i bdag nyid thob par shog /bum nang gi lha rnams kyi thugs kar padma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar lha rang rang gi sa bon gyi phyi rol du/ rang rang gi snying pos bskor ba klog pa'i tshul gyis bzlas pas sku'i cha shas nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'od zer dmar po'i rnam pa can babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ lha dgu so so'i sngags dang las bum du slar yang / hrīḥbadzra kro ta dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ sngags de rnams brgya 'am/ tha na'ang nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa ci rigs pa bzlas mthar thal mo sbyar te/ ngag tu/ bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgongs su gsol/ /bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis/ /bag med tshul gyis dam la 'gal gyur na/
