/padma dbang chen dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi/ /thugs dang 'gal ba'i las rnams ci bgyis pa/ /thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol/ /bzod par gsol lo tshangs pa stsal du gsol/ /tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ hrīḥ mchod yon nas/ sku bzhi'i bdag nyid thob par shog /bar gong bzhin mchod cing bstod/ dung chos dang rdor gzungs bsdu mi dgos/ bum pa la mnga' gsol zhing zhugs su gsol ba ni/ ngag tu/ bum pa dbang chen gzhal yas su/ /byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyis/ /dbang bskur sgrib pa sbyang ba'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor 'di yi rgyan du bzhugs/ /bhrūm̐ sa ma ya tiṣṭha badzra/ tshe dbang sgrub pa nas bzung / tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /bar 'og dngos gzhi nas 'byung ba bzhin/ rdo rje gzungs thag bsdus te/ lag pa g.yon pa'i gong du g.yas pa bsnol ba kha phyir bstan nas/ mtheb srin gnyis sbyar ba'i se gol gtogs/ ngag tu/ badzra muḥ bum nang gi ye shes pa gshegs/ dung chos kyi dri bzang po'i chu bum nang du blugs pas/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu bar gyur/ bsngo ba ni/ ngag tu/ dge ba 'di yis 'gro kun sems can rnams/ /zhes sogs nas bkra shis kyi bar 'og tu bshad pa bzhin bya'o/ /sta gon yongs su rdzogs pa bstan zin to// ༈ //ras bris ltar na sta gon mi dgos pa'i dkyil 'khor bkram la sman rag gtor gsum mchod yon sogs dkyil 'khor gyi nang du shong ba'am ma shong na dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du bsgrigs la bla ma sku gsum gyi gsol 'debs nas bzung dngos gzhi lo ka la btsan 'dzus byed do/ /gsum pa dngos gzhi la/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod/ dbang bskur ba/ 'jug gi cho ga dang gsum las/ dang po ni bum pa bcu dkyil 'khor la bkod na/ snod gcig tu dbus dang phyogs star pa ma 'dzol par bsdus la/ slob dpon gyi mdun cog steng du bshams pa'am/

phyag len phal cher la bum pa gnyis mdzad pas rnam rgyal dang las bum slob dpon gyi cog steng du bshams/ bum pa'i shul du sman raka gtor ma/ mar me/ mchod yon rnams bshams/ dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du tshe dbang gi chas dang / chos skyong gi gtor ma/ mtha'i mchod pa rnams gong bzhin bshams la sgrub pa po rnams gral la 'khod de/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /zhes pa nas bzung / mahā rakta hūm̐/ zhes pa'i mthar/ gong sta gon gyi skabs bzhin/ ting 'dzin rnam gsum bsgoms pa ni/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings nam mkha'i klong yangs nas/ /chos rnams sna tshogs rang shar ba/ /rang bzhin med de chu zla 'dra/ /thugs rje chen pos kun la khyab/ /snying po ye shes hūm̐ gi dbyibs/ /oṃ shu n+ya ta dzñā na sa ma ti hūm̐/ chos thams cad spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /oṃ dharmā ddha tu sa ma ti hūm̐/ chos thams cad ye shes rang gsal yin pa la/ de ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad snying re rje/ oṃ dzñā na badzra sa ma ti hūm̐/ de'i ngang las rang rig gi sa bon rgyu'i yi ge hūm̐ mthing nag gcig tu gyur/ de las e sngo skya/ yaṃ dud kha/ raṃ dmar po/ khaṃ dmar nag suṃ ser nag keṃ dkar po/ bhrūm̐ ljang khu rnams rim pa bzhin du chags chen po lnga yi snying po la/ 'byung ba lnga yi dngas ma chags/ gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni/ e a kā sha maṇḍal hūm̐/ e las nam mkha' sngo skya gru gsum es mtshan pa/ yaṃ karmā raksha maṇḍal hūm̐/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam dud kha yaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ raṃ dzwa la maṇḍal hūm̐/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ khaṃ rakta dzwa la maṇḍal hūm̐/ khaṃ las rakta'i rgya mtsho dmar nag zlum po khaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ suṃ sug rme maṇḍal hūm̐/ suṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi suṃ gyis mtshan pa/ keṃ ni ri tiṣṭha maṇḍal hūm̐/ keṃ las keng rus kyi ri rab dkar po gru bzhi pa keṃ gyis mtshan pa/

de dag kyang phyi ltar na 'byung ba lnga/ nang ltar na ye shes lnga/ gsang ba ltar na yum lnga'i mkha' klong rnam par dag pa'o/ /bhrūm̐ bhi sha bi shuddhe dzñā na tsakra maṇḍal hūm̐/ bhrūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las gzhal yas khang dbus dmar nag gru gsum/ zla gam dmar po gsum/ de'i phyi rol thod phreng dkar pos bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / rtsibs mchan mdzes tshon/ de'i phyi rol du thod pa skam rlon las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang / thod pa skam po'i rtsig gzhi/ nem phreng gi rtsig pa/ rlon pa'i bad byas pa/ maṃ sa'i zhal zas/ rakta'i sprin thabs/ drag po gnam lcags kyis gzer btab pa/ skra lcang lo'i kha bad can/ nyi zla gza' skar gyi mthong khung glo dkar dang bcas pa/ de'i phyi rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i dur khrod kyi gzhal yas khang pa/ gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin du dmar po/ dkar po/ ser po/ ljang khu/ nag po'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng na rin po che'i pha gu ser po las/ drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng na rin po che'i mda' yab dang pu shus bskor ba/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol na 'dod yon gyi snam bu la lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa/ nang thod skam gyi ka ba brgyad dang ldan zhing / thod rlon gyi ka gzhu yod pa/ steng padmas mtshan pas gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus byur bur gyur pa'i steng na padma'i tog gis mtshan pa/ sgo bzhi'i thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng na/ padma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang / gdugs dang ri dwags dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang gos dang / 'phan dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang / rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pa rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i phyi rol du dur khrod brgyad rdo rje'i rwa ba dang drwa ba me ri rab tu 'bar bas kun nas bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang du gyur/

dbus dmar nag gru gsum gyi steng na/ paṃ padma maṇḍal/ paṃ las sna tshogs padma'i gdan/ a tsaṇḍa maṇḍal/ a las zla ba'i gdan/ ma surya maṇḍal/ ma las nyi ma'i gdan/ ru tra baṃ/ ru tra pho mo byi chings su bsnol ba'i gdan shar gyi rtsibs steng du/ dhe ba baṃ/ dri za dkar po pho mo byi chings su bsnol ba'i gdan/ lho'i rtsibs steng du/ ya ma baṃ/ grul bum sngon po pho mo byi chings su bsnol ba'i gdan/ nub kyi rtsibs steng du/ na ga baṃ/ klu rgyal dmar po pho mo byi chings su bsnol ba'i gdan/ byang gi rtsibs steng du/ yakṣa baṃ/ gnod sbyin ljang khu pho mo byi chings su bsnom pa'i gdan/ sgo bzhir a tsaṇḍa maṇḍal/ bzhi brjod/ zla ba'i gdan re re dang ldan par gyur/ ye shes 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi gnas chen po/ /'khor lo dbang chen pho brang ldan/ /phyi nang med pa yongs su gsal/ /lha bskyed pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ rang gi rig pa'i rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi hūm̐ mthing nag de/ hrīḥdamar nag gcig dang / maṃ sngon mo gcig tu gyur/ hrīḥmaṃ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ 'od zer phar 'phros rgyal ba rnams la phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa phul/ sems can thams cad kyi las nyon gyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ padma dbang chen gyi go 'phang la bkod/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ slar 'dus hrīḥdang maṃ la thim/ tiṣṭha badzra/ hrīḥbadzra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ rang nyid padma dbang chen sku mdog dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ zhal g.yas dkar/ g.yon ljang / dbus dmar nag gru gsum/ zhal bgrad pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ khro gnyer bsdus pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'khyil ba'i spyi gtsug na rta mgo ljang khu zhur dkar po/ phuṃ phuṃ ser po/ rngog ma leb rgan/ dbang gi rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog pa dang bcas pa/

phyag dang po gnyis na padma dang bandha/ bar pa gnyis na lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ tha ma gnyis na be con dang ral gri/ sku stod la gzhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi dang glang chen gyi ko rlon gsol ba/ sku smad la stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ thod pa skam po lngas dbur brgyan cing / tshal bus dpung rgyan/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu tshar gsum gyi do shal 'phyang ba/ sbrul dkar pos dbur brgyan/ ser pos snyan cha/ dmar pos mgur chu/ nag pos lhu tshigs/ ljang khus ga shal dang ske rags byas pa/ thugs kar zhag gi zo ris/ 'bur gsum du rakta'i thig le/ dpral bar thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/ mdor na dpal gyi chas brgyad dang / dur khrod kyi rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje'i gshog pa can/ zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum gyi tshul gyis ru tra mnan pa/ oṃ mahā kro dhi shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ de'i pang du yum padma gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ zhal bgrad pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ khro gnyer bsdus pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ral pa nag po mun ltar du gtibs pa/ phyag g.yas tsitta thogs nas yab la 'khyud cing / g.yon pa dung chen dmar 'khyil gtso bo la stobs pa dang / thod pa skam po lngas dbur brgyan cing / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon bskum pas yab la 'khyud cing / g.yas pa yab dang mnyam du brkyang pa/ dur khrod kyi rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa yab yum gnyis ka ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa/ yab yum gyi thugs kha'i hrīḥdang maṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'og min na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa phul/ thugs mnyes/ thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ mdun gyi nam mkhar khrag 'thung rigs lnga yab yum gyi rnam par byon/

de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lnga'i zhal nas/ hūm̐ badzra he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ buddha he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ swā ratna he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa swā/ ā padma he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā/ hā padma he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hā/ zhes gsung zhing rigs lnga yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pas byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun/ rta mgrin yab yum gyi spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ sku'i nang gang / dri ma dag dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ dbus gnas lngar bandha ka pā la/ bhrūm̐ bhrūm̐ bhrūm̐ bhrūm̐ bhrūm̐/ thod pa'i khang bu lnga dang ldan pa'i nang du/ spyi bor badzra he ru ka sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dpral bar buddha he ru ka dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rna ltag g.yas su ratna he ru ka ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ ltag par padma he ru ka dmar po padma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rna ltag g.yon du karma he ru ka ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i khrag 'thung rigs lnga mtshon gang pa res dbur brgyan par gyur/ spyi bor a tsaṇḍa maṇḍal oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par paṃ padma maṇḍal āḥdamar po/ thugs kar ma surya maṇḍal hūm̐ sngon po/ hūm̐ paṃ/ yab kyi gsang ba'i gnas mi dmigs pa las/ hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ badzraḥ yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs pa las/ paṃ las padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru la es mtshan pa/ e aṃ a nu ra ko ya haṃ/ a nu ra ko ya mi/ bo dhi tsitta siddhi ku ru hūm̐/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs rgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pas thig le rnams yig 'bru brgyad du gyur/

hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badzra shwa ri kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ shar gyi rtsibs steng du dri za'i gdan la/ rdo rje dbang chen dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang / g.yon dbyug tho 'dzin pa/ oṃ ratna shwa ri kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ lho'i rtsibs steng du grul bum gyi gdan la/ rin chen dbang chen sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rin po che dang g.yon lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ oṃ padma shwa ri kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ nub kyi rtsibs steng du klu rgyal gyi gdan la/ padma dbang chen dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas padma dang g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa/ oṃ karma shwa ri kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang gi rtsibs steng du gnod byin gyi gdan la/ las rab dbang chen ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ral gri dang g.yon kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang zhal bgrad pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ khro gnyer bsdus pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'khyil ba sbrul gyis bcings pa/ dpal gyi chas brgyad dang / dur khrod kyi rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gyis bzhugs pa/ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ shar sgo'i zla gdan la/ rdo rje lcags kyu ma dkar mo khrag gi ral pa can g.yas lcags kyu/ oṃ badzra pa sha hūm̐/ lho sgo'i zla gdan la rdo rje zhags pa ma ser mo g.yu'i ral pa can/ g.yas zhags pa/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ nub sgo'i zla gdan la/ rdo rje lcags sgrog ma dmar mo mthing nag gi ral pa can g.yas lcags sgrog oṃ badzra gaṇḍe hoḥ byang sgo'i zla gdan la rdo rje dril bu ma ljang gu gser gyi ral pa can/ g.yas dril bu g.yon thams cad tsitta bsnams pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ zhal bgrad pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ khro gnyer bsdus pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ dur khrod kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gyis bzhengs pa/

gdan bting sku bskyed dbang bskur zhing / /byin gyis brlabs pa rab tu bya/ /yab yum gnyis med sbyor ba las/ /sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu gsal/ /spyan drangs pa ni/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas nub phyogs o rgyan padma dbang gi gzhal yas nas/ padma dbang chen khrag 'thung lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la 'khor za byed bka' nyan gyi tshogs kyis skor ba badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas snyan gsan dbab pas thugs kyis dgongs te rong bzhengs par bsam la/ rnga brdung zhing dbyangs dang bcas pas/ ngag tu/ hrīḥ chos kyi dbyings las sku bzhengs pa/ /dbang chen khros pa'i rgyal po bzhengs/ /dbus nyid ye shes gzhal yas nas/ /padma rta mchog gshegs su gsol/ /mkha' dbyings yum gyi gzhal yas nas/ /yum chen khro mo gshegs su gsol/ /phyogs bzhi 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng nas/ /sprul pa'i khro bo gshegs su gsol/ /sgo bzhi gnas kyi gzhal yas nas/ /sgo ma bzhi rnams༞ /dur khrod chen po'i gnas mchog nas/ /bka' nyan tshogs rnams༞ /oṃ e hye hi bha ga wan mahā ka ru ṇi ka tri sha hoḥ sa ma ya dzaḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hrīḥ dpal chen khro bo mi zad pa/ /rta mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khro mo yum la༞ /khro rgyal bzhi la༞ /sgo srung bzhi la༞ /bka' nyan tshogs la༞ /a ti pu hoḥ pra ti dzaḥhoḥbazhugs su gsol ba ni/ dam tshig dbang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /ye shes dbang chen dkyil 'khor mchog /pho brang dam tshig dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /dges shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ rnga rol bzhag phyi mchod ni/ mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog dang / /bdug spos snang gsal zhugs rtog sgra/ /zhal zas dri chab 'di rnams kyang / /padma dbang chen dkyil 'khor la/ /mchod par 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mahā padma shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/

nai wi dye/ shapda pu dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya āḥhūm̐/ zhes sngags 'di ḍā dril rol chen gyi sbugs la brjod/ bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa ni/ rnga rol bzhag la/ mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi 'thor ba'i stangs ka dang / dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hrīḥ rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag /rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman/ /rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos/ /ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas/ /rgyud lnga sems can kun grol ba'i/ /dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bcas la/ /bdag cag dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /thugs rjes dgongs la bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas bdag la dges par mdzod/ /bla med 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ snga rabs 'das pa'i rdo rje slob dpon dang / /da lta bzhugs pa'i rdo rje slob dpon dang / /slad nas byon pa'i rdo rje slob dpon la/ /rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes dgongs la dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ rgyal ba dgongs pa brgyud pa'i bla ma dang / /rig 'dzin rig pa brgyud pa'i bla ma dang / /gang zag snyan khungs brgyud pa'i bla ma la/ /rnam dag༞ /thugs rjes༞ /oṃ sarba༞ /chos sku spros bral snang ba mtha' yas dang / /longs sku bde chen khro rgyal rta mgrin dang / /sprul pa'i sku mchog padma 'byung gnas la/ /rnam dag༞ /thugs rjes༞ /oṃ sarba༞ /rab dga'i sar gnas grub thob 'dar phyar dang / /chos kyi rgyal po bo dong rin po che/ /mkhas grub chen po bsod nams brtan pa la/ /rnam dag༞ /thugs rjes༞ /oṃ sarba༞ /'gro ba'i bla ma chos rgyal dpal bzang po/ /kun mkhyen chen po dpal ldan seng ge dang / /mtshungs med chos rje rin chen bkra shis la/ /rnam dag༞ /thugs rjes༞ /oṃ sarba༞ /rtogs ldan chen po yon tan mgon po dang /

/grub pa'i dbang phyug bla chen chos dpal bzang / /dkon mchog gsum dngos rdo rje rgyal mtshan la/ /rnam dag༞ /thugs rjes༞ /oṃ sarba༞ /mus pa chen po rnam rgyal bzang po dang / /'khrul pa kun zhig dkon mchog bzang po dang / /snyan brgyud mnga' bdag blo gsal rgya mtsho la/ /rnam dag༞ /thugs rjes༞ /oṃ sarba༞ /'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug dang / /mthu stobs mnga' bdag bsod nams chos 'phel ba/ /'chi med rig 'dzin dbang phyug rab brtan la/ /rnam dag༞ /thugs rjes༞ /oṃ sarba༞ /khyab bdag bka' 'gyur mgon po'i mtshan can dang / /zur chen chos dbyings rang grol mkhas shing grub/ /kun mkhyen rgyal dbang blo bzang mtshan can la/ /rnam dag༞ /thugs rjes༞ /oṃ sarba༞ /rig 'dzin chen po padma 'phrin las dang / /rmor chen chos kyi rgyal po lhun grub mtshan/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang legs pa'i 'byung gnas la/ /rnam dag༞ /thugs rjes༞ /oṃ༞ sa chen rdo rje 'chang dbang kun blo'i zhabs/ /grub dbang 'jigs bral yab rje dbang gi mtshan/ /gang gi thugs sras ngag dbang kun rin la/ /rnam dag༞ /thugs rjes༞ /oṃ sarba༞ /snyan rgyud mnga' bdag kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang / /padma dbang chen theg chen maṅga'i mtshan/ /ngag dbang kun bsod rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /rnam dag༞ thugs rjes༞ /oṃ sarba༞ /'chi med bdud rtsi ra sa ya na ya/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mchod pa 'di/ /bcom ldan khro rgyal padma dbang chen la/ /bdag cag rab tu dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /thugs rje chen pos dgongs la bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas bdag la kun tu dges par mdzod/ /bla med 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ 'chi med༞ /dam rdzas༞ /yum chen khro mo padma gar dbang la/ /bdag༞ /thugs rje༞ /bzhes༞ /bla med༞ /oṃ༞ /'chi med༞ /dam rdzas༞ /sprul pa'i khro rgyal chen po bzhi rnams la/ /bdag༞ /thugs rjes༞ /bzhes nas༞ /bla med༞

/oṃ༞ /'chi med༞ /dam rdzas༞ /ye shes sgo ma chen mo bzhi rnams la/ /bdag༞ /thugs rjes༞ /bzhes nas༞ /bla med༞ /oṃ༞ /'chi med༞ /dam rdzas༞ /rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs 'khor bcas la/ /bdag cag༞ /thugs rje༞ /bzhes nas༞ /bla med༞ /oṃ༞ /'chi med༞ /dam rdzas༞ /gur gyi mgon po lcam dral 'khor bcas la/ /bdag cag༞ /thugs rjes༞ /bzhes nas༞ /bla med༞ /oṃ༞ /'chi med༞ /dam rdzas༞ /lha chen nag po gdong bzhi 'khor bcas la/ /bdag༞ /thugs rje༞ /bzhes nas༞ /bla med༞ /oṃ༞ /'chi med༞ /dam rdzas༞ /dpal mgon legs ldan nag po 'khor bcas la/ /bdag cag༞ /thugs rje༞ /bzhes nas༞ /bla med༞ /oṃ༞ /'chi med༞ /dam rdzas༞ /ye shes mgon po stag zhon 'khor bcas la/ /bdag cag༞ /thugs rje༞ /bzhes nas༞ /bla med༞ /oṃ༞ /'chi med༞ /dam rdzas༞ /srog gcod gying chen lnga po 'khor bcas la/ /bdag cag༞ /thugs rje༞ /bzhes nas༞ /bla med༞ /oṃ༞ /'chi med༞ /dam rdzas༞ /dregs pa gza' gdong lcam dral 'khor bcas la/ /bdag cag༞ /thugs rje༞ /bzhes nas༞ /bla med༞ /oṃ༞ /'chi med༞ /dam rdzas༞ /dpal ldan beg gdong lcam dral 'khor bcas la/ /bdag cag༞ /thugs rje༞ /bzhes nas༞ /bla med༞ /oṃ༞ /'chi med༞ /dam rdzas༞ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /bdag cag༞ /thugs rje༞ /bzhes nas༞ /bla med༞ /oṃ༞ /'chi med bdud rtsi ra sa ya na ya/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi mchog gi mchod pa 'di/ /chos 'khor skyong ba'i srung ma thams cad la/ /bdag cag rab tu dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /thugs rje chen pos dgongs la bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas bdag la kun tu dges par mdzod/ /bla med 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐/ ye shes khro rgyal dbang chen gyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub mchog /rnal 'byor lus ngag yid la thim/ /gnyis med gyur nas brtan par byas/ /rang gi gnas gsum du thig le byas la/

ka ya siddhi oṃ/ wakka siddhi āḥ tsitta siddhi hūm̐/ gsang ba sman rag gi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ rnam dag rang byung grub sman 'di/ /padma dbang chen dkyil 'khor la/ /mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ rakta'i mchod pa ni/ rnga rol bcas/ hūm̐/ rakta dmar chen mchod pa 'di/ /padma dbang chen dkyil 'khor la/ /mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /mahā rakta kha raṃ khā hi/ sbyor sgrol gyi mchod pa ni/ rdor dril dang bcas pas lag gnyis 'khyud pa'i stangs ka dang / hūm̐/ gsang ba thabs dang shes rab las/ /padma nor bu mnyam sbyar nas/ /dges pa chen po'i bde chen dang / /byang chub sems kyi mchod pa 'di/ /padma dbang chen dkyil 'khor la/ /mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /mahā su ka boddhi tsitta swā hā/ bsgral mchod ni/ rnga rol dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ sprul pa'i khro bo 'bar ba yis/ /zhing bcu ma lus thams cad dang / /'khor ba nyon mongs rgyab bral nas/ /dug lnga dbyings su bsgral bar bya'o/ /a lu ka mā ra ya phaṭa/ hūm̐/ zhing bcu thams cad rang bzhin bsgral/ /sha khrag srog dbugs mchod pa 'di/ /padma dbang chen dkyil 'khor la/ /mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /mahā maṃ sa༞ mahā rakta༞ mahā keṃ ni ri te༞ mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ khyad par 'dod yon mchod pa'i mchog /sha khrag keng rus gtor ma 'dis/ /khro rgyal rta mchog thugs dam bskang / /mahā ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ khyad par 'dod yon༞ /sha khrag༞ /keng rus༞ /yum chen khro mo'i thugs dam bskang / /mahā༞ /khyad par༞ /sha khrag༞ /khro rgyal bzhi yi thugs dam bskang / /mahā༞ /khyad par༞ /sha khrag༞ /sgo ma bzhi yi thugs dam bskang / /mahā༞ /khyad par༞ /sha khrag༞ /gying chen lnga yi thugs dam bskang / /mahā༞ /khyad par༞ /sha khrag༞ /gza' gdong lcam dral thugs dam bskang / /mahā༞ /khyad par༞ /sha khrag༞ /beg rtse lcam dral thugs dam bskang /

/mahā ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ hūm̐/ sha khrag rus pa nang khrol mkhris/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang / /nga rgyal phrag dog mchod par 'bul/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang / /'phrin las dngos por bzhes su gsol/ /mahā maṃ sa khā hi/ mahā keṃ ni ri te khā hi/ mahā ba su ta khā hi/ mahā go ro tsa na khā hi/ 'dod yon gyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ gzugs kyi lha mo sku mdog dkar/ /phyag na mdzes sdug longs spyod bsnams/ /dbang chen lha yi spyan la 'bul/ /gzugs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /a la la ste dges par mdzod/ /sgra yi lha mo sku mdog sngo/ /phyag na sgra snyan longs spyod bsnams/ /dbang chen lha yi snyan la 'bul/ /sgra yi mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /a la la༞ /dri yi lha mo sku mdog ser/ /phyag na dri yi longs spyod bsnams/ /dbang chen lha yi shangs la 'bul/ /dri yi mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /a la la༞ /ro yi lha mo sku mdog dmar/ /phyag na ro yi longs spyod bsnams/ /dbang chen lha yi ljags la 'bul/ /ro yi mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /a la la༞ /reg bya'i lha mo sku mdog ljang / /phyag na reg bya'i longs spyod bsnams/ /dbang chen lha yi sku la 'bul/ /reg bya'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /a la la༞ /chos kyi lha mo sku mdog mthing / /phyag na chos kyi po ti bsnams/ /dbang chen lha yi thugs la 'bul/ /chos kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /a la la ste dges par mdzod/ /bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ hrīḥ dmar nag gru gsum dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas/ /padma nyi zla bdud bsnol gdan steng du/ /rnam shes gnas gyur padma he ru ka /zhe sdang rnam dag chos dbyings ye shes ngang / /rgyud drug nyon mongs zhe sdang 'joms mdzad pa/ /khro rgyal rta mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /rmad byung rol pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /dga' bzhi bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor nas/

/dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yum/ /bde stong zung 'jug shes rab thabs la rol/ /dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med khro mo'i sku/ /rgyud drug las dang nyon mongs 'joms mdzad pa/ /khro mo gar dbang yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi nang༞ /rmad byung rol pa'i༞ /yab yum thabs shes gnyis med rol pa las/ /shar phyogs 'khor lo dri za'i gdan steng na/ /gzugs phung gnas gyur rdo rje dbang chen sku/ /gti mug rnam dag me long ye shes ngang / /rgyud drug nyon mongs gti mug 'joms mdzad pa/ /rdo rje dbang chen sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi nang༞ /rmad byung༞ /yab yum༞ /lho phyogs 'khor lo grul bum gdan steng na/ /tshor phung gnas gyur rin chen dbang chen sku/ /nga rgyal rnam dag mnyam nyid ye shes ngang / /rgyud drug nyon mongs nga rgyal 'joms mdzad pas/ /rin chen dbang chen sku la༞ /phyi nang༞ /rmad byung༞ /yab yum༞ /nub phyogs 'khor lo klu dbang gdan steng du/ /'du shes gnas gyur padma dbang chen sku/ /'dod chags rnam dag kun rtog ye shes ngang / /rgyud drug nyon mongs 'dod chags 'joms mdzad pa/ /padma dbang chen sku la༞ /phyi nang༞ /rmad byung༞ /yab yum༞ /byang phyogs 'khor lo gnod sbyin gdan steng du/ /'du byed gnas gyur las rab dbang chen sku/ /phrag dog rnam dag bya grub ye shes ngang / /rgyud drug nyon mongs phrag dog 'joms mdzad pa/ /las rab dbang chen sku la༞ /phyi nang༞ /rmad byung༞ /yab yum༞ /shar phyogs sgo khyud zla ba'i gdan steng du/ /sa khams rnam dag sgo ma lcags kyu ma/ /byams pa tshad med zhi ba'i las rnams sgrub/ /rgyud drug las dang nyon mongs 'joms mdzad pa/ /rdo rje lcags kyu ma la༞ /phyi nang༞ /rmad byung༞ /yab yum༞ /lho phyogs sgo khyud zla ba'i gdan steng du/ /chu khams rnam dag sgo ma zhags pa ma/ /snying rje tshad med rgyas pa'i las rnams sgrub/ /tshe dang ye shes ma lus rgyas mdzad ma/

/rdo rje zhags pa ma la༞ /phyi nang༞ /rmad byung༞ /yab yum༞ /nub phyogs sgo khyud zla ba'i gdan steng du/ /me khams rnam dag sgo ma lcags sgrog ma/ /dga' ba tshad med dbang gi las rnams sgrub/ /khams gsum ma lus dbang du bsdud mdzad ma/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog ma la༞ /phyi nang༞ /rmad byung༞ /yab yum༞ /byang phyogs sgo khyud zla ba'i gdan steng du/ /rlung khams rnam dag sgo ma dril bu ma/ /btang snyoms tshad med drag po'i las rnams sgrub/ /dgra bgegs mngon spyod las kyis tshar gcod ma/ /rdo rje dril bu ma la༞ /phyi nang༞ /rmad byung༞ /zhing khams thams cad dbang drag dkyil 'khor nas/ /phung po khams dang skye mched ye shes lha/ /sku lnga ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin can/ /tshad med bzhi dang 'phrin las rnam bzhi ldan/ /thugs rje khros pa'i khro bzhad rngams pa'i zhal/ /yab yum gtso 'khor bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi nang༞ /rmad byung༞ /dbang drag phyi yi dkyil 'khor bka' srung ni/ /srog la dbang bsgyur gying chen lnga rnams kyang / /las su sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung mdzad cing / /zas su dgra bgegs sha khrag tshogs rnams gsol/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs thal bar rlog mdzad pa'i/ /dregs pa mthu stsal can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi nang༞ /rmad byung༞ /phyogs bzhi bar snang nam mkha'i dkyil yangs nas/ /dam can bka' bstod gza' gdong lcam dral yang / /las su sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung mdzad cing / /zas su dgra bo'i lo thog snar ma gsol/ /dgra bgegs yul khams thal bar rlog mdzad pa'i/ /gza' gdong dregs pa can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi nang༞ /rmad byung༞ /byang shar mya rngam 'das pa'i zhing khams nas/ /gnod sbyin beg rtse lcam dral 'khor bcas kyang / /las su sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung mdzad cing / /zas su dgra bgegs sha khrag tshogs rnams gsol/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs thal bar rlog mdzad pa'i/ /gnod sbyin 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/

/rmad byung rol pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /rnga rol bzhag thugs kha'i sngags phreng gsal btab nas/ 'dzabs bzlas pa ni/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid khro rgyal rta mchog dpal/ /thugs kar padma 'dab brgyad kyi/ /ge sar la ni snying po hrīḥ /'dab ma brgyad la sngags kyis bskor/ /'od 'phros bde gshegs rnams la thim/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bsdu/ /rnal 'byor lus ngag yid la bsdu/ /hrīḥbadzra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ mahā kro dhi shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra shwa ra kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ratna shwa ra kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ padma shwa ra kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ karma shwa ra kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badzra pa sha hūm̐/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badzra gaṇḍe hoḥ zhes dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi sngags te/ de yang phyag len la yab kyi sngags phreng 'khor tsam re bzlas grub pa dang / lag gnyis kyi mthe bong dang mthe'u chung la phreng ba bskon te/ thugs ka'i thad du drangs/ 'dzab dbyangs rdo rje'i sgra bsgrags pas/ /bla ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskul/ /hrīḥbadzra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'dzab dbyangs༞ /rgyal ba dgongs brgyud thugs dam bskul/ /hrīḥbadzra kro dha༞ 'dzab dbyangs༞ /rig 'dzin rig brgyud thugs dam bskul/ /hrīḥbadzra kro dha༞ 'dzab dbyangs༞ /gang zag snyan brgyud thugs dam bskul/ /hrīḥbadzra༞ 'dzab dbyangs༞ /yi dam lha tshogs thugs dam bskul/ /hrīḥbadzra༞ 'dzab dbyangs༞ /sgrub chen bka' brgyad thugs dam bskul/ /hrīḥbadzra༞ 'dzab dbyangs༞ /khro rgyal rta mchog thugs dam bskul/ /hrīḥbadzra༞ 'dzab dbyangs༞ /yum chen khro mo'i thugs dam bskul/ /hrīḥbadzra༞ 'dzab dbyangs༞ /dbang chen bzhi yi thugs dam bskul/ /hrīḥbadzra༞ 'dzab dbyangs༞ /sgo ma bzhi yi thugs dam bskul/ /hrīḥbadzra༞ 'dzab dbyangs༞ /gying chen sde lnga'i thugs dam bskul/

/hrīḥbadzra༞ 'dzab dbyangs༞ /gza' gdong lcam sring thugs dam bskul/ /hrīḥbadzra༞ 'dzab dbyangs༞ /gnod sbyin lcam dral thugs dam bskul/ /hrī badzra༞ 'dzab dbyangs༞ /chos skyong srung ma'i thugs dam bskul/ /hrīḥbadzra༞ 'dzab dbyangs rdo rje'i sgra bsgrags pas/ /gnas bdag gzhi bdag thugs dam bskul/ /hrīḥbadzra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes rkang gnyis de'i rjes su sngags gnyis gnyis bcug nas gsung grub pa dang / yang phreng 'khor gnyis bzla/ yum sngags phreng 'khor phyed dang gnyis/ 'khor rnams la phreng 'khor re bzlas grub pa dang / drags bstod ni/ rnga rol dang bcas/ hrīḥ dmar nag gru gsum dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas/ /yab gcig bcom ldan padma he ru ka /sku mdog dmar nag gzi brjid 'bar ba ni/ /thugs rje chen pos 'gro la chags pa'i rtags/ /khro mo dbang phyug sku la 'khril ba ni/ /gnyis med bde chen pha rol phyin pa'i rtags/ /dbu gsum g.yas dkar g.yon ljang dbus dmar ni/ /rnam thar sgo gsum yongs su rdzogs pa'i rtags/ /zhal bgrad tshems dkar mche ba gtsigs pa ni/ /zhing bcu ma lus sha la rol ba'i rtags/ /spyan gsum dmar zlum phyogs bcur gzigs pa ni/ /sdug bsngal gdungs pa'i 'gro la gzigs pa'i rtags/ /dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'khyil ba ni/ /'gro drug 'khor ba'i gnas nas 'dren pa'i rtags/ /dbang chen gdug pa'i spyan rtsa ldog pa ni/ /dregs chen sde brgyad zil gyis gnon pa'i rtags/ /rta mgo ljang khu rta skad 'tsher ba ni/ /zab cing rgya che'i chos sgra sgrog pa'i rtags/ /rngog ma dmar po sprin ltar gtibs pa ni/ /srid gsum ma lus dbang du sdud pa'i rtags/ /zhur po dkar po 'od zer 'bar ba ni/ /skye rgu'i ma rig mun pa sel ba'i rtags/ /dgyes pa'i 'gying gar stabs tshul ston pa ni/ /rtag tu 'gro don sna tshogs mdzad pa'i rtags/ /thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan pa ni/

/khrag 'thung rigs lnga'i rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i rtags/ /shangs nas bskal pa'i rlung nag 'tshubs pa ni/ /dregs pa mthu chen rtsal drag 'dul ba'i rtags/ /rngams pa'i nga ro 'brug stong sgrog pa ni/ /khams gsum bdud dpung skrag par byed pa'i rtags/ /dang pos padma bandha bsnams pa ni/ /snang srid che btsan dbang du sdud pa'i rtags/ /bar pas lcags kyu zhags pa bsnams pa ni/ /sgrub pa po yi dmigs yul 'gugs pa'i rtags/ /tha mas be con ral gri bsnams pa ni/ /dgra bgegs ma lus sgrol bar byed pa'i rtags/ /bgrad pa'i zhabs bzhis ru tra mnan pa ni/ /bdud dpung ma lus brlag par byed pa'i rtags/ /thod rlon phreng bas tshar gsum brgyan pa ni/ /chos rnams rten 'brel rang bzhin ston pa'i rtags/ /sku smad stag gi sham thabs gsol ba ni/ /sgrub po bag yod gnas la 'god pa'i rtags/ /sbrul rigs bzhi yis sku la brgyan pa ni/ /gdug pa'i klu nag ma lus 'dul ba'i rtags/ /dur khrod chas brgyad rgyan gyis mdzes pa ni/ /'phags lam yan lag ma lus rdzogs pa'i rtags/ /bskal pa'i me dpung klong na bzhugs pa ni/ /bgegs rnams ma lus bsreg par byed pa'i rtags/ /khyung gshog sngon pos bar snang khyab pa ni/ /chos kyi dbyings las 'gyur ba med pa'i rtags/ /'od 'bar nyi ma stong bas lhag pa ni/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho gting nas skem pa'i rtags/ /sku stod glang chen ko rlon gsol ba ni/ /mi shes rab rib glang po bral ba'i rtags/ /snyan nas bskal pa'i 'brug stong ldir ba ni/ /srid pa'i che btsan dbang du sdud pa'i rtags/ /tshems las drag po'i thog ser 'bebs pa ni/ /sdang ba'i dgra bgegs rdul du rlog pa'i rtags/ /zhal na rakta'i rgya mtsho 'khyil ba ni/ /ma rung dgra la skyin thang 'bebs pa'i rtags/ /khro bo'i gad rgyangs rgya cher sgrog pa ni/ /gdug pa'i tshogs rnams skrag par byed pa'i rtags/ /khro rgyal khrag 'thung padma he ru ka

/khyod kyi dbang drag 'phrin las dus la babs/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol ba dang / /dgra bgegs rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod/ /'dzab bstod ni/ hrīḥ padma rigs kyi khro rgyal mchog /dpal chen padma he ru ka /mi zad khro rgyal rta mchog dpal/ /dbang drag stobs chen rngams brjid gtum/ /sku mdog dmar nag brjid cing 'gying / /dbu gsum rnam thar gsum yang ston/ /phyag drug rgyud drug rtsad nas gcod/ /zhabs bzhi 'khor ba'i chos bzhi sgrol/ /dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs/ /rta mgo ljang khu rta skad 'tsher/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs/ /rngams pa'i nga ro 'brug stong ldir/ /dregs pa pho mo dbang du sdud/ /dbang chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnga rol bzhag dngos grub blangs ba ni/ hūm̐/ khro rgyal rngams chen rta mchog dpal/ /dpal gyi sku gsung thugs mchog las/ /mchog gi dngos grub ye shes dbyig /dus 'dir rnal 'byor bdag la stsol/ /oṃ padma ta kri ta padma shwa ri mahā kro dha ha ya grī wa ma ma rakmo dun ting hrīṃ hrīṃ hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ padma kro dha ka ya wakka tsitta siddhi a la la hoḥ zhes sngags le tshan gnyis sbrel ma gsum mam bdun sogs bgrong / ras bris ltar na 'dir bum bskyed gong bzhin bya/ tshe rdzas grub pa ni/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ na mo rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa/ rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pa/ gang zag snyan khung gi brgyud pa ste/ brgyud gsum rig 'dzin dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sgrub sde chen po brgyad kyi lha tshogs sogs yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / khyad par du yang bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i lha tshogs rnams kyi༞ bcom ldan 'das padma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa khrag 'thung lha dgu 'khor za byed bka' nyan gyi tshogs dang bcas pa'i dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang /

bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis tshe'i dbang bskur ba zab mo sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa'i tshogs mi min mi ru rdzu ba/ lha min lha ru rdzu ba/ gsang sngags zab mo nyan pa la mi dbang ba gang yin pa de dag thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par rgyang ring du songs shig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag la ye shes kyi khro bo rab tu 'bar ba 'di rnams kyis skad cig nyid la rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bya'o/ /oṃ raṃ kro dha/ sogs mtshams sngags brjod cing / gu gul gyi du ba dang rol mo'i sgra chen po bsgrags/ de ltar bgegs bskrad nas/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ tshe rten bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyi mgul chings dang ldan pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ phyi bum pa'i rnam pa la nang gzhal yas khang chen po 'chi med kyi bdud rtsis gang ba/ de'i dbus su rma bya brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ paṃ padma maṇḍal/ ma surya maṇḍal/ a tsaṇḍa maṇḍal/ padma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du/ oṃ pyaṃ dmar po/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ 'od zer 'phros 'dus/ padma gaṇḍa/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa dang / de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu/ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ 'od zer 'phros 'dus/ oṃ a ro lig pyaṃ ra ga ra ti satwaṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na rin po che'i bum pa 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang ba rdo rje rgya gram gyis mtshan pa bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum tshe'i lha mo gos dkar mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/

g.yas bkra shis mda' dar dmar po g.yab tu 'dor ba/ g.yon tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ zhabs padma'i skyil krung gis yab la 'khyud pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pas sku stod yan chad khebs pa/ yab yum gnyis ka'ang dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ 'od dang 'od zer gyi rang bzhin/ zhi ba 'dzum pa sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ de gnyis kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ dbus gnas lngar ratna mu ku tra a bhi ṣiñtsa traṃ/ zhes pas rin po che'i khang bu lnga'i nang du/ oṃ mahā pra ti be ṣa dzñā na badzra swa bha wa ātma ko3haṃ/ oṃ mahā ā darsha dzñā na༞ oṃ mahā sa manta dzñā na༞ oṃ mahā shu n+yā ta dzñā na༞ oṃ mahā kri ta a nu dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ dbu'i gnas lngar rgyal ba rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad tshe dpag med yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ rnga rol dbyangs dang bcas pa'i rdo rje g.yab cing dril bu gsil la/ hrīḥ thugs rje'i lcags kyus thugs dam rgyud bskul zhing / /byams pa'i zhags pas gnas nas spyan yang 'dren/ /lcags sgrog bka' yi pho nyas rab bskyod de/ /'dir gshegs bzhugs shing rnam grol dges par mdzod/ /oṃ e hye hi bha ga wan mahā ka ru ṇi ka tri shya hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par gyur/ de'i steng gi nam mkha' la slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas dang / 'chi med tshe'i lha mo tsaṇḍa li la sogs pa tshe yi rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang / gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma/ lha dang srung ma'i tshogs thams cad phyag na bum pa dang thod pa la sogs pa tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba thogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar bzhugs pa rnams kyis 'dzab dbyangs dang shis brjod kyi sgra sgrog

bdud rtsi dang me tog gi char 'bebs par bsam mo/ /de dag la mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /rgyal ba rgyal mtsho'i ye shes las/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho mtha' yas kun/ /kun bzang mchod sprin mchog tu rol/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu ṣe bhyaḥ sarba tad khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhne daṃ sa ma ya swā hā/ yang dag don du dag mod kyang / /'gro ba yongs kyi don slad du/ /phyag dang zhabs ni bsil nas kyang / /rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ a ha ra a ha ra sarba bi dha ra pū dzi te na maḥs manta buddha naṃ ga ga na khaṃ sa ma ye swā hā/ oṃ hṝḥrā ga badzra dhū pe/ puṣpe/ a lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dya/ shapda āḥhūm̐ gis phyi mchod dang / rnga rol byas nas bzhag mtheb srin gyis nang mchod gtor/ oṃ mahā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐/ zhes pas bdud rtsi dbul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa'i sna la sgo ma bzhi la sogs pa pho nya dpag tu med pa spros te/ de dag gis 'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshe dang bsod nams la sogs pa thams cad rang dbang med par bsdus nas mdun gyi tshe rdzas rnams dang / rang gi snying gar nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor gyi dbus na tshe'i rten 'od dkar po mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam dkar la 'tsher ba'i dbus na/ rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo yi ge ṇi ljang khu snum la 'gril ba dwangs shing gsal ba zhig yod pa la thim par gyur/ rdo rje phyag 'tshal ba'i stangs ka dang dril bu gsil la/ bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med/ /sku mchog mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku/ /gsung mchog yan lag drug cu'i gsung / /thugs mchog mi rtog pa yi thugs/ /mkha' 'dra'i sku gsung thugs mnga' ba/ /tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i las mdzod cig /rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ puṇye puṇye mahā puṇye a pa ri mi ta ā yur puṇya dzñā na saṃ bha ro pa tsitte swā hā/

zhes lan bdun/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ āḥ oṃ ā yur dzñā na siddhi bhrūm̐/ sngags thung gnyis po 'di sbrel ma nyer gcig brjod/ slob dpon gyi lag tu tshe mda' thogs la 'og tu sngags brjod skabs g.yab cing / yang tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka nas lha mo lcags kyu ma dkar mo dpag tu med par 'phros te shar dang shar lho'i phyogs su song bas/ dri za dang me lha la sogs pa lha klu gnod sbyin mthu bo che rnams kyi lag na rang gi tshe 'phrogs pa dang 'thor ba dang / yar ba la sogs pa ji snyed yod pa dang / shar dang shar lho'i 'byung ba'i rtsi bcud sogs dang / gzhan yang 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i tshe dang bsod nams thams cad rang dbang med par bsdus nas mdun gyi tshe rten rnams dang rang gi snying ga'i tshe rten la thim par gyur/ hūm̐/ 'gugs pa'i lha mo lcags kyu ma/ /dkar mo mdzes ma lcags kyu bsnams/ /dri za'i lag nas tshe khug la/ /me lha'i lag nas dpal skyobs shig /oṃ puṇye sogs tshe gzungs ring ba bdun dang / thung ba nyer gcig sngar bzhin brjod/ yang tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka nas lha mo zhags pa ma sngon mo dpag tu med pa spros pas lho dang nub kyi phyogs su song bas gshin rje dang srin po la sogs pa lha klu༞ zhes sogs sngar ltar bsam zhing / hūm̐/ 'ching byed lha mo zhags pa ma/ /sngon mo mdzes ma zhags pa bsnams/ /gshin rje'i lag nas tshe khug la/ /srin po'i lag nas dpal skyobs shig /sngags sngar ltar brjod/ yang tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka nas lha mo dmar mo lcags sgrog thogs pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ nub dang nub byang gi phyogs su song bas chu lha dang rlung lha༞ sogs dang / hūm̐/ sdom byed lha mo lcags sgrog ma/ /dmar mo mdzes ma lcags sgrog bsnams/ /klu dbang lag nas tshe khug la/ /rlung lha'i lag nas dpal skyobs shig /sngags brjod/ yang tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka nas lha mo ljang khu dril bu thogs pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/

byang dang byang shar gyi mtshams su song bas gnod sbyin dang 'byung po༞ sogs dang / hūm̐/ 'bebs byed lha mo dril bu ma/ /ljang khu mdzes ma dril bu bsnams/ /gnod sbyin lag nas tshe khug la/ /'byung po'i lag nas dpal skyobs shig /sngags brjod/ slar lha mo rnams rnal 'byor gyi thugs khar thim par bsam/ bden pa bdar te tshe 'gugs pa ni/ mdun bskyed 'khor bcas kyi thugs ka nas sprul pa'i pho nya nam mkha'i khams khyab par spros te/ de dag na yod pa'i lha srin mthu bo che rnams kyis rang gi tshe srog 'phrogs pa sogs dang / gzhan yang phyi snod kyi 'jig rten dang / nang bcud kyi sems can/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yon tan nus pa mthu stobs la sogs pa thams cad skad cig nyid la bsdus te rang dang tshe rten la thim par gyur/ zhes dang / hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ na mo rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa/ rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pa/ gang zag snyan khung gi brgyud pa ste/ brgyud gsum rig 'dzin dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sgrub sde chen po brgyad kyi lha tshogs sogs yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / khyad par du yang bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i lha tshogs rnams kyi༞ bcom ldan 'das padma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa khrag 'thung lha dgu 'khor za byed bka' nyan gyi tshogs dang bcas pa'i༞ dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyis bdag cag gi tshe sde brgyad rigs drug gi lag na gnas kyang khug cig rdo rje'i chos skyong srung ma rnams kyis kyang / bdag cag gi tshe 'thor ba dang / yar ba dang / 'phrogs pa dang / ldags pa thams cad khug cig

gzhan yang 'byung ba'i rtsi bcud/ sems can gyi tshe dang bsod nams/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byin rlabs kyi tshe/ tshe'i rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi rig pa'i tshe/ lha klu gnod sbyin mthu bo che rnams kyi las kyi tshe la sogs pa thams cad skad cig thang cig yud tsam la khug cig drongs shig phobs shig bstims shig oṃ ā yur dzñā hūm̐ḥdzaḥdzaḥ zhes lan gsum la sogs pa brjod/ de nas tshe bcings pa ni/ rang gi snying kha'i nyi zla ga'u'i steng 'og tu rdo rje rgya gram yod pa'i rwa rnams rdo rje lu gu brgyud kyi thag pas bsdams par gyur/ tshe bsdu ba ni/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ gzungs thag la 'khril nas song bas bum pa'i nang gi bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs khar phog pas thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde chen gyis mnyes/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i tshe dang bsod nams ye shes dpal 'byor thams cad bsdus nas bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag gi bum pa'i nang du thim par gyur/ zhes dang gzungs thag nas bzung la/ gzungs ring lan gsum brjod skabs mda' dar g.yab/ 'phro 'du'i 'od kyis bkug nas kyang / /ma lus bum pa'i bcud la bsdu/ /'chi ba med pa'i tshe thob nas/ /bla na med pa'i mchog thob shog /oṃ puṇye puṇye mahā puṇye a pa ri mi ta ā yur puṇye dzñā na saṃ bha ro pa tsitte swā hā/ zhes lan gsum dang / oṃ badzra a yu ṣe hūm̐ āḥ oṃ ā yu dzñā na siddhi bhrūm̐/ zhes brgya rtsa la sogs pa ci rigs bzla ba ni tshe rten sgrub pa'o/ /de nas gying lnga gza' gdong gnod sbyin beg rtse rnams la gtor bsngo bya ba ni/ gying lnga'i gtor ma/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gyis sbyangs/ bhrūm̐/ zhes snod thod par gyur par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ mahā ba liṃ ta pū dza te dzā hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi'i shar gyi dur khrod kyi gnas g.yas su ra las dbang chen thugs kyi sprul pa srog bdag 'od kyi rgyal po/

'od kyi mi bo che dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ral gri dang g.yon 'od kyi zhags pa thogs pa/ sku la seng ge'i slog pa gsol zhing / dbu la ji dar dkar po bcings pa/ nam mkha' 'ja'i ske rags can/ lcags kyi sder mo rnon pos dgra snying 'byin pa/ 'jigs su rung ba'i seng ge dkar mo rngam sgra sgrog pa la chibs pa/ g.yon du tsa las tshangs pa dung gi thor gtsug can/ sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas zangs kyi gri rings dang / g.yon zhags pa dgra la 'debs pa/ sku la dar dkar gyi ral gu gsol zhing / dbu la dung gi cod pan bcings pa/ rta dkar po ngang ring la chibs pa/ lhor tri las dam can rdo rje legs pa sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas gser gyi rdo rje dang / g.yon tsitta dmar po thogs pa/ za 'og sngo khra'i ber gsol zhing / dbu la bse man gyi 'gying thod bcings pa/ rta kham pa lag dkar la chibs pa/ nub tu hrīḥlas bdud po ri nag spungs pa mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas bdud kyi khram shing dang / g.yon zhags pa nag po 'debs pa/ sku la lcags kyi zhun khrab gsol zhing / dbu la bdud zhwa nag po gsol ba/ bdud rta nag po la zhon pa/ byang du shu las srog bdag yam shud dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas zangs kyi gri ring dang / g.yon zhags pa dmar po dgra la 'debs pa/ bse khrab dang bse rmog gsol ba/ bse'i ra skyes kham pa la chibs pa/ lnga ka'ang rngam zhing khro la drag cing rtsub pa'i rnam pa can/ sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ padma dbang gi zhing khams nas srog bdag 'od kyi rgyal po/ rgya yul nam mkha' chad chod nas tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can/ nub phyogs pha wang long bu'i mkhar bang nas dam can rdo rje legs pa/

bdud yul kha rag mgo dgu nas bdud po ri nag spungs pa/ btsan yul zangs thang dmar po nas btsan 'god yam shud dmar po 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig thang cig yud tsam la e hye hi/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ khyud rgya se gol gyis spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa rnams la gnyis su med par thim/ mtheb srin gyis sman rag 'thor ba'i stangs ka dang / ra tsa tri hrī shu sa ma ya satwaṃ/ rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgyas dam la bzhag rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i mthar se gol gtog cing / oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ra tsa srog la hrīḥ.a shugme/ tri srog la dzaḥtsa sa ma a shug dzaḥtri dzaḥbadzra sa du hrīḥ dun dun shu la gri wa i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhna sa ma ya rakṣantu ma ma/ sarba siddhi me pra yatstshantu/ ya the baṃ/ ya theṣṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ dzi gha tha/ pi pa tha/ ma ti pra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kartha ya/ sad su khaṃ/ bi shuddhe/ sa ha yi ka bha wantu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes lan gsum dang / ra tsa tri hrī shu mahā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ mahā rakta khā hi/ sman rag phul/ rnga rol dang rdor dril 'dzin pas/ dbang drag dkyil 'khor phyi yi bka' bstod ni/ /srog la dbang bsgyur gying chen lnga rnams kyang / /las su sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung byed cing / /zas su dgra bo'i sha khrag tshogs rnams za/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod mdzad pa'i/ /dregs pa mthu rtsal can la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /rmad byung rol pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes pas bstod cing 'phrin las bcol lo/ /yang sngar ltar gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi'i nub kyi dur khrod kyi sa gzhi la rgya mtsho chen po rba klong 'khrugs pa'i dbus me dpung 'bar zhing sprin dang rlung nag bu yug 'tshubs pa/ thog dang ser ba drag tu bab cing / 'brug dang glog dmar 'khyug pa'i sgra sgrog cing / gnam sa cha lang sdebs pa lta bu'i klong dkyil du ra ma ra tsa sha rnams las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/

khro rgyal padma he ru ka'i thugs kyi sprul pa gza' rgod drag po rā hu la/ sku mdog dud kha srin po khros pa lta bu'i mgo dgu pa/ phyag g.yas kyi skyin thang gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo nam mkhar 'phyar nas dgra bo'i yul du 'phen cing / phyag g.yon chu srin gyi zhags pas dam nyams 'ching zhing za ba/ lus po thams cad mig gis gang ba/ lte ba man chad dug sbrul nag po'i gzugs kyis rgya mtsho'i gting nas dkrug pa/ de'i shar du zer srin dkar mo stag gi gdong can/ lhor bam srin ser mo dred kyi gdong can/ nub tu kong srin dmar mo ba glang gi gdong can/ byang du 'brog srin ljang khu chu srin gyi gdong can/ bzhi ka'ang srin mo khros pa'i rnam pa/ g.yas zor ba dang / g.yon nad rkyal thogs pa/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyi 'khor gyis bskor ba/ skad cig nyid la dgra bo'i yul khams thal bar rlog par byed pa/ gtso 'khor de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis lho nub mtshams kyi srin yul laṅka pu ri'i grong khyer nas dregs pa gza' gdong lcam dral lha srin sde brgyad kyi 'khor dang bcas pa e hye hi badzra sa mā dzaḥ bsdu rgya se gol gyis spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par thim/ rā hu la sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ rdo rje'i rtse lnga'i phyag rgyas dam la bzhag oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi rā hu la/ ma ra tsa sha ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhna sa ma ya rakṣantu ma ma/ sarba siddhi me pra yatstshantu/ ya the baṃ/ ya theṣṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ dzi gha tha/ pi pa tha/ ma ti pra ma tha/ ma ma sarba karthā ya/ sad su khaṃ bi shuddhe/ sa ha yi ka bha wantu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum dang / mtheb srin gyis sman rag 'thor ba'i stangs ka dang / rā hu la sa pa ri wā ra mahā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ mahā rakta khā his sman rag phul/ rnga rol dang rdor dril 'dzin pas/

phyogs bzhi bar snang nam mkha'i klong yangs nas/ /dam can bka' bsdod gza' gdong lcam dral yang / /las su sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung mdzad cing / /zas su dgra bgegs lo thog snar mar gsol/ /dgra bgegs yul khams thal bar rlog byed pa'am/ /gza' gdong dregs pa can la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /rmad byung rol pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes pas bstod cing 'phrin las bcol/ yang gnod sbyin gyi gtor ma sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi'i byang shar gyi dur khrod kyi sa gzhi la rta khrag dang mi khrag gi rgya mtsho dmar la dwangs pa/ rba klong gru gsum bsnol mar 'khrug pa'i dbus su zangs kyi ri gru bzhi pa'i steng du/ padma nyi ma rta ro mi ro brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ praṃ dang zangs kyi ral gri las skyes pa'i gnod sbyin chen po sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i zangs kyi ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar bas dam nyams kyi srog rtsa gcod cing / g.yon mda' gzhu dang dgra bgegs glo snying thugs khar 'dzin pa'i mchan khung g.yon na bse'i ru mtshon dmar po bsnams pa/ zhal rab tu gdangs shing / mche ba rno ngar du gtsigs nas ljags 'gril ba/ spyan gsum dang ldan pas khro gnyer shin tu bsdus pa smin ma dang sma ra dus mtha'i me ltar rab tu 'bar zhing / dbu skra kham ser ltag par bcings pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / khrag 'dzag pa'i mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sku la zangs kyi beg rtse dang / dar gyi ral gu dmar pos brgyan cing / zhabs la sag lham dmar po gsol ba/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa'i gzugs can/ g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du maṃ las srid pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma/ sku mdog sngo nag gdong pa bse/

so dung / smin ma g.yu/ me'i ral pa la mchong dang mu men gyis brgyan cing gser gyi rna rgyan 'phyang ba/ gcer mo spyan dang zhal bgrad pa/ g.yas zangs kyi ral gri dgra la 'phyar ba/ g.yon lcags kyi phur pa bgegs la 'debs pa dred mo mi zan ma zhon pa/ gtso bo'i g.yas su trāṃ las las mkhan srog bdag dmar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas mdung dmar 'phyar zhing / g.yon btsan gyi zhags pa dgra la 'debs pa/ bse khrab dang bse rmog gyon cing / ce spyang la zhon pa/ mtshan mo rgyu zhing dgra bgegs la 'o dod 'bod pa/ gtso 'khor gsum gyi shar du mi dmar phra ma/ lhor ri rtse mi dmar/ nub tu kro ti mi dmar/ byang du srog bdag ko sha shar lhor aṃ kri mi dmar/ lho nub tu ro kri mi dmar/ nub byang du ha shang mi dmar/ byang shar du srog bdag thal ba ste gri thogs brgyad dang / bshan pa nyi shu rtsa gcig po thams cad sku mdog dmar po g.yas zangs kyi ral gri 'phyar zhing / g.yon la la rgyu ma lag bsdogs byed pa/ la la glo snying mchin pa 'brad pa/ la la snying khrag klad pa ldag pa/ la la sha khrag spar gyis 'debs pa/ la la rus pa rkang mar 'cha' ba/ la la lpags pa dmar bshus byed pa/ la la sha gdan dmar po 'ding ba/ thams cad kyang dgra bo'i srog len/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi dang / ba glang gi ko ba rlon pa gyon pa/ gzhan yang btsan dmar stong / bdud dang gnod sbyin srin po sum stong / ma mo 'bum/ the'u rang stong la sogs pa dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba'o/ /gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas byang shar ma ru rtse'i dur khrod brag dmar po 'chong lding gi pho brang nas gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig thang cig yud tsam la e hye hi/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ bsdu rgya se gol gyis spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

dam tshig pa rnams la gnyis su med par thim/ praṃ maṃ traṃ sa ma yā satwaṃ/ rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgyas dam la bzhag rdor thal kha phye'i mthar se gol gtog cing / oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ rakmo pra ṇa ātma sa pa ri wā ra/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhna/ sa ma ya rakṣantu ma ma/ sarba siddhi me pra yatstshantu/ ya the baṃ/ ya theṣṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ dzi gha tha/ pi pa tha/ ma ti pra ma tha/ ma ma sarba karthā ya/ sad su khaṃ bi shuddhe sa ha yi ka bha wantu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ lan gsum dang / mtheb srin gyis sman nas 'thor ba'i stangs ka dang / praṃ maṃ traṃ mahā sarba pañtsa a mri ta khā hi/ mahā rakta khā hi/ zhes pas sman raka phul/ rnga rol dang rdor dril 'dzin pas/ byang shar mya rngam 'das pa'i zhing khams nas/ /gnod sbyin beg rtse lcam dral 'khor bcas kyang / /las su sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung byed cing / /zas su dgra bo'i sha khrag tshogs rnams za/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod mdzad pa'i/ /dregs pa mthu rtsal can la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /rmad byung rol pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes bstod cing 'phrin las bcol/ rgyas par na so so'i bskang ba'ang bya/ gang ltar gtor bsngo bskang ba rnams grub nas/ bskul gyi rim pa la/ rig 'dzin spyi bskul ni/ rnga rol dang bcas/ rgyal ba kun bdag chos sku kun tu bzang / /bdag don mtshan ldan longs sku rdo rje sems/ /thugs rjes don mdzad sprul sku rdo rje 'dzin/ /sku gsum mchog gi mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje man chad nas/ /ya ger bai ro tsa na la sogs pa'i/ /rdzogs chen ston pa grub pa brnyes pa yis/ /man ngag rig 'dzin rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdud po laṅka'i bdag po man chad nas/ /lo tsā che btsan skyes mchog la sogs pa'i/ /mdo yi sgo nas grub pa brnyes pa yi/ /lung gi rig 'dzin rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/

/gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje man chad nas/ /lo tsā sma bsnyegs rnam gnyis la sogs pa'i/ /sgyu 'phrul sgo nas grub pa brnyes pa yi/ /rgyud kyi rig 'dzin rnams la༞ /slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen man chad nas/ /bsnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes la sogs pa/ /gshin rje'i sgo nas grub pa brnyes pa yi/ /sku yi rig 'dzin rnams la༞ /slob dpon klu sgrub snying po man chad nas/ /btsun pa ngan lam rgyal mchog la sogs pa'i/ /padma'i sgo nas grub pa brnyes pa yi/ /gsung gi rig 'dzin rnams la༞ /slob dpon dur khrod bde ba man chad nas/ /bod kyi dge slong mi lnga la sogs pa'i/ /yang dag sgo nas grub pa brnyes pa yi/ /thugs kyi rig 'dzin rnams la༞ /tshangs pa dung gi gtsug tor man chad nas/ /bsnyegs chen ku ma rā dza la sogs pa'i/ /bdud rtsi'i sgo nas grub pa brnyes pa yi/ /yon tan rig 'dzin rnams la༞ /sems dpa' lha yi dbang po man chad nas/ /gzungs ma mkhar chen mtsho rgyal la sogs pa'i/ /phur pa'i sgo nas grub pa brnyes pa yis/ /'phrin las rig 'dzin༞ /ston pa mngon rdzogs rgyal po man chad nas/ /'brog mi dpal gyi ye shes la sogs pa'i/ /ma mo'i sgo nas grub pa brnyes pa yi/ /dam can rig 'dzin rnams la༞ /dge slong ku ku rā dza man chad nas/ /sog po dpal gyi ye shes la sogs pa'i/ /gzi mdangs sgo nas grub pa brnyes pa yi/ /tshe yi rig 'dzin rnams la༞ /slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes man chad nas/ /lha mchog dpal gyi ye shes la sogs pa'i/ /bsod nams sgo nas grub pa brnyes pa yi/ /tshogs kyi rig 'dzin rnams la༞ /de dag kun kyang theg pa so so yi/ /gang la sbyangs pa'i yon tan khyad par can/ /mi yi yul gyi sangs rgyas rin po che/ /rkang gnyis mchog gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /slob dpon padma 'byung gnas man chad nas/ /dpal ldan grub thob 'dar phyar la sogs pa'i/ /mkhyen rab sgo nas grub pa brnyes pa yi/

/byin rlabs rig 'dzin rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /byin rlabs bcud 'dus rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dpal/ /rgyud lung man ngag thugs su chud gyur cing / /rtogs tshad gdengs ldan bla ma rin po che/ /tha dad bzhugs nas bstan pa 'dzin skyong mdzad/ /bod kyi rig 'dzin rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /byin rlabs bcud 'dus rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dpal/ /dus gsum bde gshegs kun gyi phrin las ldan/ /chu bo bzhi 'dus kun dga' legs pa'i zhabs/ /zhes pa lta bu rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i mtshan bcug la/ padma dbang chen khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khyod kyi mthu rtsal nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /dug gsum nyon mongs rgyas pa'i sems can rnams/ /dbang drag phrin las bzhi yis 'dul ba bzhin/ /rnam smin stong mdzad sgrub mchog tshul bzhin rtsol/ /khyod kyi sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub rnams/ /sgrub mchog bdag cag rnams la stsal du gsol/ /dkon mchog spyi bskul ni/ rnam dag sku lnga ye shes lnga yi dngos/ /khyab bdag rang byung rgyal ba bcom ldan 'das/ /skyabs mchog dpal ldan bla ma he ru ka /dbyer med zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /yi dam lha dang dkon mchog gsum gyi dngos/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma mi mngon dbyings nas bzhengs/ /dur khrod gsang ba'i dbang drag dkyil 'khor du/ /thod pa dur khrod rin chen gzhal yas khang / /gnam lcags urmo'i brtser chen ta la ma/ /sprul pa'i lcang lo mang po'i kha bad can/ /bskal pa'i me ri smug nag 'tshub mar 'bar/ /mi ro thod phreng keng rus tshogs kyis brgyan/ /rakta'i rgya mtsho rba rlabs chil li li/ /rus chen tshogs kyi phung po khra la la/ /khrag dang zhag gi 'bab chu sil li li/ /rdo rje zhing chen dri ngad thu lu lu/ /tsitta gsar rnying rgyan thog ye re re/ /dbang chen khrag 'thung rgyal po 'khor dang bcas/ /sgrub sde brgyad kyi lha tshogs mang po dang / /ma mo mkha' 'gros bdag la byin gyis rlobs/

/sgrub pa'i rtags mtshan myur du bstan du gsol/ /chos nyid zhi ba'i tshul gyis don mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan zhi ba'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs/ /khro bo'i tshul gyi gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa/ /'bar ba khro bo'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs/ /skye med dmigs bral ngang las sku bzhengs pa/ /'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs/ /khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i las mdzad pa/ /padma gsung gi lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs/ /dus gsum bde gshegs kun gyi thugs kyi thugs/ /yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs༞ /dug lnga gtan bcom ye shes lnga sbyor ba'i/ /bdud rtsi yon tan lha tshogs༞ /gdug pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus tshar gcod pa'i/ /phur bu 'phrin las lha tshogs༞ /dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba 'dus pa yi/ /'dud pa mdo yi lha tshogs༞ /thabs dang shes rab dbyer med dges rol ba'i/ /ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs༞ /bstan la gnod byed bgegs rnams tshar bcad pa'i/ /dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs༞ /legs nyes btang 'dzin dam 'dzin rjes gcod pa'i/ /'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs༞ /rdo rje gdung chen rig 'dzin pho mo'i tshogs/ /mi mngon dbyings nas bzhengs la byin gyis rlobs/ /rtsi shing thams cad ye nas sman dang bcud/ /snang srid thams cad ye nas byang chub sems/ /stong gsum thams cad ye nas gzhal yas khang / /rgyud drug thams cad ye nas rgyal ba'i sku/ /sgra dbyangs thams cad ye nas sngags kyi sgra/ /ma sring srung ma ye nas bran dang g.yog /rbad cing bsngags so dam can mthu rtsal che/ /dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /dbang chen sgos bskul ni/ hrīḥ rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings las rang byung ba'i/ /dmar nag gru gsum dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas/ /padma 'khyil ba dbang chen khro bo'i sku/ /thugs rje thabs kyi sprul skur gshegs su gsol/

/bdud pho bdud mo byi chings bsnol ba'i steng / /ma chags padma nyi zla'i gdan steng na/ /dug gsum dbang bsgyur ye shes lnga yi lha/ /dbang chen khrag 'thung ha ya grī wa'i sku/ /sku mdog dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum rngams 'gying brjid pa'i sku/ /spyan gsum zhal bsgrad mche ba rab tu gtsigs/ /smin ma sma ra ag tshom me ltar 'bar/ /dbu skra ral pa kham nag gyen du 'khyil/ /spyi gtsug rta mgo ljang khu zil gnon rngams/ /rngog ma dmar po dbang gi rta skad 'tsher/ /g.yas dkar g.yon ljang dbus dmar rngams sgra sgrog /sku stod zhing chen glang chen ko rlon gsol/ /sku smad stag gi sham thabs bdud dpung 'dul/ /thod rlon tshar gsum phreng bas rgyan du mdzes/ /sbrul rigs bzhi yis dbu dang phyag zhabs spras/ /dang po padma bandhas dbang du sdud/ /bar pa lcags kyu zhags pas dmigs pa 'gugs/ /tha ma be con ral gris dgra bgegs sgrol/ /dbang drag me dpung klong dkyil rin chen spras/ /sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs par ldan/ /dbang chen gdug pa'i spyan rtsa ldog pa yis/ /snang srid dregs pa thams cad dbang du sdud/ /shangs nas rlung nag bskal pa'i 'tshub ma 'byung / /snang srid kun 'thor mthu chen drag rtsal 'dul/ /snyan nas bskal pa'i 'brug stong ldir ba yis/ /srid pa'i che btsan thams cad zil gyis gnon/ /tshems las drag po'i thog chen 'bebs pa yis/ /sdang dgra gdon bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog /zhal gsum rakta'i rgya mtsho 'khrug cing 'khyil/ /bstan pa shig pa'i dgra la skyin thang 'bebs/ /khro rgyal dbang gi rta skad tshe re re/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis che btsan dbang du sdud/ /padma dbang chen khrag 'thung mi zad pa/ /khyed kyi dbang drag 'phrin las dus la babs/ /sdang dgra gnod bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog /khro rgyal dbang chen sku yi g.yon phyogs nas/ /khro mo padma gar gyi dbang phyug ma/

/sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /spyan gsum khrag 'khyil zhal bsgrad mche ba gtsigs/ /dbu skra ral pa nag po mun ltar gtibs/ /sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs par ldan/ /phyag g.yas tsitta thogs nas yab la 'khyud/ /phyag g.yon dung chen dmar 'khyil gtso la stobs/ /khro mo kun gyi dbang phyug chen mo khyod/ /rngams pa'i nga ros thams cad zil gyis gnon/ /spyan nas khrag 'dzag zhal nas mi ro 'grul/ /snyan nas 'brug sgrogs shangs nas rlung nag 'tshub/ /khyed kyi dbang drag 'phrin las dus la babs/ /sdang dgra gnod bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog /hrīḥ yab yum thabs dang shes rab rol pa las/ /thugs kyi sprul pa dbang chen khro bo'i sku/ /shar phyogs 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs steng nas/ /dri za pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /rdo rje dbang chen dkar po khro bo'i sku/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs/ /spyan gsum zhal bsgrad mche gtsigs mi ro za/ /dbu skra kham nag gyen bsgreng sbrul gyis bcings/ /phyag g.yas rdo rjes dgra bgegs mgo lus bshog /phyag g.yon dbyug thos myos shing brgyal bar byed/ /me dpung klong na 'gying gar stabs su bzhugs/ /rngams pa'i nga ro 'brug stong ldi ri ri/ /thugs kyi sprul pas stong gsum khyab par 'gengs/ /khyed kyi dbang drag phrin las dus la babs/ /sdang sgra gdon bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog /yab yum thabs dang shes rab rol pa las/ /thugs kyi sprul pa dbang chen khro bo'i sku/ /lho phyogs 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs steng na/ /grul bum pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /rin chen dbang chen mthing nag khro bo'i sku/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs/ /spyan gsum zhal bsgrad mche gtsigs mi ro za/ /dbu skra kham nag gyen sgreng sbrul gyis bcings/ /phyag g.yas rin chen myu gus dgos 'dod bskong /

/phyag g.yon lcags kyus bla 'gugs tsitta 'byin/ /me dpung klong na 'gying gar stabs su bzhugs/ /rngams pa'i nga ro 'brug stong ldi ri ri/ /thugs kyi sprul pas stong gsum khyab par 'gengs/ /khyed kyi dbang drag phrin las dus la babs/ /sdang dgra gdon bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog /yab yum thabs dang shes rab rol pa las/ /thugs kyi sprul pa dbang chen khro bo'i sku/ /nub phyogs 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs steng na/ /klu dbang pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /padma dbang chen dmar nag khro bo'i sku/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs/ /spyan gsum zhal bsgrad mche gtsigs mi ro za/ /dbu skra kham nag gyen brdzes sbrul gyis bcings/ /phyag g.yas padmas che btsan dbang du sdud/ /phyag g.yon zhags pas lus dang yan lag 'chings/ /me dpung klong na 'gying gar stabs su bzhugs/ /rngams pa'i nga ro 'brug stong ldi ri ri/ /thugs kyis sprul pas stong gsum khyab par 'gengs/ /khyed kyi dbang drag 'phrin las dus la babs/ /sdang dgra gnod bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog /yab yum thabs dang shes rab rol pa las/ /thugs kyi sprul pa dbang chen khro bo'i sku/ /byang phyogs 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs steng na/ /gnod sbyin pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /las rab dbang chen ljang nag khro bo'i sku/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs/ /spyan gsum zhal bsgrad mche gtsigs mi ro za/ /dbu skra kham nag gyen brdzes sbrul gyis bcings/ /phyag g.yas ral gris rtsa dang srog gzugs gcod/ /phyag g.yon kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum dug gsum sgrol/ /me dpung klong na 'gying gar stabs su bzhugs/ /rngams pa'i nga ro 'brug stong ldi ri ri/ /thugs kyi sprul pas stong gsum khyab par 'gengs/ /khyod kyi dbang drag 'phrin las dus la babs/ /sdang dgra gnod bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog /hrīḥ shar phyogs dung gi sgo 'khyud nas/

/sgo ma dkar mo 'jigs tshul can/ /khrag gi ral pa sha ra ra/ /phyag g.yas lcags kyu dgra snying 'byin/ /g.yon pa mi snying dmar po bsnams/ /rings par khug cig aṃ ku sha dzaḥ /lho phyogs gser gyi sgo 'khyud nas/ /sgo ma ser mo 'jigs tshul can/ /g.yu yi ral pa sha ra ra/ /phyag g.yas zhags pas yan lag 'ching / /g.yon pa mi snying dmar po bsnams/ /'chings shig sdoms shig pa sha hūm̐/ /nub phyogs zangs kyi sgo 'khyud nas/ /sgo ma dmar mo 'jigs tshul can/ /mthing gi ral pa sha ra ra/ /phyag g.yas lcags sgrog tshe srog sdom/ /g.yon pa mi snying dmar po bsnams/ /rten la bstims shig spho ṭa baṃ/ /byang phyogs g.yu yi sgo 'khyud nas/ /sgo ma ljang mo 'jigs tshul can/ /gser gyi ral pa sha ra ra/ /phyag g.yas dril bus brgyal bar byed/ /g.yon pa mi snying dmar po bsnams/ /myos par gyis shig gaṇḍe hoḥ hrīḥ /bcom ldan padma he ru ka /dbang chen thugs kyi sprul pa las/ /srog bdag 'od kyi rgyal po byung / /skyes mchog 'od kyi mi bo che/ /sku la seng ge slog pa gsol/ /dbu la byi dar dkar po bcings/ /nam mkha' 'ja' yi ske rags can/ /lcags kyi sder mos dgra snying 'byin/ /g.yas pa ral gris dgra srog gcod/ /g.yon pa 'od kyi zhags pa 'phen/ /dgra bo'i tshe srog don snying phyungs/ /bskul lo drag tu dgra srog chod/ /dam nyams ma btang sho ra re/ /shar gyi dkar po dam tshig can/ /chibs su dkar po ngang ring chibs/ /sku la dar dkar ral ka gsol/ /dbu la dung gi thor gtsug can/ /phyag g.yas shel gyi gri ring rnams/ /g.yon pa zhags pa dgra la 'debs/ /tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can/ /dgra bo'i lha phrol don snying phyungs/ /bskul lo drag tu dgra srog gcod/ /dam nyams ma btang sho ra re/ /lho yi dge bsnyen dam tshig can/ /chibs su khams pa lag dkar chibs/ /sku la za 'og sngo khra gsol/ /dbu la bse man 'gying thod bcings/

/phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje bsnams/ /g.yon pa tsitta dmar po thogs/ /gying chen rdo rje bshog rgod rtsal/ /dgra bo'i snying phyungs don snying chod/ /bskul lo drag tu dgra srog chod/ /dam nyams ma btang sho ra re/ /nub kyi bdud nag dam tshig can/ /chibs su bdud rta nag po chibs/ /sku la lcags kyi zhun khrab gsol/ /dbu la bdud zhwa mchin nag gsol/ /phyag g.yas bdud kyi khram shing bsnams/ /g.yon pas zhags pa dgra la 'debs/ /nag po gsod byed bdud kyi bu/ /dgra bo'i tshe srog khram la thob/ /bskul lo drag tu dgra srog chod/ /dam nyams ma btang sho ra re/ /byang gi srog bdag dam tshig can/ /chibs su bse yi ra skyes chibs/ /sku la bse khrab dmar po gsol/ /dbu la bse rmog zangs ri gsol/ /phyag g.yas zangs kyi gri rings bsnams/ /g.yon pa zhags pa dgra la 'debs/ /se to srog gcod lag dmar gyis/ /dgra bo'i mdangs 'phrogs srog rtsa chod/ /bskul lo drag tu dgra srog chod/ /dam nyams ma btang sho ra re/ /hrīḥ padma'i rgyal po rta mchog dpal/ /khro rgyal khrag 'thung he ru ka /thugs kyi sprul pa mi zad pa/ /skyin thang chu 'khyags mnga' bdag khyod/ /khyab 'jug chen po rā hu la/ /byi ta se ta sgra gcan 'dzin/ /du ba mjug ring khyab 'jug ste/ /drang srong chen po kun tu rgyu/ /gza' rgod drag po skyin thang bdag /dud kha mgo dgu srin po'i gzugs/ /mgo lus med pa mig gis khengs/ /ro stod mi la ro smad sbrul/ /ro stod mi yis lha lus len/ /ro smad sbrul gyis rgya mtsho 'khrug /phyag g.yas skyin thang 'khor lo bsnams/ /phyag g.yon chu srin zhags pa 'phen/ /dgra yul lo tog rdul du rlog /phyogs bzhi nam mkha'i klong yangs nas/ /ngan sngags bdag mo khyed bzhi yang / /shar gyi stag srin zor ba gdong / /lho yi bam srin dred mo gdong / /nub kyi kong srin ba lang gdong / /byang gi 'brog srin chu srin gdong /

/ngan sngags bdag mo bzhi po ni/ /g.yas pa zor la g.yon na rkyal/ /skyin thang chu rgod mnga' bdag mo/ /dgra bo'i lo thog snar ma la/ /chu rgod 'khyags pa'i skyin thang phob/ /dgra yul thal ba rdul du rlog /bskul lo drag tu dgra srog chod/ /dam nyams ma btang sho ra re/ /dam rdzas gtor ma 'di long la/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis bcol ba yi/ /'phrin las thams cad grub par mdzod/ /padma'i rgyal po rta mchog dpal/ /khro rgyal khrag 'thung he ru ka /thugs kyi sprul pa mi zad pa/ /gnod sbyin zangs kyi beg rtse can/ /sku mdog dmar nag srin po'i gzugs/ /phyag g.yas zangs ral dgra srog gcod/ /g.yon pa dam nyams glo snying gsol/ /rngams shing drag po'i chas kun rdzogs/ /dbang gi mdog can mthu rtsal can/ /khyod kyi thugs dam dus la babs/ /dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog /dam rdzas gtor ma 'di long la/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis bcol ba yi/ /'phrin las thams cad grub par mdzod/ /rig pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma/ /gshin rje gshed kyi bka' nyan ma/ /e ka dza ṭi'i gsung bstod ma/ /ma mo 'bum gyi dbang phyug ma/ /srin mo lus nag gdong pa dmar/ /me ral chongs dang mu men brgyan/ /g.yas pa zangs gris dgra srog gcod/ /g.yon pa lcags phur bgegs dpung 'joms/ /mi zan dred zhon stong gsum myul/ /mi sdug rgyan dang cha lugs 'chang / /khyed kyi thugs dam dus la babs/ /nga yi nor gyi gting la rgyug /dam nyams dgra la cho 'phrul thong / /dgra bgegs༞ /dam rdzas༞ /rnal 'byor༞ /'phrin las༞ /srog bdag che btsan dmar po ni/ /drag po'i las la thog bas myur/ /rnal 'byor 'phrin las kun sgrub cing / /dam nyams dgra la bya ra byed/ /mi sdug srin po khros pa'i gzugs/ /bse rmog bse khrab lus la gyon/ /g.yas pa mdung gi dmag dpung sdud/ /g.yon pa zhags pas dgra bgegs 'ching / /khyod kyi thugs dam dus la babs/ /bstan la gnod byed myur du sgrol/

/dgra bgegs༞ /dam rdzas༞ /rnal 'byor༞ /'phrin las༞ /gzhan yang gri thogs gying chen brgyad/ /srog gcod rol bshan nyi shu gcig /bdud srin gnod sbyin sum stong dang / /ma mo 'bum dang the'u rang stong / /dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs rnams/ /drag tu bskul zhing rbad pa'i tshe/ /gang la dmigs pa sho ra re/ /dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog /dam rdzas gtor ma 'di long la/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis bcol ba yi/ /phrin las thams cad grub par mdzod/ /ces bskul la rnga rol bzhag skabs 'dir phyag len la o rgyan rin po che padma 'byung gnas kyi gsol 'debs le bdun ma mdzad/ gnyis pa dbang bskur dgos na kho bos brtsams pa'i mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge smin byed dbang gi nyi 'od ltar bya zhing / mkhas grub 'ga' zhig bdag 'jug bzhed kyang / bla chen chos dpal ba'i dbang chu ma dag pa'i dri ma 'khrud byed las/ slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug pa ni/ chos 'di lugs kyi gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor gnyis su med pa sgrub pa nyid ka la byed cing zhes gsungs pas bdag 'jug mi dgos so/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du ras la sogs pa'i khud yangs par bting la/ 'bru bkram pa'i dbus su padma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i lte bar me tog gi tshom bu gcig bkod/ shar gyi 'dab ma la tshogs 'bag dkar zlum rgyan can snod dang bcas pa/ lhor khur ba sogs rdzas ser ba'i rigs/ nub tu maṃ sa sogs dmar ba'i rigs/ byang du dza gad sogs btung ba'i rigs dang / mtshams kyi 'dam ma mtha' bskor gyi khud dang bcas pa sna tshogs rdzas gang yod ci bder bshams/ bsang chu sbyangs/ oṃ raṃ kro dha rakṣa badzra dzwa la raṃ/ tig na bi shwa dzwa la raṃ/ phaṭa raṃ raṃ/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ bhrūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ mahā ratna ka ma la bi shuddhe hūm̐/ lan gcig zhes pas yo byad kyi bgegs dang mi gtsang ba sbyangs/

snod thod pa'i nang du bcud sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga'i ngo bor bsam la/ rnga rol dang bcas pas tshogs zhing spyan drangs pa ni/ hūm̐/ rang bzhin rnam dag dbyings nyid las/ /sprul pa'i khro bo mi zad pa/ /padma dbang chen dkyil 'khor lha/ /longs spyod tshogs la gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ e hye hi bha ga wan/ mahā ka ru ṇi ka mahā padma shwa ra sa pa ri wa ra badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ padma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ spyir 'bul ba ni/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te/ /dam tshig bzhin la ci bder bzhes su gsol/ /mahā padma shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ/ dhū paṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ di paṃ/ gandhaṃ/ nai wi daṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ hūm̐/ 'di na sna tshogs gzugs mchis te/ /gzugs kyi lha mo me long ma/ /me long las kyang gzugs rnams 'byung / /mang po bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i khams bkang ste/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi spyan la 'bul/ /gzugs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /a la la ste dges par mdzod/ /'di na sna tshogs sgra mchis te/ /sgra yi lha mo pi waṃ ma/ /pi waṃ las kyang sgra rnams 'byung / /mang po bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i khams bkang nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi snyan la 'bul/ /sgra yi mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /a la la ste dges par mdzod/ /'di na sna tshogs dri mchis te/ /dri yi lha mo spos khang ma/ /spos khang las kyang dri rnams 'byung / /mang po bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i khams bkang nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi shangs la dbul/ /dri yi mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /a la la ste dges par mdzod/ /'di na sna tshogs ro mchis te/ /ro yi lha mo zhal zas ma/ /zhal zas las kyang ro rnams 'byung / /mang po bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i khams bkang nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi ljags la 'bul/

/ro yi mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /a la la ste dges par mdzod/ /'di na sna tshogs reg mchis te/ /reg gi lha mo na bza' ma/ /na bza' las kyang reg rnams 'byung / /mang po bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i khams bkang nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi sku la 'bul/ /reg gi mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /a la la ste dges par mdzod/ /'di na sna tshogs chos mchis te/ /chos kyi lha mo po ti ma/ /po ti las kyang chos rnams 'byung / /mang po bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i khams bkang nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi thugs la 'bul/ /chos kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /a la la ste dges par mdzod/ /bye brag tu 'bul ba ni/ las kyi rdo rjes tshogs phud tsho gsum bcos pa'i dang po de snod gsum du bgos la/ dkyil 'khor gyi drung stegs kyi khar bshams/ hrīḥ sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung ba dang / /rgod dang gshe dang 'jigs par byed pa dang / /snying rje rngams dang zhi ba la sogs pa/ /sku yi dngos po shin tu bsgyur ba ni/ /gar bcas sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gar gyi dbang phyug gtso bo che/ /zla ba la sogs snying po can/ /maṃ sa la sogs ro mchog gsol/ /me tog la sogs tsandan dri/ /bzang dgu 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /mi mo rnams kyi reg bya mchog /byin gyis rlobs shig rnal 'byor pa/ /sgrub pa'i rdzas 'di thams cad la/ /hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyis ldan par mdzod/ /mahā padma shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha raṃ khā hi/ bar pa gshegs te 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dgongs su gsol/ /bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis/ /bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur te/ /padma dbang chen dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi/ /thugs dang 'gal ba'i las rnams ci bgyis pa/ /thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol/ /bzod par gsol te tshangs pa stsal du gsol/ /tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/

/rnga rol bzhag la/ oṃ padma shrī he ru ka sogs yig brgya lan gsum bzla mkha' la btab ste phul ba ni/ lcags snod la sogs par liṅga bshams pa slob dpon gyi mdun du bzhag slob dpon gyis rdor dril hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas bzung / las rdor gyis gu gul gdugs la/ e raṃ/ phaṭa raṃ/ dzwa la raṃ/ rnir dza/ tri dza/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bka'༞ chos kyi bka'༞ dge 'dun gyi༞ bcom ldan 'das padma dbang chen khrag 'thung lha dgu 'khor za byed bka' nyan gyi tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / rnal 'byor pa bdag gi sngags dang phyag rgya dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi byin rlabs dang / chos nyid rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing / chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ spyir bstan pa'i spyi dgra/ bla ma'i sku dgra/ dam tshig can gyi sdang dgra/ sems can yongs la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa dang / khyad par du yang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor yon mchod grogs mched 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gzugs can gyi dgra/ gzugs med kyi bgegs gang yin pa de dag thams cad skad cig thang cig yud tsam la gzugs dang liṅga 'di la mchis par gyur cig zhes dang / drag rol bya zhing / dgug gzhug gi phyag rgya liṅga'i steng du 'bebs pa'i stangs ka dang / pra be sha ya phaṭa/ a be sha ya a/ de 'dra lan gsum mam gcig byas la/ rnga rol dang bcas pas/ dzaḥ dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs/ /nga dpal khrag 'thung he ru ka /thugs rje thugs dam rgyud bskul ba/ /'jig rten thams cad bsgral ba'i phyir/ /'jig rten thams cad dur khrod 'bar/ /bza' rgyu thams cad sha khrag tshogs/ /gzugs snang thams cad he ru ka /mi rtog thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/

/bcom ldan padma he ru ka /thugs rje thugs dam rgyud bskul nas/ /ye shes rol cing gshegs su gsol/ /dzaḥ yab gcig sku mdog dmar ba ni/ /rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dbu la rdzogs/ /phyag rgya thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /lcags gri nag po phyag na bsnams/ /sgrol gying chen por dam bcas pa/ /nag po 'bum gyi bdag po ste/ /mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi dbus na 'gying / /mi ro 'bum gyi khri steng na/ /rta ro 'bum ni bcal du bkram/ /zas su de ni sha chen za/ /skom du de ni khrag 'thung ngo / /mtha' dag bsgral ba'i rgyu yin te/ /'di yi snying po 'bum bzlas na/ /gcig tu de ni dgra la 'jabs/ /gnyis su de ni bgegs la 'jabs/ /skyes bu chen po'i 'phrul gyi sras/ /gnod bgegs 'dul ba'i dus la babs/ /dzaḥ dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs/ /sprul pa chen po'i dus la babs/ /phyag brnyan chen po'i dus la babs/ /bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs/ /khyod kyi dam tshig dus la babs/ /mthu rtsal dbyung ba'i dus la babs/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung gsob pa/ /rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams la ni/ /gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa dang / /dngos grub 'phrog cing 'tshe ba rnams/ /khro bo chen pos byin gyis brlabs/ /yud tsam gyis ni 'dir khug la/ /mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral ba dang / /lus ngag rdul du brlag par mdzod/ /zungs shig sdoms shig rnam par 'chings/ /rtogs shig grogs dang bral bar gyis/ /phob cig rnam par gzir bar gyis/ /'di la byang chub sems med kyis/ /gzhan du nam yang btang mi bya/ /byang chub sems su btang bar bya/ /nga yi dbang du bsdus la shog /chems rol dang / pra be sha ya phaṭa/ a be sha ya a/ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badzra pa sha hūm̐/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badzra gaṇḍe hoḥ lha dbye ba ni/ gu gul sogs la/ bhyoḥ gnyan po kun sgrol dam tshig can/
