/'go ba'i lha rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /gu gul sbyar ba'i rdzas mchog 'dis/ /srog lha gnam du yar du chug /dgra lha rgya mtsho'i gting du bsgyur/ /pho lha rdog pa'i 'og tu gnon/ /zhang lha rgya mtsho'i khrigs la bskyol/ /mo lha srog rtsa myur du chod/ /gu gul sbyar ba'i rdzas mchog gis/ /me dgu'i lha dang phrol la shog /'bob dud pho lha'i gshed ma gyis/ /rgya tshil dgra lha'i gshed ma gyis/ /yungs kar srog lha'i gshed ma gyis/ /ra ru mo lha'i gshed ma gyis/ /zhab ma'i zhang lha'i gshed ma gyis/ /gu gul sbyar ba'i rdzas mchog gis/ /dgra bo'i dam tshig nyams su chug /mahā gu gul pra ta la hūm̐ phaṭa/ chems rol dang bstun/ gu gul gyis bdug yungs thun dbab pa ni/ slob dpon gyis yungs kar sogs la/ hrīḥ yungs kar rgyal po gser sgong 'dra/ /sku ni gser mdog 'od zer 'phro/ /yan lag med pa bdud la bsdo/ /kha mig med pa stong khams bskor/ /sngags 'chang bdag gi mtshon cha ste/ /ma mo rnams kyi mtshon cha yin/ /sde brgyad yongs kyi pho nya yin/ /steng gi phyogs su yar 'phangs pas/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskong / /'og gi phyogs su mar 'phangs pas/ /ngan song gsum gyi sgo yang gcod/ /bar snang khams su phar 'phangs pas/ /dgra bo skyob pa'i lha dang phrol/ /ring par rgyug cig pho nya'i tshogs/ /ri rab 'di ni 'gul zhing 'deg /rgya mtsho 'di ni 'chol zhing rnyog /bhyoḥ gnod sbyin rgyal po sprul pa'i sras/ /nyung kar ye shes sprul pa'i mda'/ /thugs rje'i klong nas phar 'phangs pas/ /dgra bo'i gzugs phung 'ben la rgyob/ /dkar nag snying ga'i dkyil du rgyob/ /shig shig dum bur nyil nyil rgyob/ /khro chung gtams pa'i yungs kar 'di/ /yid kyis ye shes sprul pa'i mda'/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis byin gyis brlabs/ /yengs pa med par 'phangs pa yis/ /dgra bo'i nang khrol 'ben la rgyob/

/dum bu tul phaṭa/ dum bu nyal rbad/ yan lag 'ching ba'i yungs kar 'di/ /phyag rgya rol pa'i mda' brgyangs te/ /'phro 'du cir yang 'gyur ba'i mda'/ /dgra bo'i yan lag 'ben la rgyob/ /thuṃ ril bhyoḥthuṃ ril bhyoḥ dbang po len pa'i yungs kar 'di/ /rig pa'i rgyal po thul gyi mda'/ /rig pa'i dbyings nas 'phangs pa yis/ /dgra bo'i dbang po'i mig la rgyob/ /thim ya thim ya/ rnam shes gcod pa'i yungs dkar 'di/ /sngags kyi rgyal po bram ze'i mda'/ /dgug 'dren pho nya'i mda' brgyang ste/ /dgra bo'i rnam shes 'ben la rgyob/ /hrul hrul srog srog bhyo bhyoḥ zhes brjod la sngags rnams la chems rol dang bstun yungs kar brdegs/ rnga rol bzhag lcags sam seng ldeng gi phur pa lag tu thog la/ oṃ shu n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ padma maṇḍal/ ma surya maṇḍal/ padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥspha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ oṃ padma kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ padma kī la ya sku mdog dmar po dmar dkar ljang ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ dang po gnyis padma dang bandha/ bar pa gnyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis phur pa bsgril ba/ dpal chen po'i chas dang / dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ sku smad zur gsum dbal dang ldan pa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ padma he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ padma he ru ka dmar po padma dang dril bu 'dzin pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ rdor thal gyis phur pa bsgril la/ bdag dang phur pa'i gnas gsum gyi oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ oṃ dipta tsakra ha na ha na oṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku thim/ sku'i sgo nas khams gsum dus gcig la sgrol ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/

sor mo sbub mo'i lag thil gyis phur pa bsgril la/ hrīḥ phur pa ta āḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung thim/ gsung gi sgo nas khams gsum dus gcig la sgrol ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ sor mo bsnol ba'i gung mos phur pa bsgril la/ oṃ badzra satwa hūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs thim/ thugs kyi sgo nas khams gsum dus gcig la sgrol ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ka ya wakka tsitta tiṣṭha badzra/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rnam par thim pas nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par gyur/ phur pa'i dbal la yungs kar gtor la/ oṃ padma kī li kī la ya pe ta li maṇḍal rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ mthu dang ldan par gyur/ phur pa gu gul gyis bdugs la/ oṃ padma kī li kī la ya ma gu ta ma pra ta la a tiṣṭha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ gzi mdangs dang ldan par gyur/ phur pa'i dbal la rakta gtor la/ oṃ padma kī li kī la ya mahā rakta dzwa la mā na hūm̐ phaṭa/ badzra ki ta/ thugs rje chags pa dang ldan par gyur/ rnga rol dang bcas/ phur bskul ni/ hūm̐/ 'dod chags khros me dmar nag 'bar/ /gru gsum 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /sras mchog padma kī la ya/ /rdo rje gzhon nu sku bzhengs shig /bdud dang log 'dren 'dul ba'i phyir/ /drag po phur pa'i tshul du bzhengs/ /dam nyams gnod byed dgra bgegs 'di/ /dang po zhe sdang pha yis bskyed/ /bar du 'dod chags ma yis bskyed/ /tha ma dug gsum lus su grub/ /dug gsum rtsad nas bcad pa'i phyir/ /dkar nag snying gi mtshams shed na/ /mi yi snying po ṇi khug la/ /bgegs kyi snying po tri khug la/ /ṇi tri'i dkyil du mā ra ya/ /'chings shig sdoms la dbang du bsdus/ /zil gyis gnon la ma btang zhig /hūm̐/ yang cig rbad cing bskul ba ni/ /rang byung ye shes sprul pa'i sku/

/rta mgrin dmar nag dgra bgegs sgrol/ /sku stod zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /sku smad zur gsum phur pa'i dbal/ /rta mgrin thugs ni gsod la dga'/ /gnod byed dgra bgegs gang yin pa'i/ /snying gi dkyil du mā ra ya/ /khyod kyi sprul pa'i pho nya ni/ /kun kyang khro bo chen po la/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis phur pa bsgril/ /sku smad zur gsum phur pa'i dbal/ /sa dang nam mkha' kun khang nas/ /kun kyang dgra bgegs sgrol la brtson/ /gnod byed dgra bgegs gang yin gyis/ /rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog zhom phyir/ /yan lag kun la mā ra ya/ /zhes brjod la rol mo bya zhing / slob dpon gyis phur bu bsgril la/ oṃ maṃ hūm̐ laṃ taṃ bha nan/ ma ho gha ta ya/ bha ga wan hriḥṣṭi/ wi kri badzra hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐/ badzra kī li kī la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sarba bigha nan/ badzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ dmigs pa ni/ bdag dang dkyil 'khor phur pa'i gnas gsum gyi a las a khra mo 'od zer dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs la a'i rnam par bzhugs/ bdag dang dkyil 'khor dang phur pa gsum la thim pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib gnyis sbyangs sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob par gyur/ yang dag dang dkyil 'khor dang phur pa'i gnas gsum gyi a las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi sgrib gnyis sbyangs/ srid gsum thams cad a'i rang bzhin can dngul chu ltar zhu/ zas pa po la thim pas/ zas pa po'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ rnam par shes pa a yig dkar po'i rnam pa can du gyur/ khrus lung gsum mo/ /de nas liṅga'i snying khar ma reg tsam bsgril zhing mthar btsugs la/ oṃ gha gha/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣṭan mā ra ya phaṭa/ kī li kī la ya sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ padma kī li kī la ya/ padma dha rod a dzñā pa ya ti ka ya wakka tsitta/

padma kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ padma kī li kī la ya hūm̐ gnod byed dgra bgegs mā ra ya phaṭa/ phur pa rang gi gnas gsum du reg a bo dhi tsitta oṃḥ a bo dhi tsitta āḥ a bo dhi tsitta hūm̐/ de dag gi dmigs pa ni/ zas pa po'i tshe dang bsod nams thams cad bdag la thim/ sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob par gyur/ slar yang phur pa bsgril la snying khar btsugs te/ sgrub bya'i rnam par shes pa a yig gi rnam par slar rang nyid dpal chen du gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud yum gyi mkhar thig le las hūm̐ du gyur/ phur rtse nam mkha' la bstan la/ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ hūm̐/ phyir 'phros 'og min gyi rigs lnga yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pa'i mkha' nang du zhugs/ der hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje sems dpa' rang rigs kyi dbu rgyan can du gyur/ tshe lung gnyis dang rnam shes spar ba'o/ /yang rnga rol bzhag la slob dpon gyis ral gri bzung / oṃ shū n+yā ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ padma maṇḍa la/ ma surya maṇḍa la/ padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ oṃ ya manta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ gshin rje gshed sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas ral gri dang / g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thil/ hūm̐ badzra he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ badzra he ru ka sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭi wi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ gshin rje gshed zhu ba las byung ba'i ral grir gyur/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭi wi kri tā na na dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya nā sha ya satwaṃ bha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/

rnga rol dang bcas/ dbang chen thog mda' thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /ye shes mtshon cha lnga yi char phab pas/ /dug lnga bdud rtsi lnga ru dag byas te/ /ye shes lnga yi lha tshogs mnyes par bya/ /hūm̐ bhrūm̐/ oṃ bhrūm̐/ traṃ bhrūm̐/ hrīḥbhrūm̐/ ā bhrūṃ/ zhes brjod la liṅga gtubs/ btab pa ni ling ro bsnam la/ hrīḥ dmar nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas/ /bcom ldan padma dbang chen ni/ /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad/ /phyag drug mtshon chas rgyud drug sgrol/ /rab gtum mi zad khros pa yis/ /zhal gsum rngams pa'i zhal gdangs shig /zhal ni hom khung gdangs pa 'dra/ /tshems ni gangs ri gtams pa 'dra/ /mche ba zangs phur zhibs pa 'dra/ /ljags ni hor gzar brkyang pa 'dra/ /nyams pa btab bo kha raṃ khā hi/ /nyams pa bsgral ba'i las mdzod cig /yum chen khro mo zhal gdangs shig /gar gyi dbang phyug zhal du btab/ /rdo rje rigs mchog zhal gdangs shig /mthu chen rngams pa'i zhal du btab/ /rin chen rigs mchog zhal gdangs shig /ser nag 'khrug pa'i zhal du btab/ /padma rigs mchog zhal gdangs shig /dmar nag 'khyil ba'i zhal du btab/ /las kyi rigs mchog zhal gdangs shig /ljang nag khros pa'i zhal du btab/ /mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi'i zhal gdangs shig /sring mo bzhi yi zhal du btab/ /bsgral ba'i zhing bcur gyur pa yi/ /gzugs can sgra dang gzugs med bgegs/ /dbang chen lha dgu'i zhal du btab/ /zhal du btab bo kha raṃ khā hi/ /mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ mahā ba liṃ ta khā hi/ mahā maṃ sa khā hi/ mahā rakta khā hi/ mahā tsitta khā hi/ mahā ba su ta khā hi/ mahā keṃ ni ri ti khā hi/ mahā go ro tsa na kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes brjod la/ dkyil 'khor la tshogs phud gsum phul ba'i tha ma de 'bul lo/ /de dag ni bsgral mchod rgyas pa'i phyogs yin la/ bsdu na gong du phul ba'i tshogs phud gsum pa de nyid la dgug gzhug dang bsgral mchod kyi dmigs pa byas nas 'bul ba yin pas/

de'i tshul ni/ dgug gzhug gong bzhin la/ tshogs tha ma 'di la mchis par gyur cig /ces bya/ rnga rol dang bcas/ sprul pa'i khro bo 'bar ba yi/ /zhing bcu ma lus thams cad dang / /'khor ba'i nyon mongs rgya bsgral nas/ /dug lnga dbyings su bsgral bar bya/ /a mu ka mā ra ya phaṭa/ hūm̐/ zhing gyur thams cad rang bzhin bsgral/ /sha khrag srog dbugs mchod pa 'di/ /padma dbang chen dkyil 'khor la/ /mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ mahā maṃ sa khā hi/ mahā rakta khā hi/ mahā tsitta khā hi/ mahā ba su ta khā hi/ mahā go ro tsa na khā hi/ mahā kaṃ ni ri ti khā hi/ mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes pas nang mchod dang / de nas tshogs bar pa de las kyi rdo rjes dpon slob rnams la 'gyed la/ rang rang gi lag tu bzung la/ smon lam gdab pa ni/ ho bdag cag rdo rje slob dpon mched dang lcam dral rnams kyis/ mahā maṃ sa gsol ba la brten nas rdo rje sems dpa'i sku tshe dang lang 'tsho la mnga' brnyes par gyur cig dza gad dpa' bo la gsol ba la brten nas 'gro ba mang po dbang du 'dus par gyur cig zhal zas kyi bye brag mang po gsol ba la brten nas dpal chen po padma dbang chen gyi rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mnga' brnyes par gyur cig ces brjod la tshims par rol ba ste/ de yang rab chos nyid la chos nyid kyis rol/ 'bring ye shes la ye shes kyis rol/ tha ma lha la lhas mchod pa'i tshul du rol cing las kyi rdo rjes lhag ma ma bsdus kyi bar du snod stong par mi 'jog tshogs khang du yod pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo phan tshun rtsod pa dang / kha shags mi bya/ sems dga' ba'i gtam dang / chos kyi 'brel gtam la sogs pa bya'o/ bla ma'i grogs la ma zhus par phyir mi 'gro/ tha mal gyi 'du shes mi byed/ lha pho mo'i 'du shes dang ma bral bar bya/ rnal 'byor pho mo rnams la bzang ngan gyi rnam rtog mi bya bar mi byed zhing /

snod gcig nas bza' bar byed/ byin gyis brlab pa'i rdzas la gtsang mi gtsang gi rnam rtog mi bya/ kun mchod pa'i bsam pas ci dgar dpyad par bya'o/ /las kyi rdo rjes tshogs kyi lhag ma thams cad snod gcig tu bsdus/ thog mar tshan pa gsum du bgos pa'i dang po'ang cha gsum ni btab bshags bsgral gsum/ bar pa rnal 'byor pas longs spyad/ mtha' ma'ang cha gsum gyi dang po de tshogs phud kyi drung du bzhag phud kyi gnas gsal btab pa ni/ bhrūm̐ bi sha bi shuddhe dzñā na tsakra maṇḍa la bhrūm̐/ hrīḥbadzra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ mahā kro dhi shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra shwa ra kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ratna shwa ra kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ padma shwa ra kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ karma shwa ra kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badzra pa sha hūm̐/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ gaṇḍe hoḥ thugs dam bskul ba ni/ slar yang gtso bo nas byang sgo'i bar gyi sngags rnams tshar gcig brjod/ oṃ mahā padma shwa ra sa pa ri wa ra arghaṃ nas/ shapda'i bar gyis phyi mchod/ yar gnas rnams kyi zhal du/ mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hiḥ mahā ba liṃ ta khā hi/ mahā rakta khā hi/ gtor ma phul nas/ hrīḥ dmar nag gru gsum dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas/ /bcom ldan dpal chen padma he ru ka /'khor du dregs pa'i tshogs rnams 'bum gyis bskor/ /dbang chen rngams pa'i gnas nas sku bzhengs la/ /dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /thun mong mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /dbyings nyid rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /yum chen padma gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ /'khor du ma mo chen mo 'bum gyis bskor/ /ma tshogs gnas nas 'khor bcas sku bzhengs la/ /dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /thun mong༞ /gnod pa'i༞ /rnal 'byor༞ /shar phyogs 'khor lo dri za'i gdan steng du/

/sprul pa'i khro rgyal rdo rje dbang chen yang / /'khor du dri za'i tshogs rnams 'bum gyis bskor/ /dri za'i gnas nas 'khor bcas sku bzhengs la/ /thun mong༞ /gnod pa'i༞ /rnal 'byor༞ /lho phyogs 'khor lo grul bum gdan steng du/ /sprul pa'i khro rgyal rin chen dbang chen yang / /'khor du grul bum tshogs rnams 'bum gyis bskor/ /grul bum gnas nas 'khor bcas sku bzhengs la/ /dam rdzas༞ /thun mong༞ /gnod pa'i༞ /rnal 'byor༞ /nub phyogs 'khor lo klu dbang gdan steng du/ /sprul pa'i khro rgyal padma dbang chen la/ /'khor du klu dbang tshogs rnams 'bum gyis bskor/ /klu rgyal gnas nas 'khor bcas sku bzhengs la/ /dam rdzas༞ /thun mong༞ /gnod pa'i༞ /rnal 'byor༞ /byang phyogs 'khor lo gnod sbyin gdan steng du/ /sprul pa'i khro rgyal las rab dbang chen la/ /'khor du gnod sbyin tshogs rnams 'bum gyis bskor/ /gnod sbyin gnas nas 'khor bcas sku bzhengs la/ /dam rdzas༞ /thun mong༞ /gnod pa'i༞ /rnal 'byor༞ /thams cad zhi bar byed pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /shar phyogs sgo ma chen mo lcags kyu ma/ /'khor du rang 'dra'i dkar mo 'bum gyis bskor/ /dung gi sgo 'khyud gnas nas sku bzhengs la/ /dam rdzas༞ /thun mong༞ /gnod pa'i༞ /rnal 'byor༞ /thams cad rgyas par byed pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /lho phyogs sgo ma chen mo zhags pa ma/ /'khor du rang 'dra'i ser mo 'bum gyis bskor/ /gser gyi sgo 'khyud gnas nas sku bzhengs la/ /dam rdzas༞ /thun mong༞ /gnod pa'i༞ /rnal 'byor༞ /thams cad dbang du byed pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /nub phyogs sgo ma chen mo lcags sgrog ma/ /'khor du rang 'dra'i dmar mo 'bum gyis bskor/ /zangs kyi sgo 'khyud gnas nas sku bzhengs la/ /dam rdzas༞ /thun mong༞ /gnod pa'i༞ /rnal 'byor༞ /thams cad drag po'i las kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /byang phyogs sgo ma chen mo dril bu ma/

/'khor du rang 'dra'i ljang mo 'bum gyis bskor/ /g.yu yi sgo 'khyud gnas nas sku bzhengs la/ /dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /thun mong mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /gong du chos srung spyi sger gyi bskang ba byed na skabs 'dir spyi btab kyi gtor ma 'bul zhing tshogs phud dang gnyis dang / lhag ma'i dang po de'ang phyir phul/ mar gyi gnas la sbyin pa ni/ rang gi ya rkan nyi ma'i steng du 'od dpag med dang / ma rkan zla ba'i steng du gos dkar mor bsam la yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ sbyor mtshams nas byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun 'bebs pa ni/ ngag tu/ dpags chen po'i pham 'bags la dbang ba'i lha'i tshogs rnams 'dir gshegs shig e hye hi dzaḥdzaḥ mthe bong gnyis bsnol sor mo rnams nang du gdengs pa gdengs ka'i phyag rgyas dbang du sdud pa ni/ mu ṭa sa ma ya hūm̐/ yang gong gi phyag rgya las sor mo rnams phyir gdengs pa zil gnon gyi phyag rgya dang / mu ṭa sa ma ya phaṭa/ paṃ padma maṇḍa la/ a tsaṇḍa maṇḍa la/ aṃ pyaṃ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ snang ba mtha' yas yab yum du gyur/ mahā surya maṇḍa la hūm̐ phaṭa/ paṃ padma maṇḍa la e aṃ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ a nu ra ga ya hoḥ a nu ra ga ya mi/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ 'di yan gyi sngags rnams lan gcig bo dhi tsitta spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ lan gsum gyis rnal 'byor pa'i tshogs lhag de la 'bar ba'i phyag rgya kha phyir bstan gyis kha khru lan gsum gdab/ dang pos snod/ gnyis pas bcud/ gsum pas thob par bya ba'i phyir snod bcud rdzas gsum la bran no/ /lhag ma'i gnyis pa de snod gtsang mar blugs nas/ gong gi kha chu bran pa'i steng du bzhag las kyi rdo rjes sman raka bran/ rnga rol dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ dang po phud kyis mi mchod rgyu/ /bcom ldan dpal chen phud kyi bdag

/bar du tshogs la mi rol rgyu/ /ma dang sring mo tshogs la dgyes/ /tha ma lhag ma mi bya rgyu/ /dbang chen bran g.yog lhag ma dbang / /lhag ma kha chus mi bran rgyu/ /rje dang 'bangs gnyis khyad par che/ /rnam gsum gcig tu mi sre rgyu/ /chos kyi dbyings la bzang ngan med/ /mchod nas las rnams mi 'chol rgyu/ /chos 'khor bstan pa bshig pa 'byung / /hrīḥ dmar nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas/ /bcom ldan padma he ru ka /yum chen padma gar dbang la/ /bde gshegs khyung gis skor ba ni/ /buddha rigs kyi khyung chen dang / /rdo rje rigs kyi khyung chen dang / /rin chen rigs kyi khyung chen dang / /padma rigs kyi khyung chen dang / /las kyi rigs kyi khyung chen rnams/ /rang rang 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di 'bul gyis/ /bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /dpag bsam rtse nas bzhengs pa yi/ /las kyi khyung chen pho mo la/ /rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di 'bul gyis/ /bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /buddha ga ru ḍa/ badzra ga ru ḍa/ ratna ga ru ḍa/ padma ga ru ḍa/ karma ga ru ḍa i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhna kha kha khā hi khā hi putstsha ho rakta si saṃ swā hā/ hrīḥ dmar nag༞ /bcom ldan༞ /yum chen༞ /srin po pho mos bskor ba ni/ /phyogs bzhi nam mkha'i klong yangs nas/ /gza' mchog chen po rā hu la/ /ngan sngags bdag mo gdong ma bzhi/ /shar gyi stag srin stag gi gdong / /lho yi bam srin dred mo'i gdong / /nub kyi kong srin ba glang gdong / /byang gi 'brog srin chu srin gdong / /ngan sngags bdag mo khyed bzhi yang / /gtor ma len pa'i len tshul ni/ /nam mkha'i dkyil nas 'brug ldir ma/ /bar snang khams nas glog 'khyug ma/ /sad dang thog dang ser 'bebs ma/ /sprin dang rlung 'tshubs dkyil shed nas/ /'ur 'ur thog thog 'jigs byed ma/ /rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di 'bul gyis/ /bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/

/rā hu la badzra raksha ma ra tsa sha ha ya i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhna kha kha khā hi khā hi putstsha ho rakta si saṃ swā hā/ hrīḥ dmar nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas/ /bcom ldan padma he ru ka /yum chen padma gar dbang la/ /ma mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba ni/ /ma tshogs rang 'dra'i gzhal yas nas/ /stong gsum phung byed ma mo ni/ /nag ser dmar ljang ral pa can/ /phyag na sbrul gyi zhags pa bsnams/ /sbrul dang thod phreng rgyan du byas/ /rma bya'i thul pa sku la gsol/ /gtor ma len pa'i len tshul ni/ /kha nas shugs pa'i sgra 'bod cing / /lag na thod pa'i rnga chen brdung / /ma tshogs 'bum sde dam la sdud/ /rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /ma ma rakmo mahā kā li i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhna putstsha ho rakta si saṃ swā hā/ hrīḥ dmar nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas/ /bcom ldan padma he ru ka /yum chen padma gar dbang la/ /dregs pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba ni/ /bdud btsan rgyal po la sogs te/ /sde brgyad lha srin thams cad kyang / /gtor ma len pa'i len tshul ni/ /stong khams thams cad khu sgras 'debs/ /sha khrag bza' zhing dgra la 'chas/ /mtshon rtse dgra la ston cing rngams/ /rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /ra dzaḥsrog la hrīḥ a shu me tri/ srog la dza/ tsa pa la a shug dza/ tri mi dza/ badzra sadhu hrī dun dun shu la grī wa i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhna kha kha khā hi khā hi putstsha ho rakta si saṃ swā hā/ gtor sgo dbye ba dang / gtor lam bstan pa ni/ lhag gtor de gom pa gsum phyir bsnur/ gom pa gsum nang du bsnur nas/ bhyoḥ da ni gshegs so sha ra ra/ /da ni bzhud do si li li/ /da ni gshegs so dbyings su gshegs/ /gnas ngan tha ma dur khrod gnas/ /zas ngan tha ma mi gtsang zas/ /gos ngan tha ma shun chen gos/ /rgyan ngan tha ma sbrul nag rgyan/ /gnas ngan tha ma ma lags te/

/'khor ba'i mgo bcad gzhal yas khang / /zas ngan tha ma ma lags te/ /dug lnga 'joms pa bdud rtsi'i zas/ /gos ngan tha ma ma lags te/ /rnam rtog 'joms pa shun chen gos/ /rgyan ngan tha ma ma lags te/ /zhe sdang 'joms pa sbrul nag brgyan/ /da ni gshegs so sha ra ra/ /da ni bzhud do si li li/ /dang po 'bub cing 'bub cing 'gro/ /bar du 'phyongs shing 'phyongs shing 'gro/ /tha ma 'thengs shing 'thengs shing 'gro/ /dang po 'bub cing mi 'gro rgyu/ /gti mug phung po lhun re stug /gti mug phung po lhun mi stug /sha yi phung po lhun re stug /bar du 'phyong zhing mi 'gro rgyu/ /'dod chags phung po gting re zab/ /'dod chags phung po gting mi zab/ /khrag gi rgya mtsho gting re zab/ /tha ma 'theng zhing mi 'gro rgyu/ /zhe sdang phung po rtse re rtsub/ /zhe sdang phung po rtse mi rtsub/ /rus pa'i phung po rtse re rtsub/ /da ni gshegs so sha ra ra/ /da ni bzhud do si li li/ /sgo ma ma gi'i sgo phye zhig /phrang ma ma gi'i phrang phye zhig /sgo ma ma gi'i sgo phye na/ /btsas su gzugs chen dgra dbul lo/ /g.yas su re zhig thal ba re/ /'phrang ma ma ga'i 'phrang phye na/ /btsas su gzugs med bgegs 'bul lo/ /g.yon du re zhig 'bub sa re/ /da ni gshegs so sha ra ra/ /de ni bzhud do si li li/ /lhag ma'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ mahā ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ mahā rakta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes brjod cing / chems rol dang las kyi rdo rjes tshogs kyi lhag ma nam mkhar dor/ rnal 'byor pa'i lhag lam gyi bzhi mdor dor/ de nas brtan skyong gi sngon 'gro ni/ gtor ma rnams zhal phyir bsnur/ sman raka bran la/ rnga brdung zhing dbyangs dang bcas pas/ ngag tu/ bhyoḥ sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa dang po la/ /'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du/ /bcom ldan dpal chen badzra he ru ka /khrag 'thung rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas/

/snang srid ma mo dam la btags pa'i tshe/ /ki ri la sogs gnas kyi khro mo brgyad/ /singha la sogs yul gyi phra men brgyad/ /stag gdong la sogs sgo ma chen mo bzhi/ /so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang / /bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam/ /rnal 'byor tshe srog bsrung bar ma chad dam/ /sdang ba'i dgra bo sgrol bar ma chad dam/ /sngon gyi zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar/ /sha khrag rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /bhyoḥ de nas dus bskal de yi 'og rol la/ /rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi pho brang du/ /slob dpon chen po dga' rab rdo rje yis/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe/ /mgon po chen po bdun cu rtsa gnyis dang / /mkha' 'gro chen mo sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis/ /so so'i༞ /bka' yi༞ /rnal 'byor༞ /sdang ba'i༞ /sngon gyi༞ /sha khrag༞ /thugs dam༞/ bhyoḥ de nas dus bskal de yi 'og rol la/ /yar 'brog stag tshang seng ge'i dgon pa ru/ /slob dpon chen po dpal gyi seng ge yis/ /yang dag lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas/ /dbang phyug nyer brgyad dam la btags pa'i tshe/ /so so'i༞ /bka' yi༞ /rnal 'byor༞ /sdang ba'i༞ /sngon gyi༞ /sha khrag༞ /thugs dam༞/ bhyoḥ de nas dus bskal de yi 'og rol la/ /lho brag mkhar chu gnyan gyi dben gnas su/ /slob dpon chen po nam mkha'i snying po yis/ /rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas/ /gnam lcags brag la phur pa btab pa'i tshe/ /so so'i༞ /bka' yi༞ /rnal 'byor༞ /sdang ba'i༞ /sngon gyi༞ /sha khrag༞ /thugs dam༞/ bhyoḥ de nas dus bskal de yi 'og rol la/ /yar lung phug ring gad kyi dben gnas su/ /slob dpon chen po dzñā na ku ma ras/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas/ /ce spyang la sogs dam la btags pa'i tshe/ /so so'i༞ /bka' yi༞ /rnal 'byor༞ /sdang ba'i༞ /sngon gyi༞

/sha khrag༞ /thugs dam༞/ bhyoḥ de nas dus bskal de yi 'og rol la/ /bsam yas brag dmar chu rgyun ne'u sing du/ /slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyis/ /man ngag lta ba'i rdzogs 'phrang gsung ba'i dus/ /brtan ma bcu gnyis dam la btags pa'i tshe/ /so so'i༞ /bka' yi༞ /rnal 'byor༞ /sdang ba'i༞ /sngon gyi༞ /sha khrag༞ /thugs dam༞/ bhyoḥ de nas dus bskal de yi 'og rol la/ /nags rgyal lha chu dpal gyi brag phug tu/ /grub thob chen po rin chen bzang po yis/ /dbang chen lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas/ /dam can gying lnga gza' gdong yongs bsdus te/ /mu stegs bon po'i bstan pa snubs pa'i tshe/ /so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang / /bka' yi༞ /rnal 'byor༞ /sdang ba'i༞ /sngon gyi༞ /sha khrag༞ /thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /de nas gtor ma rnams phyir gom pa bdun cu rtsa lnga'i bar khur nas zhing lpags sam gcan gzan gdug pa can gyi lpags pa'i steng du 'jog brtan skyong dngos ni/ hoḥ nag mo bzhin mi sdug gi bu mo bdud mo chen mo bzhi dang / ma mo khro gnyer can ma'i bu mo gnod sbyin mo chen mo bzhi dang / dkar bsham bzhin bzang gi bu mo sman btsun mo chen mo bzhi ste/ bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis/ 'khor zhing gi rdul snyed dang bcas pa dpal chen po'i pham 'bags dang / sgrub pa po'i stong grogs la 'dir gshegs shig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ e a ra li hri hri dzaḥdzaḥ mu ṭa sa ma ye hūm̐/ mu ṭa sa ma ya phaṭa/ mu ṭa sngags mtshan gnyis kyi dang por dbang sdud dang / gnyis par zil gnon gyi phyag rgya gong bzhin/ rnga rol dang bcas/ bhyoḥ bka' yi tshogs dang bcas nyid du/ /khrag 'thung de bzhin nam mkha'i sku/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs skyong ma rnams/ /'dir gshegs dam skong 'phrin las mdzod/ /bdag nyid chen mo rdo rje kun grags ma/ /dpal ldan ha ri rdo rje g.ya' ma skyongs/

/gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje kun tu bzang / /'brog chen 'khor 'dul rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso/ /bdud mo chen mo khyed bzhi yang / /sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la/ /bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas/ /lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan dang bcas/ /sil sil mang po'i sgra dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs dam dgongs 'phrin las mdzod/ /gangs dkar sha med rdo rje g.yu bun ma/ /kha rag khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum/ /gser chen mkhar rgyug rdo rje rlung mo dang / /sma ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal/ /gnod sbyin chen mo khyod bzhi yang / /sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la/ /bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas/ /lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan dang bcas/ /sil sil mang po'i sgra dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs dam dgongs phrin las mdzod/ /kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong / /btsan la la rog rdo rje sman gcig ma/ /sman btsun 'dug chos rdo rje g.yar mo sil/ /g.yu yi dril bu rdo rje zu le ma/ /sman btsun chen mo khyed bzhi yang / /sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la/ /bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas/ /lhab lhub mang po'i rgyan dang bcas/ /sil sil mang po'i sgra dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs dam dgongs 'phrin las mdzod/ /slob dpon padma thod phreng dang / /bshes gnyen lang ka dpal brtsegs kyis/ /rgya yul de wi bstan bzangs su/ /zhing chen 'khrigs pa'i gdan steng du/ /rnam lnga zhing gi mchod bkram ste/ /lag tu rdo rje bskur nas ni/ /rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i dam la btags/ /rdo rje 'chang gi gral du bzhag /thar pa thob pa'i ming yang btags/ /ji bzhin khas blangs dam bcas bzhin/ /dam tshig bzhin las ma 'da' zhig /bod khams bsrung zhing skyong ba dang / /sgrub pa po yi stong grogs mdzod/ /bka' yi gtor ma 'di long la/ /spyi las gyur pa nad rnams dang / /rims nad thams cad bzlog pa dang / /bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/

/bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi zhal du mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ mahā ba liṃ ta khā hi/ mahā rakta khā hi/ zhes brjod de chems rol byed cing gtor ma rnams dgra phyogs su 'phangs pa'am/ yang na byang shar gyi mtshams su sa gtsang sar 'bul lo/ /gong tshogs kyi skabs phud dang po gsum du phye ba nas tshogs dang bshags pa bsgral mchod gsum gyi 'bul tshan dang / tshogs phud bar pa de rnal 'byor pho mo gang yod la 'gyed/ tshogs phud tha ma de dum bu gsum du btang ba'i dang po lhag ma'i yar gnas mchod pa ste 'das gtor sogs dang lhan cig dbul/ bar pa de lha'i lhag ma de rnal 'byor pa'i lhag ma'i steng du bzhag nas mar gnas la sbyin pa de phyir dor skabs lha'i de nam mkhar dor/ rnal 'byor pa'i de bzhi mdor dor/ tha ma la brten nas bro brdung bzhi/ sa la dong gru gsum 'dru ba'am bsam kyang rung / tshogs phud gsum pa'i tha ma de dang / gtor ma nas mtheb skyu gcig blangs la liṅga bzo ba'am dgra bgegs su dmigs la dong nang ngam gtor snod kyi 'og tu'ang rung / gtor snod kha phub la/ ngag tu/ e raṃ/ phaṭa raṃ/ dzwa la raṃ/ rni? dzaḥ tri dzaḥ pra be sha ya phaṭa/ a be sha ya a/ zhes brjod pa'i bstan la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad sa bon ིrni? tri las bskyed la/ de'i steng du/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal btab ste/ dbyangs dang bcas bro khrab pa ni/ dpon slob rnams lag g.yon steng bzhag bsnol ba'i g.yas g.yon gyi srin lag sbrel nas bskor la/ ngag tu/ hriḥ dmar nag gru gsum 'khyil pa yi/ /dbang chog dkyil 'khor chen po nas/ /bcom ldan padma he ru ka /dbang chen rngams pa'i sgra sgrog cing / /dbang gi rta skad tshe re re/ /khro bo'i 'brug sgra 'ur ru ru/ /rol pa'i rta bro chems se chems/ /gsang ba'i shug glu kyu ru ru/ /bskal pa'i glog dmar ljibs se ljibs/ /rdo rje thog 'bebs lam se lam/

/hūm̐ gis khams gsum dbang du sdud/ /phaṭa kyis dregs pa'i bdud dpung bsreg /rngam chen sku yi dkyil 'khor nas/ /'bar chen rus pa'i phung po la/ /gsod byed byams pas bro brdungs pas/ /zhe sdang me yi tshogs chen bcom/ /khrag 'thung gsung gi dkyil 'khor nas/ /bsreg byed rakta'i chu bo la/ /bsdud byed dbang po'i bro brdungs pas/ /'dod chags rgya mtsho'i rba klong bcom/ /dpal chen thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /ma rig sha yi phung po la/ /kun mkhyen gsal ba'i bro brdungs pas/ /gti mug mun pa'i tshogs chen bcom/ /gtum chen yon tan dkyil 'khor nas/ /ngar 'dzin dregs pa'i phung po la/ /bdag med rdo rje'i bro brdungs pas/ /nga rgyal brag ri'i tshogs chen bcom/ /'jigs byed 'phrin las dkyil 'khor nas/ /'gro rgyud ser chen 'khyil ba la/ /'dod chags snying rje'i bro brdungs pas/ /phrag dog 'dod pa'i tshogs chen bcom/ /ma chags padma'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /rnam rtog bgegs kyi phung po la/ /gnyis med rol pa'i bro brdungs pas/ /gnyis 'dzin gdon gyi tshogs chen bcom/ /nyon mongs rdul du rlog pa'i bro/ /nyon mongs steng du rab brdungs shig /rnam rtog phye ru 'thag pa'i bro/ /rtog pa'i mgo la rab brdungs shig /skye med klong du chems se chems/ /'gag med klong du 'khrig se 'khrig /dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa/ /dgra bgegs thams cad staṃ bha ya nan/ /srin lag sgrel ba dkrol/ thal mo sbyar/ na mo bdag cag rdo rje slob dpon mched dang lcam dral rnams/ tshe rabs thams cad du bla ma rdo rje slob dpon gyi zhal mthong zhing / zhabs drung du skye bar gyur cig mant+ra mu tra sa man ti tra tha/ zhes brjod/ gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga ni/ de nas nang du log la dkyil 'khor gsal gdab pa ni/ bhrūm̐/ bi shwa bi shuddhe dzñā na tsakra maṇḍa la bhrūm̐ hrīḥ badzra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ mahā kro dhi shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra shwa ra kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ratna shwa ra kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ padma shwa ra kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ karma shwa ra kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badzra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badzra gaṇḍe hoḥ zhes pas rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal gdab/ hrīḥ mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog dang / /bdug spos snang gsal zhu rtog sgra/ /zhal zas dri chab 'di rnams kyang / /padma dbang chen dkyil 'khor la/ /mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mahā padma shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ dhū pe/ puṣpe/ a lo ke gandhe/ nai wi te/ shapda/ rnams gcug pa sngags gzhung du spel ba'am/ sngags mchod rkyang pas kyang rung ngo / /nang gi mchod pa ni/ hrīḥ badzra kro dha/ nas/ oṃ badzra gaṇḍe hoḥ'i bar brjod cing / mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ mahā ba liṃ ta khā hi/ mahā rakta khā hi/ bstod pa ni/ rnga brdungs shing dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ lag pa g.yas pa rdo rje gsor zhing / phyag 'tshal ba'i stangs ka dang / g.yon pas dril bu/ shlau ka re re'i mtshams su bcad gtub tu dkrol la/ hrīḥ 'od gsal dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /zung 'jug bde chen rnam 'phrul las/ /sna tshogs sprul pa'i skur bstan pa'i/ /rta mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spros pa kun las rnam grol yang / /chags chen chags pa 'dul ba'i phyir/ /bud med sgyu ma'i tshul 'dzin pa'i/ /khro mo yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zag bcas phung po gnas gyur cing / /nyon mongs rnam dag ye shes sku/ /phrin las rnam bzhi rdzogs mdzad pa'i/ /khro rgyal bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag chad bdag mtshan rnam dag cing / /bsdu dngos tshad med bzhi yi dngos/ /dgug gzhug bcings dang dbang mdzad pa'i/ /sgo ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdug pa can rnams 'dul ba'i phyir/

/rab khros rngams shing mi zad pa/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa yi/ /bka' bstod rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis rnam dag cing / /byang chub phyogs chos rang bzhin can/ /bde chen snying po yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /gzhal med khang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis med ye shes rdo rje yi/ /sa bzhi rwa ba bla re gur/ /ye shes me dpung 'bar ba can/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lor phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod la bstod pa'i dge ba des/ /lam gyi bar chad gegs bsal nas/ /tshe 'dir tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs te/ /sku bzhi bdag nyid thob par shog /oṃ padma shrī he ru ka zhes sogs yig brgya lan gsum mam ci rigs bzlas/ bzod pa gsol ba ni/ thal mo sbyar te/ ngag tu/ bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgongs su gsol/ /bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis/ /bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur te/ /padma dbang chen dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi/ /thugs dang 'gal ba'i las rnams ci bgyis pa/ /thugs rjes che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol/ /bzod par gsol lo tshangs pa stsal du gsol/ /tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /smon lam ni/ dge ba 'di yis 'gro kun sems can rnams/ /padma rgyal po'i go 'phang mchog thob nas/ /ma rig ldongs pa'i skye tshogs thams cad la/ /rol pa'i rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog par shog /rtag pa'i mtha' gsal ba ni/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor yod na lag pa g.yas steng du dang / g.yon 'og tu bsnol ba'i mtheb srin gnyis kyi se gol phyir gtogs/ ngag tu/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badzra muḥ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab ste/ mthar rol mo dang bcas gtso bo nas byang sgo'i bar gyi sngags brjod cing / so so'i mtshan ma ni mtheb srin gyis rdul tshon blangs te spyi bor bzhag

ngag tu/ rdul tshon gyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ oṃ shu n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dam tshig pa bdag la thim/ bdag thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim/ hrīḥyang je phra je phrar gyur nas mi dmigs pa'i ngang du gyur/ ces brjod la/ rdo rjes thal byung gis ri mo shar sgo nas nub sgor bshig lho sgo nas byang sgor bshig rtsig pa rnams dbang ldan nas brtsams te 'khor mor bshig la/ mthar tshad legs par bsdus/ thig shul rnams kyang las bum gyi chus bkrus la/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /de'i shul du me tog gi char phab pa ni/ sgrub grogs rnams kyis rol chen dang / slob dpon gyi me tog dang bcas pas me tog gtor zhing dril bu bsil la/ ngag tu/ 'khor lo chu skyes nyi zla ru tra'i steng / /zhabs bzhis bdud bcom pha rol phyin drug phyag /'bar ba'i sku gsum rnam thar dbu gsum bstan/ /dbang chen rta skad bzhed kyi bkra shis shog /gar dbang chos dbyings zhal dang bden gnyis phyag /rtag chad mtha' mnan zhabs gnyis gnyis med 'khril/ /dges pa'i gar bzhis sku gnyis 'gro don mdzad/ /bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i bkra shis shog /rtsibs bzhi'i chu skyes nyi zla bdud bzhi'i steng / /gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed kyi/ /khams bzhi bden pa bzhi yi rnam par dag /sprul pa'i khro rgyal bzhi yi bkra shis shog /sgo bzhi chu skyes nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /sa chu me rlung rnam dag sgo ma bzhi/ /tshad med bzhi yi 'khor ba'i chu bzhi skems/ /sgo skyong rnam pa bzhi yi bkra shis shog /lam chos rnam dag dur khrod gzhal med khang / /'khor chos rnam dag 'byung ba lnga yi steng / /dug lnga sreg byed me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus/ /chos dbyings thar pa'i grong mchog bkra shis shog /rnam shes gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'khrigs/ /bden chen bdud rtsi lnga myang zhen pa bral/

/stong nyid glu gar sgra dbyangs mchod pas mchod/ /yan lag drug ldan rdzogs pa'i bkra shis shog /ces brjod la rol mo sogs bzhag chad pa'i mtha' gsal ba ni/ ngag tu/ hrīḥbadzra kro dha ha ya gṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ rang skad cig gis chu las nya 'phar gyi tshul du rta mgrin dpa' bo gcig pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sku can du gyur/ legs bshad rin chen phreng ba 'khrig pa ltar na bsrung ba/ bsngo ba/ bkra shis tshe spel ba rnams 'dug kyang chos 'dir bsgrigs pa'i sgrigs 'di bzhin byas na legs pas mdun gyi tshe rten lhar bskyed pa rnams la dmigs te/ ngag tu/ mdun gyi bcom ldan 'das 'od du zhu nas phyag gi tshe bum la thim/ de nyid 'od du zhu nas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub kyi ngo bo/ dpa' bo 'bru lngar gyur pa'i 'od dpag med dang sor rtog ye shes kyi ngo bo yi ge aṃ dmar po/ mi bskyod pa dang me long ye shes kyi ngo bor hūm̐ sngon po/ rin 'byung dang mnyam nyid ye shes kyi ngo bo swā ser po/ rnam snang dang chos dbyings ye shes kyi ngo bo oṃ dkar po/ /don grub dang bya grub ye shes kyi ngo bo hā ljang khu rnams su gyur/ de rnams rang gi spyi bo nas gnas lngar thim par bsam la/ hūm̐/ yi ge 'bru lnga ye shes lnga/ /sangs rgyas lnga ni tshe yi bdag /'bru lnga rigs lnga'i rang bzhin te/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi dbang thob shog /oṃ padma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa traṃ/ buddha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ hoḥ tshe dbang du gyur cig dbang dngos grub tu gyur cig 'chi med kyi bdud rtsir gyur cig skyed med kyi ye shes su gyur cig bdud las rgyal bar gyur cig mi shig pa'i rdo rjer gyur cig mi 'gyur ba'i g.yung drung du gyur cig mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan du gyur cig ces brjod pas/ rang gi snying kha'i nyi zla ga'u'i rdo rje lu gu rgyud grol nas/

nyi zla ga'u kha phye ba'i nang du zhugs/ yi ge 'bru lnga po 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bab bzhin pa tshe dang rnam shes kyi rten la thim pas/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa skad cig nyid la byang zhing dag 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob/ slar yang ga'u rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyis sngar bzhin gdams par bsam/ tshe bsdu ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud brtan g.yo thams cad la phog pas 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ de nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor la thim/ de tshe rten 'od dkar po la thim/ de rnam par shes pa'i rten rni? yig la thim/ de nyid a dkar po 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ de yang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar chos nyid kyi ngang du thim par bsam la yun ring du mnyam par bzhag cing / las kyi rdo rjes/ tshe mda'i dar stong kha la dkris/ dpon slob rnams kyi thugs kar reg cing mgrin gcig tu/ cis kyang mi tshugs mi shigs pa'i/ /stong pa'i go cha bla na med/ /chos kyi dbyings su tshe sbas pas/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gzigs so/ /zhes brjod/ tshe brtan par bya zhing bsrung ba ni/ lag pa gnyis kyis mthe bong dang gung mo sbyar la gshib pa'i kha phyir bstan pas rgyan du mdzub mo gnyis bsnol ba'i rgyab nas srin lag gnyis kyi sor mo 'khyud la mtheb chung gnyis rwa ltar brkyangs pa bya khyung gi phyag rgya bcas la spyi bor reg ste/ ha ya grī wa hrī gab/ mgrin par reg ste/ ba mo dha ra hrī gab/ snying gar reg ste/ padma dha ra hrī gab/ lte bar reg ste/ tsandha rakṣa hri gab/ gsang gnas su reg ste/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyoḥhūm̐/ tshe spel ba ni/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas na bla ma dang tha mi dad pa'i mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa la brgyud pa'i bla ma/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma/ tshe'i lha dang drang srong gi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor nas bzhugs pa rnams dang /

gzhan yang nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa 'khor bcas/ padma dbang gi zhing khams nas khro rgyal padma dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ lho nub rnga yab dpal ri'i gnas nas slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas/ 'chi med tshe'i lha tshogs tsaṇḍa li la sogs pa dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gros bskor ba/ gzhan yang rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad phyogs bcu'i zhing khams nas sprin gyi phung po 'thibs pa'am/ bya'i khyu chen po phur ba bzhin du mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su byon/ de dag gis shis brjod dang 'dzab dbyangs kyi sgra 'brug ltar sgrog cing / me tog kyang 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi char chen po 'bebs par gyur/ ces dang / dril bsil me tog 'thor zhing gdangs dang bcas pas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'dir tshogs skal ldan rdo rje'i bu/ /snying gi ze'u 'bru dad pas phye/ /mig gi padmo mkha' dbyings ltos/ /yid la bde chen dga' ba skyong / /oṃ puṇye puṇye mahā puṇye a pa ri mi ta a yu puṇye dzñā na saṃ bha ro pa tsitte swā hā/ mdun ngos dag pa'i mkha' dbyings na/ /rje btsun bla ma tshe dpag med/ /tshe yi rig 'dzin bye bas bskor/ /lha dang mkha' 'gro srung mar bcas/ /byin rlabs thugs rje'i sprin phung gtibs/ /'dzab dbyangs rdo rje 'brug stong ldir/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i char rgyun 'bebs/ /tshe yi dngos grub bkra shis rtsol/ /oṃ puṇye/ sogs/ bde ldan yangs pa'i zhing khams nas/ /'chi med rgyal ba tshe dpag med/ /tshe yi lha dang lha mos bskor/ /gnas 'dir byon la bkra shis stsol/ /oṃ puṇye/ sogs/ padma dbang gi pho brang nas/ /khro rgyal padma dbang chen la/ /tshe yi khro bo khro mos bskor/ /gnas 'dir byon la༞ /oṃ puṇye/ sogs/ rnga yab dpal sde'i rtse mo nas/ /rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas la/ /tshe yi rig 'dzin mkha' 'gros bskor/ /gnas 'dir byon la༞

/oṃ puṇye/ sogs/ rgya bod phyogs bcu'i gnas chen nas/ /tshe yi brgyud ldan bla ma la/ /mched lcam dag pa'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /gnas 'dir byon la༞ /oṃ puṇye/ sogs/ dpon slob rnams kyis lag pa bsnol ba'i thal mo gan rkyal du bken par las kyi rdo rjes g.yas su tshe 'brang dang / g.yon du tshe bum gnyis dus gcig tu 'brim la thams cad kyis ngag tu gdangs dang bcas/ lag gnyis pad dkar bzhad pa'i rtser/ /'chi med dngos grub tshe yi rdzas/ /longs shig bskal ldan dpon slob rnams/ /lo brgya 'tsho ba'i bkra shis shog /oṃ puṇye/ sogs brjod/ tshe ril bskyed la/ dpal gyi zas mchog ril bu 'di/ /'khor 'das tshe bcud bsdus pa'i sman/ /zos pas 'chi bdag bdud bcom nas/ /tshe yi dngos grub bkra shis stsol/ /oṃ puṇye/ sogs/ tshe chang bskyed la/ snying po lnga ldan rigs lnga'i bcud/ /ye shes lnga ldan bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /myangs pa'i rdo rje'i lus khengs nas/ /tshe yi dngos grub bkra shis stsol/ /oṃ puṇye/ sogs tshe'i bar chad bsrung ba ni/ snying kha na tshe'i rten yod pa'i rtsa sgo smin mtshams su zla gam dmar po me 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du dpal rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas tsandan gyi be con dang / g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ dbu gtsug na rta mgo ljang khu 'tsher ba/ khro bo'i nyams thams cad rdzogs pa/ dur khrod kyi chas thams cad kyis rgyan pa/ zhabs gyad kyi dor stabs can cig bzhugs pas tshe'i bar chad thams cad bsrung bar gyur/ ces dang las rdor gyis dpon slob rnams kyi smin mtshams su li khri'i thig le byas la/ a wa ddhu ti'i sgo 'phar na/ /zla gam dmar po'i klong dkyil du/ /tshe yi sgo srung rta mgrin dbang / /bar chad bdud 'joms bkra shis shog /hrīḥbadzra kro dha/ sogs/ bsngo ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /khro rgyal dbang chen grub gyur nas/

/'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /tshe ring nad med longs spyod ldan pa dang / /mi snang mkha' spyod las rnams 'grub pa dang / /shes rab ldan zhing rgyud rnams rtogs pa dang / /bde ba chen po'i sku gsum 'grub par shog /bla ma yi dam dkon mchog dgongs du gsol/ /dge ba 'di sogs 'khor 'das sems can gyi/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba dri med des/ /bdag gzhan sgrib bral tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs te/ /padma rgyal po'i go 'phang myur thob shog /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang / /bla ma rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / /bstan 'dzin skyes chen sku tshe ring ba dang / /dge 'dun rnams kyi chos spyod 'phel bar shog /bdag gzhan phyi nang rkyen rnams zhi ba dang / /tshe dang dpal dang 'byor ba rgyas pa dang / /ci bsam don rnams chos bzhin 'grub pa dang / /sa lam bgrod nas byang chub myur thob shog /sems can rnams kyi bsam sbyor phun tshogs nas/ /phan tshun gnod pa'i bsam sbyor zhi ba dang / /lo phyugs thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / /thams cad bde 'byor phun sum tshogs par shog /mtho ris yon tan bdun ldan lus thob nas/ /bla ma yi dam dkon mchog skyabs btsal te/ /lhag bsam dag pa'i bsam sbyor phun tshogs ldan/ /rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid rgyas thebs shog /bar dor 'khrul pa'i snang log mi 'byung zhing / /'jigs skrag ya nga'i gnas dang bral ba dang / /bden zhen sred len rtog pa rab zhi nas/ /bar dor sku gsum don mchog 'grub par shog /grub chen brgyad dang las bzhi lhun grub cing / /lam lnga khyad par sa lam bgegs bgrod de/ /sku lnga ye shes lnga yi mchog thob nas/ /phrin las mthar phyin 'gro rnams smin byed shog /bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum po dang / /mkha' 'gro chos skyong rig 'dzin pho mo dang / /mched dang lcam dral nyan rang dgra bcom gyi/

/bden pa'i stobs kyis bsngos kun 'grub par shog /dril gsil me tog gtor la/ bkra shis gang zhig lhag lha'i gtsug gi rgyan/ /rin chen sna tshogs 'bar ba'i lha nge ba/ /gang gis mchod na dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i/ /mtshungs bral bla ma'i bkra shis deng 'dir shog /bkra shis gang zhig tshogs gnyis las grub cing / /sku lnga rab rdzogs ye shes lnga yi bdag /thugs rje che sprul khro chen rngams pa'i zhal/ /khro rgyal dbang gis bkra shis deng 'dir shog /bkra shis gang zhig spros las rnam grol yang / /gdug pa 'dul phyir khro mo'i cha lugs 'chang / /stong nyid dbyings las ye shes rol pa shar/ /gar dbang yum gyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /bkra shis gang zhig ye shes lnga yi dngos/ /'phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /thugs rje las byung ye shes khro rgyal bzhi/ /dbang chen bzhi yi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /bkra shis gang zhig bsdu dngos tshad med bzhi/ /dgug gzhug bcings dang dbang gi las rnams mdzad/ /ye shes sgo ma srung ma'i las mdzad pa'i/ /sgo ma bzhi yi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /bkra shis gang zhig dur khrod gnas mchog nas/ /'jig rten 'das dang gdug pa'i cha lugs 'chang / /sangs rgyas bstan la gnod byed tshar gcod pa'i/ /bka' bstod rnams kyi bkra shis deng 'dir shog /bkra shis gang zhig byang chub chos rnam dag /sangs rgyas zhing mchog dag pa'i gzhal yas khang / /bdud bzhi'i dpung 'joms srung ba'i 'khor lo mchog /bden pa des kyang bkra shis deng 'dir shog /bkra shis kun gyi dpal du bkra shis shing / /lhar bcas bkra shis bde legs bkra shis la/ /ngo mtshar bkra shis mchog tu bkra shis la/ /skyabs gsum lhag pa'i lha yi bkra shis shog /gzhan yang bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad ci rigs bya'o/ /spyod lam ni/ snod thams cad gzhal yas khang / bcud thams cad rta mgrin gyi lha tshogs/ sgra thams cad sngags/

rtog pa thams cad chos/ 'dod yon lnga'i longs spyod la de mchod pa'i bsam pas longs spyad pas 'bras bu tshe 'di phyi bar do skye ba bdun nam bcu drug tshun tshad la dpal rta mgrin gyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar dpal chen padma dbang chen gyi/ /dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa'i tshul/ /dang po'i las can 'jug pa bde phyir dang / /lugs 'di'i smin grol chos rgyun spel ba'i phyir/ /rgyud dang mkhas grub gzhung bzang la brten nas/ /rang bzo'i dri mas nye yang ma gos pa/ /sgrib pa dag par sbyar ba'i yi ge 'di/ /rta mgrin rig 'dzin kun blo'i legs bshad yin/ /bzod gnas spyod ldan mkhas pa'i tshogs rnams dang / /skal ldan dad cing ya rabs 'ga' yod na/ /tshur byon go thob legs bshad 'di bzhes dang / /rta mgrin sgrub mchod shin tu gsal bar 'gyur/ /'di sogs gsang sngags gsar ma'i chos tshul rnams/ /mi nyams rgyun du spel ba'i lhag bsam gyis/ /gsal byed yi ger bkod dang bkod 'gyur dges/ /bstan 'gror phan zhing 'gro kun sangs rgyas shog /ces dpal padma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa khrag 'thung lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa'i chos 'di ni kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ge'i dbang chog bde chen myu gu/ bla chen chos dpal ba'i dbang chu ma dag pa'i dri ma khrud byed/ gnyags rnam rgyal bzang po'i phrin gzhung rnams gtso bor bzung / gsal byed she ni sa lugs rgyal mtshan gyi 'phrin gzhung dang / tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i tshe dbang gying lnga gza' gdong ma 'od byin rnams kyi gtor chog tshar chen rin po che dang rje chos dbang rin chen gyi zhal slob ldong 'dren ind+ra sa mu dra'i legs bshad rin chen phreng ba rnams kyang bgyis te/ yig cha de rnams kyi dgongs pa dang / tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po yab sras kyi phyag len gtso bor bzung ba yin pas chad lhag dang nor 'khrul cung zad kyang med pas skal ldan rnams kyis 'di ltar nyams su blangs pas blo gtad thub par yod cing /

lugs 'di la mkhas grub kha shas kyis rgyud sde spyi gros ltar na sta gon gyi chos tshang ma dang / bdag 'jug dang rigs pa'i dbang lnga sbyar ba sogs pa 'dug kyang gong gi yig cha de rnams la mi dgos par gsungs pas chad pa'i skyon med do/ /zhes pa sa skya lo tsā ba kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dpal sa skya'i nyan 'chad pa rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis 'di 'dra zhig brtsom dgos zhes rten bcas bskul ma byung ba bzhin yi ge sngon ma rnams kyi sgra don la gnod kyang snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bstan rgyun spel ba la lugs chos la 'di 'dra ba rang byin rlabs che bar 'dug pas rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtshos gzigs gnang ba rtsal du gsol/ 'dis bstan pa dang sems can la phan thog par gyur cig rta mgrin yang gsang sgrub dkyil ras bris la brten nas zhag brel byed na bum bskyed bdag mdun tha mi thad grub tshar ba'i oṃ padma kro ta ka ya wakka tsitta siddhi a la la ho/ zhes pa'i rjes su bum bskyed tshe dbang byed na tshe sgrub/ mi byed na gying lnga gza' gdong sogs kyi gtor bsngo nas/ nyin dang po rnams mtshan sngags padma he ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum byas tshar ba dang / spyi btab dgos na de bzhin/ mi dgos na hriḥmachod yon zhabs bsil nas rol ba'i rta skad phyogs bcur sgrogs par shog bar/ dbang bskur byed na slob ma la dbang bskur gong rang nyidadakyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas bye tshar bas 'dir mi dgos/ ras bris lugs kyi sgrub mchod rkyang pa yin na/ de nas rang phyi dkyil gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas las kyi rta mgrin du bye bar bsams la/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /zhes sogs kyis ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brtan bzhugs/ bya khyung gi phyag rgyas rung ste/ ha ya grī wa hrī gab nas/ hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ gi bar/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag nas/

lha yi bkra shis shog bar/ nyin rjes mar sgral mchod nas mjug bkra shis kyi bar yongs rdzogs ras bris dang rdul tshon gyi ltar ni gong du bshad pa bzhin no/ /tshe dbang mi byed na de'i yo byad sgrub pa dang bcas pa mi dgos/ 'dis dbang bskur thams cad la tshe dbang dang / gying lnga gza' gdong gi rigs gtad sbyor ba'ang mi mdzad/ chos rgyun 'dzin thub pa dang mi thub kyang rgyas par byed dgos na thams cad dang min na dbang bskur pas rung ngo / /tshogs mtha' ma nas bzung ste bkra shis kyi bar 'dir de bzhin grub dbang rgyas pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur/ nub mtha' mar ma gtogs ma grub kyang chad pa'i skyon med do/ /chas brgyad kyi gras tsam phur pa'i sgrub mchod la'ang de ltar rung ba'i phyir ro zhes pa'ang sa skya pa kun blos bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 96 kun dga' blo gros/ rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing mchod pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
